Are you ready to explore the world of aerospace and defense? Do you want to learn from and collaborate with some of the greatest minds in the industry? At RTX, our internships, co-ops and full-time careers provide an exceptional foundation to work on complex problems, advance your skills and create a safer, more connected world. Discover opportunities to make a difference at RTX.

What You Will Do

As a Systems Engineer at Raytheon, you will integrate hardware and software, develop test plans and procedures, debug and evaluate system functions and interfaces, and verify system requirements in support of final sell-off to the customer. We put our systems together, exercise them in the lab or in the field, measure and analyze performance, and make sure our products work the first time and every time. Every day is a different set of challenges to overcome. You'll be expected to collaborate with multi-disciplinary teams and partner to implement solutions. In this role, you will support elements of program development, engineering testing, integration, field testing, production, system deployment, and/or post deployment support across the product lifecycle. You will get to know a little bit about every aspect of the system and have a direct hand in making it all work together supporting teams of engineers engaged in integration and test efforts.

What You Will Learn

  • Supporting engineering activities related to testing and troubleshooting of hardware and software
  • Functional analysis of real world and test data; trade studies to bring advanced features to fielded system
  • Troubleshooting and failure data analyses, including root cause and corrective action processes and advanced use of lab or field test equipment
  • System integration and test support, possibly including live fire test events
  • Complete and compile detailed performance evaluations, including the use of analysis tools, such as MATLAB
  • Support qualification of our products
  • Maintain engineering specifications (DS, ARD, etc.) & drawing (Schematics & Assembly Drawings)
  • Prepare and present results in reports and briefings to internal or external stakeholders
  • Maintain engineering databases

Qualifications You Must Have

  • Bachelors Degree in Science, Technology, Engineering, or Mathematics (STEM) obtained by start date
  • Experience with troubleshooting technical issues in an academic or internship setting, including the use of common commercial test equipment (oscilloscope, spectrum analyzer, etc.)

Experience may be obtained through on-the-job experience, research, coursework, or projects.

Qualifications We Prefer

  • Strong undergraduate level understanding of electrical, mechanical and/or software system integration, familiarity with C/C++/C# preferred
  • Experience with tools, such as MATLAB or Python scripting, for instrumentation and collection of large data sets, data analysis and automation
  • Ability to analyze issues and define solutions
  • Strong communication skills including effective written, verbal, and listening skills
  • Self-starter with the ability to independently pursue information and solve problems

What We Offer

  • Our values drive our actions, behaviors, and performance with a vision for a safer, more connected world. At RTX we value: Trust, Respect, Accountability, Collaboration, and Innovation.

title: Lot Attendant
description:
Accelerate your career with Hertz!

Have you ever wondered what it’s like to work in a fast-paced, customer-focused environment where teamwork, integrity, and professionalism take the lead? Are you energized by staying organized, keeping things moving, and being part of one of the most recognized brands in the world? At Hertz, we’re looking for motivated individuals like you to help keep our operation running smoothly and our vehicles ready for the road.

THE JOB:
As an Automotive Sales Lot Attendant, you will play a key role in creating a strong first impression by ensuring our vehicles and sales lot are organized, presentable, and customer-ready. By taking ownership of inventory flow and lot appearance, you’ll help deliver a seamless and professional experience for both customers and team members. Join us and be part of a team that values transparency, teamwork, and attention to detail.
THE WAGE:
$16.00/hr

Hiring Bonus:
$1,000 total.
  • $500 after 90 days.
  • $500 after 180 days.

THE DAY-TO-DAY:
  • Control the flow of vehicles on the lot, including inventory management, logging new arrivals, and updating vehicle status in the fleet computer system.
  • Maintain lot merchandising standards by ensuring vehicles are frontline ready with correct pricing stickers, buyer’s guides, and frame plates.
  • Park, align, and organize vehicles to maintain a clean, professional, and presentable sales lot.
  • Manage the back-overflow lot and assist with shuttling vehicles to vendors, supporting dealer trades, and picking up customers as needed.
  • Assist with maintaining fuel logs, filing reports, and completing additional reports requested by the Location Manager.

THE IDEAL CANDIDATE:
  • Valid Driver’s License (Required).
  • Must be at least 20 years of age.
  • Flexible availability, including nights, weekends, and holidays.
  • Ability to work any assigned shift based on operational needs.
  • Internal candidates must have completed their probationary period with excellent attendance and performance.
PERKS & BENEFITS:
  • Medical, Dental, and Vision Insurance.
  • Life Insurance.
  • 401(k) Retirement Plan.
  • Paid Time Off.
  • Employee Vehicle Purchase Program & Employee Discounts.
  • Professional work environment with job training and advancement opportunities.

At The Hertz Corporation, we proudly operate the Hertz, Dollar, and Thrifty brands across approximately 9,700 locations worldwide. We champion a culture of diversity, inclusion, and opportunity—where unique perspectives and experiences drive our success.

If you believe in doing business with integrity, transparency, professionalism, and teamwork, we invite you to apply today — or tell a friend about this opportunity.

title: Investment Banking Senior Associate - Media & Communications
location: New York New York United States
description:
Citi is looking for an Investment Banking Senior Associate to join its Media & Communications team, playing a pivotal role in advising clients on strategic financial transactions, capital raising, and mergers and acquisitions. Working within the Institutional Banking group, you will act as a trusted advisor to clients — formulating investment strategies and executing complex transactions that directly shape the growth of Citi's franchise. This is an opportunity to bring your capital markets expertise to a global platform where your work delivers measurable client impact.

Responsibilities

  • Advise clients across the Media & Communications sector on mergers, acquisitions, and capital raising transactions, serving as a strategic intermediary throughout the deal lifecycle.
  • Execute investment banking mandates end-to-end, coordinating closely with the Institutional Banking team to deliver high-quality outcomes for clients.
  • Apply M&A and capital markets expertise to evaluate corporate transaction structures, identify strategic options, and support client decision-making.
  • Develop and present financial analyses — including valuation models, transaction comparables, and market assessments — to support client advisory engagements.
  • Build and sustain client relationships by supporting business development efforts, tracking industry trends, and contributing to sector research.
  • Mentor and develop junior analysts by providing structured guidance, managing information flow, and offering real-time feedback on work product and professional development.
  • Contribute to the growth of Citi's Investment Banking franchise by bringing sector insight, client focus, and transactional expertise to every engagement.

Required Qualifications & Skills

  • 5 to 8 years of experience in investment banking, capital markets, or a closely related financial advisory discipline.
  • Demonstrated ability to evaluate corporate transactions and structures, with hands-on experience executing M&A or capital raising mandates.
  • Proven track record building financial analyses, including valuation models and transaction-related financial assessments.
  • Clear and concise communicator, both in written materials and verbal client-facing settings.
  • Ability to manage competing priorities, coordinate across teams, and maintain rigorous attention to detail in a fast-paced transactional environment.
  • Active Series 79 and Series 63 licenses, or eligibility to obtain them.
  • Bachelor's degree in Finance, Business Administration, or a closely related field.

Beneficial Skills & Qualifications

  • Master's degree in Business Administration (MBA) or equivalent postgraduate qualification.
  • Experience supporting client development activities, including pitching, relationship management, and sector coverage.
  • Ability to track and synthesize business development intelligence — including competitive research and industry trend analysis — to inform client strategy.

What We Offer

At Citi, you will work alongside experienced professionals on high-profile transactions that shape industries and create lasting value for clients. This role offers the scope to develop your advisory career within a globally respected investment bank, with the support, resources, and platform to help you perform at your best.

  • A hybrid working model with 3 days in the office and 2 days working remotely, supporting a sustainable and productive work rhythm.
  • Meaningful leadership exposure through analyst mentoring and hands-on deal execution across the Media & Communications sector.
  • Access to continuous learning and professional development resources to advance your technical and advisory capabilities.
  • Competitive financial rewards, including compensation and benefits packages aligned to your seniority and contribution.
  • Wellbeing support and family-friendly benefits designed to sustain long-term performance and personal resilience.
  • The opportunity to build client relationships and develop strategic sector expertise within a globally connected team.

Apply today to bring your investment banking expertise to a global platform where your advisory work drives real outcomes for clients across the Media & Communications sector.

title: Head of Global Credit Reserves for Finance Chief Risk Office
location: New York New York United States
description:
The Finance Chief Risk Office (Finance CRO) is responsible for providing independent risk management oversight of the Finance function, including effective challenge and mitigation of capital, liquidity, interest rate risks, and market risk for treasury investments; oversight for operational and regulatory reporting risks for Finance; and oversight of key risk management methodologies and calculations, including credit reserves, and Basel Advanced RWA. Finance CRO is led by the Chief Risk Officer for Finance, who reports directly to the Citigroup Chief Risk Officer.

The Head of Global Credit Reserves leads a team of 20 to 30 risk professionals who are responsible for the oversight and governance related to Current Expected Credit Losses (CECL) and International Financial Reporting Standards 9 (IFRS 9) expected credit losses (ECL). The team’s responsibilities include executing the quarterly process to determine the appropriate level of credit reserves aligned with accounting and regulatory guidance, ensuring CECL and IFRS 9 policy compliance and managing related governance, and driving consistency between the U.S. and non-U.S. credit reserving processes. The role reports directly to the Chief Risk Officer for Finance and must have relevant prior experience in credit reserve management within Finance or Risk management departments of a financial institution.

The candidate must have the credibility to influence others in senior management, collaborate effectively across divisions, build relationships across Risk, Finance, and the business. This candidate should have an engaged, hands-on style of leadership, be results-driven and detail-oriented, and have a strong track record of execution.

Responsibilities

Directly lead a global team of risk managers specializing in calculating firmwide credit reserves according to CECL and IFRS 9 regulations and standards

  • Own the end-to-end frameworks for the determination of CECL and IFRS 9 credit reserves including all relevant documentation such as policies and procedures, methodological determinations, governance processes and reporting and analytical requirements.
  • Review baseline macroeconomic scenarios, prescribe the requirements for alternative macroeconomic scenarios, and determine appropriate scenario weights to ensure that the macroeconomic framework for credit reserving remains fit-for-purpose.
  • Review and challenge quarterly reserve results including its various components such as qualitative management adjustments.
  • Prepare presentations to senior management, including the firmwide CFO and CRO, with consolidated reserve recommendations, key messaging, and relevant analytics and information.
  • Present the consolidated reserve recommendations to senior management through the quarterly Citi Reserve Adequacy Committee meetings.
  • Act as Secretary of the Reserve Adequacy Committee meetings, ensuring approvals of credit reserves at the Citigroup and CBNA levels, of the CECL framework, and of the Credit Reserve Policy and compliance with all relevant governance committee requirements.
  • Coordinate among Risk workstreams, Finance and Investor Relations to prepare for earnings presentations and financial filings.
  • Provide quarterly credit reserve updates for Citigroup and CBNA Risk memos and other materials presented to the Board.
  • Lead regulatory, internal and external audit interactions/examinations related to the credit reserving processes and results.
  • Own the Tier 1 Regulatory responsibilities associated with SR 20-12 to ensure ongoing compliance with regulatory expectations.
  • Interact with model developers, sponsors and validation groups to review modelled results, model changes, model testing and model limitations.
  • Embed a strong risk culture to promote behaviors in accountability, challenge, effective risk management and governance at all levels of the firm.
  • Manage staff, including resource capacity planning, talent development, performance management, employee engagement and location strategy.
  • Establish and maintain a robust controls environment as owner of global control processes and, as necessary, lead any issue remediation processes.

Qualifications and Experience

  • 15+ years of experience working in financial institutions
  • BA or BS degree in Finance, Business, Economics or equivalent; advanced degree and/or professional certification preferred
  • Detailed knowledge of CECL / IFRS 9 requirements along with direct experience managing a CECL reserving process
  • Strong analytical skills, including credit and modeling experience with both Retail and Wholesale portfolios
  • Experience leading an integrated, cross-departmental process in a large-scale organization
  • Ability to influence senior business leaders, the Board, and external stakeholders on all risk-related matters and to provide critical thinking, independent challenge, and decisive action where necessary
  • Ability to negotiate, partner and collaborate through conflicting demands to maintain focus on priority objectives while ensuring key stakeholders’ needs are met
  • Excellent verbal, written and presentational skills with attention to detail, and extensive experience in dealing with senior management committees and board risk management committees

Do you have a passion for pathology, training, and customer engagement? Are you motivated by helping others develop technical expertise while working with innovative cancer diagnostic solutions?

We are seeking a Technical Trainer to join the Academy team in Glostrup.

The Academy serves as Agilent's center for technical trainings, product demonstrations, customer engagement, and VIP events, showcasing how our pathology solutions support laboratories and healthcare professionals in the fight against cancer.

In this role, you will combine your technical expertise with training, customer support, and laboratory management responsibilities. You will play a key role in ensuring high-quality learning experiences for internal stakeholders while supporting various commercial and operational activities.

Key Responsibilities

Training and Demonstrations

  • Prepare and deliver technical training sessions on selected pathology products and solutions.
  • Conduct product demonstrations for internal Agilent employees and stakeholders.
  • Collaborate with subject matter experts to continuously improve training content and delivery methods.
  • Support the planning and execution of Academy events and workshops.

Technical Support

  • Provide application support to Application Specialists, Sales, Marketing, and Customer Support teams.
  • Assist with technical inquiries related to pathology workflows, staining procedures, and product applications.
  • Participate in product launch and post-launch activities.

Laboratory Operations

  • Ensure the Academy laboratory remains a high-quality environment for demonstrations, training activities, and customer visits.
  • Ensure equipment readiness, laboratory organization, and compliance with safety requirements.
  • Support Sales and Marketing activities, including slide staining and preparation of demonstration materials.
  • Contribute to continuous improvement initiatives and local projects.

Qualifications

Required

  • Experience working in a pathology, histology, diagnostic, or laboratory environment.
  • Understanding of pathology workflows, staining techniques, and laboratory processes.
  • Strong communication skills with the ability to explain technical concepts to diverse audiences.
  • Good English communication skills, both written and verbal.
  • Ability to effectively manage multiple priorities and projects simultaneously while maintaining attention to detail and quality.
  • Proficiency with standard IT applications and digital tools.
  • Bachelor's, Master's Degree or equivalent.

Preferred

  • Certification or educational background as a Biomedical Laboratory Scientist, Bioanalyst, Histology Technician, or similar.
  • Knowledge of histopathology and immunohistochemistry.
  • Experience with Agilent pathology products.
  • Experience delivering classroom, virtual or hands-on trainings.
  • Ability to engage and inspire learners with different levels of technical expertise.

Personal Qualities

We are looking for a colleague who is:

  • Customer-focused and service-oriented
  • Structured, organized, and quality-minded
  • Self-driven and able to work independently
  • Flexible and adaptable in a dynamic environment
  • Collaborative, outgoing, and comfortable engaging with diverse stakeholders
  • Passionate about sharing knowledge and helping others succeed

Why Join Us?

At Agilent, you will be part of a global organization dedicated to advancing cancer diagnostics and improving patient outcomes. As part of the Dako Academy team, you will have the opportunity to influence learning, support innovation, and help customers maximize the value of our pathology solutions.

title: Experienced project controller
description:
Every day, we get opportunities to make a positive impact – on our colleagues, partners, customers, and society. Together, we’re pioneering the solutions of the future and unlocking the full potential of precious resources. Trusted to act on initiative, we challenge conventional thinking to develop world-leading technologies that inspire progress in vital areas, including energy, food, water, and shipping.​

As we push forward, the innovative, open spirit that fuels our 140-year-old start-up culture and rapid growth also drives our personal growth. So, as we shape a more resourceful, less wasteful world, we build our careers too.

Are you ready to make a tangible impact on global business performance and drive financial excellence in complex customer projects? Do you thrive as a strategic sparring partner for management while ensuring rigorous financial control

About The Job

As our new Project Controller, you will act as a vital link between project management, commercial teams, and business unit leadership. You will own the financial dimension of our project portfolio, support strategic decision-making and ensure healthy project execution from order to final delivery.

Your main responsibilities will include:

  • Project Financial Follow-up: Provide robust financial support and challenge to Project Managers on budgeting, forecasting, cashflow, and timeline updates

  • Work in Progress (WIP) & Accounting: Ensure accurate and compliant recording of accounting transactions, revenue recognition, and job costing within WIP.

  • IT interaction: Engage in local activities within central IT tools (e.g., Microsoft Dynamics 365, Medius, Solver, BI tools)

  • Business Partnering: Advise the Business Unit management team on financial implications, risks, and commercial opportunities related to ongoing and upcoming projects.

  • Business analysis: Provide monthly S&A analysis for BU management, including Workshop.

  • Performance Management: Track relevant financial KPIs, perform variance analyses (Actual vs. Budget/Forecast), and prepare monthly and quarterly reporting & business reviews.

  • Process & Digitalization: Drive continuous improvement of financial reporting tools, leveraging ERP systems and Business Intelligence (Power BI) to streamline workflows.

At Alfa Laval, we embrace a hybrid work model, providing you the flexibility to work from home when it aligns with your tasks. This position is based at our Søborg office in Copenhagen, with an expected travel commitment of approximately 5 - 10 days per year.

What you know

  • A degree in Finance, Accounting, Business Administration or similar.

  • Solid knowledge of financial reporting, forecasting, and internal control frameworks.

  • Understanding of business processes in a global company and know how to structure local compliance based on global standards (e.g. segregation of duties, internal controls, risk assessments).

  • Strong command of Excel, ERP systems (e.g., Microsoft Dynamics 365 or similar), and BI tools like Power BI.

  • Proactive, analytical, and structured with high attention to detail and strong integrity.

  • Fluent in English with strong interpersonal skills to build trust and influence decision-making across global matrix teams.

Who Are You?

You combine solid financial acumen with a strong commercial mindset and deep familiarity with multi-site project environments. You enjoy collaborating across organizational boundaries and can make financial data clear and actionable for non-finance stakeholders.

What We Offer at Alfa Laval

  • An open and innovative corporate culture with a strong emphasis on work-life balance and a hybrid work arrangement.

  • Continuous personal and professional development in a global market leader.

  • Opportunities to work with cutting-edge digital financial tools and collaborate across international borders.

title: Faculty Specialist
description:
Job Description Summary

Title:
Faculty Specialist (Research Coordinator) - University of Maryland College Park - Center for Substance Use, Addiction & Health Research (CESAR) / IN-PLACE: Interdisciplinary Network for Place-based Learning, Action, and Community Engaged EnviroMental Health

Job Description Summary:

The Center for Substance Use, Addiction & Health Research (CESAR) seeks a full-time Faculty Specialist (Research Coordinator) to support the IN-PLACE initiative - the Interdisciplinary Network for Place-based Learning, Action, and Community Engaged EnviroMental Health - a multidisciplinary partnership advancing community-based mental health and environmental research across Maryland.

The Research Coordinator will support data collection across all IN-PLACE cores, including providing evaluation support to the Community and Campus cores that will also be used to generate pilot data for future proposals and to demonstrate the impact of IN-PLACE activities. This position will work closely with the Operations Director to collect all impact metrics across IN-PLACE activities, conduct rigorous data cleaning, promote dissemination, and work with the Research Core to assemble future grant proposals to sustain IN-PLACE.

Organization Summary Statement:

The Center for Substance Use, Addiction & Health Research (CESAR) at the University of Maryland, College Park, was created in 1990 as a college-wide interdisciplinary research center. CESAR is dedicated to addressing the problems substance use disorders may create for individuals, families, and communities in Maryland and around the world. Our practical action-oriented studies and evaluations focus on improving access to treatment for substance use disorders and supporting long-term recovery. Our work spans the State of Maryland, including several projects in DC and Baltimore as well as reaching rural areas of both Western Maryland and the Eastern Shore. In addition, CESAR has several clinical trials located in Cape Town, South Africa.

IN-PLACE is an interdisciplinary initiative advancing community-engaged research on the relationships between people, place, environment, and health. Through partnerships across the University of Maryland and communities statewide, IN-PLACE conducts research on equitable access to nature, develops and evaluates nature-based health interventions, and translates evidence into education, workforce development, and community programming.

Key Responsibilities:
● Supporting data collection across all IN-PLACE cores
● Supporting the administration of the IN-PLACE seed grant program, including assisting with calls for proposals, application tracking, review coordination, award administration, and program evaluation.
● Providing evaluation support to the Community and Campus cores, including generating pilot data for future proposals and demonstrating the impact of IN-PLACE activities
● Working closely with the Operations Director to collect all impact metrics across IN-PLACE activities
● Conducting rigorous data cleaning and data quality assurance
● Assisting in the implementation of effective data flow and tracking systems across cores
● Promoting dissemination of findings to academic and community audiences
● Working with the Research Core to assemble future grant proposals to sustain IN-PLACE
● Supporting qualitative and quantitative data collection, management, and analysis
● Assisting with administrative responsibilities to support IN-PLACE programming and events

In addition to work on active IN-PLACE activities, additional duties include but are not limited to: assisting with presentations for scientific conferences and manuscript/grant preparation, developing research protocols and preparing IRB submissions, supporting oversight and mentorship of students in the lab, and capacity building to support training of other team members. There will be opportunities for manuscript co-authorship and conference presentations if of interest.

Minimum Qualifications:

Education: BA/BS in Social Sciences (Psychology, Public Health, Anthropology, Environmental Science, or related field) from an accredited college or university

Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities:
● Ability to organize and manage time and multiple tasks
● Attention to detail and excellent written skills
● Excellent organizational, interpersonal and communication skills
● Ability to work independently
● Ability to demonstrate a high level of cross-cultural sensitivity working with underserved populations
● Ability to maintain effective communication and working relationships with other study team members
● Experience with data collection, data cleaning, and program evaluation
● Project coordination and qualitative and/or quantitative research skills
Preferences:
● Master's degree (MA/MS) in Social Sciences (Psychology, Public Health, Anthropology, Environmental Science, or related field[AB1.1])
● Familiarity with electronic data capture tools (REDCap), statistical software (R, SPSS), and qualitative analysis software (NVivo)
● Interest in nature and health, environmental health equity, or community-engaged research

Job Risks: Occasional onsite presence involving participant-facing data collection in campus and community settings.

Physical Demands: Works in an office environment; regularly requires sitting for long periods of time in front of a computer; driving to the campus for onsite meetings and fieldwork sites.

Licenses/Certifications: Must have valid driver's license to drive to in-person meetings and fieldwork sites in Maryland.

Position Location: The position is a hybrid role and will involve on-site data collection as well as remote research coordination. This position will be based at the University of Maryland, College Park, the flagship campus of the University of Maryland, located only 5 miles outside of Washington DC, with occasional travel to off-site IN-PLACE locations across Maryland as needed.

Additional Job Details

This position provides opportunities to engage in community-based research, nature and health initiatives, program evaluation, and impactful public health-oriented research. IN-PLACE offers an exciting opportunity to support a statewide network connecting research, education, workforce development, and community engagement, with close collaboration across all IN-PLACE cores and Co-PIs.

Start date is negotiable in Fall 2026.

title: Security Officer
description:
Location: Yulee,Florida,United States

Job Title: Security Officer
Department: Security
Reports To: Head of Security
FLSA Status: Non-exempt
Effective Date: September 2025
White Oak conserves and sustains some of the earth's rarest wild animals through innovative training, research, education, and conservation breeding programs that contribute to the survival of wildlife in nature. The conservation programs span 600 acres along the St. Mary’s River in northeast Florida, surrounded by 22,000 acres of mixed forest and wetlands that make up the beautiful White Oak property. Founded in 1982, White Oak leads professional efforts to improve veterinary care, develop holistic animal management techniques, and better understand the biology of critically endangered species by providing excellent care and managing conservation programs for over 30 species of imperiled wildlife in large, naturalistic habitats.
White Oak Mission:
Saving endangered wildlife and habitats through sustainable populations, expanding education initiatives, and responsible land stewardship.
Job Summary:
The Security Officer is responsible for the safety and security of White Oak’s guests, staff, collection, and property.
Essential Duties:
o Performs regular safety checks on AEDs and fire extinguishers, ensuring all equipment meets operational standards and compliance requirements.
o Controls access into White Oak property by ensuring that all persons are authorized to enter.
o Monitors and accompanies external personnel, including contractors, vendors, and visitors while on-site to prevent unauthorized access and ensure adherence to facility guidelines.
o Retrieves and delivers incoming and outgoing mail and packages across designated areas in a timely and secure manner. Ensures company mail is secured daily, and any perishable items are delivered promptly.
o Enforces all company policies and procedures and reports all violations to immediate supervisor.
o Maintains awareness of daily activities on property including special projects, meetings, Wildlife activities, construction activities, special deliveries, events and Support Services dept work.
o Utilizes the White Oak calendar and other updates through email and any other forms of communications to track guest arrival/departure information.
o Makes prompt notifications to White Oak personnel when visitors, vendors and contractors arrive.
o Follows VIP/owner operating procedures and carries out responsibilities accordingly.
o Escorts vehicles throughout the property when necessary or requested to ensure road safety and arrival to desired destinations.
o Accounts for property keys at the beginning and conclusion of each shift.
o Documents accurate and detailed information via computer on department documents and logs, including employee entry/exit, security department radio logs, and visitor logs.
o Maintains knowledge of property geography in order to provide accurate directions, respond to incidents, provide escorts and carry out emergency response procedures.
o Maintains cleanliness standards in security buildings and vehicles.
o Works when property is closed for emergencies or circumstances when it is not possible to conduct business (example, severe storm damage), as required.
o Assists in conducting emergency drills.
o Conducts safety inspections at the direction of the Head of Security and/or Safety/Medical Lead Officer.
o Assists in inspecting medical and fire safety equipment and systems at the direction of the Head of Security and/or Safety/Medical Lead Officer.
o Provides quick and appropriate communications (dispatching) by radio and phone during emergency situations and coordinate necessary solutions. This may include contacting external emergency entities such as law enforcement, EMS and Fire/Rescue services.
o Attends required internal training courses as directed.
o Provides transportation of guests to/from the airport or throughout White Oak property. Performs security patrols throughout the property; makes security checks of lodges and other facilities and provides status/action reports.
o Investigates unusual activities and incidents and creates formal reports as necessary.
o Monitors alarm, camera and gate access systems.
o Informs outside emergency agencies of any unusual or suspicious situations on property.
o Generates written reports regarding security-related incidents involving guests, employees and/or the facility.
o Maintains communications with the rover and monitors the base station radio, while on gate duty.
o Provides access control, monitors alarm systems, and provide coordination for emergency response/casualty control.
o Monitors CCTV of back gate and operates gate remotely, as required.
o Monitors email, guest relations calendar, arrival/departure schedules, and utilizes internet to maintain updated information, as needed.
o Inspects jump bags to ensure equipment has batteries and is in working order.
o Monitors weather and traffic conditions and communicates severe warnings to all personnel.
o Ensures safe and engaging experience for White Oak guests.
o Performs other duties that are not specifically identified above, but are required to provide a safe, clean, healthy, and enjoyable environment for guests.
The above cited duties and responsibilities describe the general nature and level of work performed by people assigned to the job. They are not intended to be an exhaustive list of all the duties and responsibilities that an incumbent may be expected or asked to perform.
Education and Work Experience Requirements:
• High School diploma or equivalent required.
• Minimum of one year of security, law enforcement, or military experience.
• Minimum of one year of hospitality or customer/guest service experience.
• Report writing experience.
• Current First Responder and/or CPR & AED Certifications.
Knowledge/Skills/Abilities:
• Proficient computer software skills, including Microsoft Office.
• Ability to multi-task in a fast-paced environment.
• Excellent hospitality skills, including guest and employee relations.
• Must be dependable, trustworthy, reliable, and have a good moral character.
• Ability to communicate effectively and follow directions, both written and verbal.
• Must always remain alert while on duty.
• Capable of making sound judgments.
• Ability to remain calm in an emergency/crisis and carry out needed procedures.
• Ability to maintain control over your own emotions.
• Confident in own abilities to perform the duties required.
• Guest service orientation and drive.
• Highly responsible with a professional presentation.
• Strong attention to detail.
• Reliable means of communication for emergencies (cellphone).
• Capable of logical reasoning.
Physical Requirements, Hazards, and Special Working Conditions:
• Must be 21 years of age or older.
• Must be able to work nights, weekends, and holidays.
• Must be able to lift up to 50 pounds regularly.
• Must have valid Florida or Georgia driver’s license.
• Shifts are twelve hours in length.

You will also play a key role in taking Data and AI solutions from early experimentation through to production, including agentic applications, multi-agent systems and Model Context Protocol (MCP) services.

  • Develop cloud-native applications using modern engineering practices.

  • Write maintainable code supported by automated testing.

  • Improve system performance, reliability and scalability.

  • Design solutions using event-driven and domain-driven architecture patterns.

  • Develop streaming applications for low-latency, high-throughput data processing.

  • Support production systems and contribute to platform reliability.

  • Work with the Technical Lead to shape the technology roadmap.

Data & AI

  • Lead Data and AI solutions from discovery through deployment.

  • Identify opportunities to apply AI and automation to real business challenges.

Working together

title: Java Applications Development Lead, Vice President
description:
Overview of the Role

The Applications Development Technology Lead Analyst is a senior-level position within the Markets Treasury Technology team, specifically focusing on the Money Markets domain. This role is responsible for establishing, designing, and implementing highly resilient, scalable, and performant application systems and microservices in coordination with global technology and business partners.

The overall objective of this role is to lead applications systems analysis, architecture, and programming activities, driving the modernization of our Treasury and Money Market platforms using Java, Spring Boot, and MongoDB in a cloud-native environment.

Key Responsibilities

  • Technical Leadership: Lead the design, development, and deployment of high-throughput, low-latency transactional systems and microservices for Money Market trading, funding, and trade life cycle management.
  • Business & Function Integration: Partner with Markets Treasury business desks, product managers, and multiple management teams to align technology solutions with business goals, identifying and defining system enhancements to support new financial products and process improvements.
  • Architecture & Design: Provide subject matter expertise in modern application design, ensuring that all microservices and system integrations adhere to the firm's overall architecture blueprints, security standards, and cloud-native principles.
  • Problem Solving & Performance Tuning: Resolve high-impact, complex technical and business process issues. Conduct in-depth evaluation of system flows, database performance (MongoDB), data ingestion pipelines, and API exposure layers to eliminate bottlenecks.
  • Standards & Best Practices: Establish and enforce robust standards for clean coding, comprehensive testing (unit, integration, and performance), debugging, and automated deployment.
  • Mentorship & Collaboration: Serve as a technical advisor, coach, and mentor to mid-level and junior developers, allocating work, conducting code reviews, and fostering a culture of continuous learning.
  • Risk & Compliance: Appropriately assess risk when business decisions are made, demonstrating particular consideration for the firm's reputation and safeguarding the organization, its clients, and assets. Drive compliance with applicable laws, rules, and regulations, adhering to policy, applying sound ethical judgment, and escalating control issues with transparency.

Recommended Qualifications

  • Experience: 10+ years of hands-on application development and technical leadership experience in the financial services domain, with a strong focus on Markets Treasury, Money Markets, and Trade Lifecycle Management.
  • Core Tech Stack Expertise:
    • Deep, hands-on expertise in Core Java (Java 17+) and the Spring Boot ecosystem (Spring Cloud, Spring Security, Spring Data).
    • Strong experience with NoSQL databases, specifically MongoDB (document modeling, aggregation framework, indexing, sharding, and performance tuning).
  • Domain Knowledge (Money Markets & Treasury Accounting):
    • Strong understanding of core financial and treasury accounting concepts, including PAA (Profit Attribution Analysis), PnL (Profit and Loss) calculation/attribution, Accrual accounting (accrual interest, amortization, and yield calculations for Money Market instruments), and Risk calculations (IRDL and CRDL)
    • Proven experience integrating trading and treasury platforms with downstream ledger, accounting, and books & records systems for seamless PnL, accrual processing, and financial reconciliation.
  • Performance & Scalability: Demonstrated experience diagnosing and solving complex performance issues across the entire application flow (including database queries, messaging ingestions, and API exposure layers).
  • Cloud-Native & Modern Architecture:
    • Expertise in cloud-native development principles, designing and building highly resilient, scalable, and observable services (using tools like Prometheus, Grafana, or OpenTelemetry) in a cloud or containerized environment (e.g., OpenShift, AWS).
    • Experience with distributed caching (e.g., Redis, GemFire) and event-driven architectures using messaging middleware (e.g., Kafka, Solace).
  • SDLC & Tools:
    • Strong understanding of CI/CD pipelines (Jenkins, Tekton, or Harness), Git, Scrum/Agile methodologies, and JIRA.
    • Familiarity with AI-assisted development tools (e.g., GitHub Copilot) and a proven track record of leveraging AI to accelerate day-to-day development tasks, code generation, and optimization.
  • Leadership & Soft Skills:
    • Excellent communication, stakeholder management, and consensus-building skills, with the ability to articulate complex technical concepts to non-technical business partners.
    • Strong project management, prioritization, and organizational skills, with the ability to adjust priorities quickly in a dynamic environment.

Education

  • Bachelor’s degree/University degree or equivalent experience in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field.
  • Master’s degree preferred.

The Naval Power Finance Organization is seeking a motivated and detail‑oriented Senior Financial Analyst (P2) to drive process improvements, strengthen financial modeling discipline, and provide analytical leadership for Tomahawk Direct Investment (DI) within the Multi‑Year Procurement (MYP) environment. This role plays a key part in enabling informed financial decisions across Tomahawk capacity, acceleration, and rate‑readiness initiatives, including test equipment modernization, supplier throughput increases, capital investments, and obsolescence redesign.

The position partners closely with Program Management, Operations, Engineering, Supply Chain, and Finance to enhance forecasting processes, improve cost‑model accuracy, and ensure disciplined execution of DI‑related financial strategies across the Tomahawk portfolio.

What You Will Do

  • Lead improvements to monthly cost and schedule variance analysis processes by developing clearer financial models and trend‑tracking tools for Tomahawk DI and capacity acceleration efforts.
  • Support and refine Quarterly EAC development through cross‑functional coordination, assumption validation, and structured input management.
  • Build and enhance financial models assessing DI impacts related to test equipment upgrades, supplier rate‑readiness investments, capital planning, and obsolescence redesign activities.
  • Improve monthly variance analysis by evolving the framework used to interpret budget, forecast, and EAC performance.
  • Strengthen monthly LRE and quarterly EAC cycles through disciplined financial tools, improved inputs, and streamlined workflow improvements.
  • Prepare proposal and customer‑reporting financial materials that clearly capture DI cost and investment elements supporting MYP alignment.
  • Perform detailed financial analysis across multiple Tomahawk contracts, highlighting DI‑related cost drivers, schedule impacts, and performance trends.
  • Complete monthly cost CDRLs and financial deliverables while improving process efficiency and data reliability.
  • Provide weekly, monthly, and quarterly leadership reporting with increased focus on DI transparency and actionable financial insights.
  • Update financial charts and materials for Program Management Reviews with an emphasis on DI and MYP‑related cost drivers and performance indicators.
  • Process approved Budget Change Requests (BCRs), ensuring consistent integration into forecasting systems and improved internal controls.
  • Manage key aspects of the monthly forecast cycle, incorporating DI considerations into RPLAN updates, data validation, and financial consolidation steps.
  • Support FP&A cadence activities by improving consolidation accuracy, reporting quality, and operational financial processes.

Qualifications You Must Have

  • Typically requires a Bachelor’s degree in Finance, Accounting, Economics, Mathematics, Business, or related field or equivalent experience and minimum 2 years of prior relevant experience.

  • Proficiency in Excel including pivot tables, VLOOKUPs, conditional formatting, and charts.
  • U.S. citizenship is required, as only U.S. citizens are authorized to access information under this program/contract..

Qualifications We Prefer

  • Experience with APEX, PRISM, Analysis for Office, SAP, or SAP Business Warehouse.
  • Understanding of Earned Value Management (EVMS) and willingness to pursue certification.
  • Strong organizational skills with the ability to meet critical deadlines.
  • Self-motivated with strong analytical, problem-solving, and decision-making skills.
  • Ability to operate independently and collaboratively in a fast-paced environment while managing multiple competing priorities.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to brief leadership.

title: Payments and Fraud Analyst
description:
At Aristocrat, we believe in bringing happiness to life through the power of play. As a world leader in gaming content and technology, we offer an outstanding opportunity for a Payments, Fraud, and Risk Analyst to join our dynamic team. This role is pivotal in ensuring flawless payment performance, detecting fraud, managing risk, and optimizing operations across our iLottery and iGaming businesses. You'll have the chance to work closely with various teams and apply modern AI tools and techniques to improve your analysis and detection capabilities. Join us and be part of a world-class organization that values collaboration, innovation, and excellence!

What You'll Do

  • Analyze performance across clients, markets, payment methods, and risk indicators.

  • Identify and investigate unusual trends, processing anomalies, and emerging threats.

  • Use AI tools and machine learning techniques to improve fraud detection and risk analysis.

  • Provide clear findings and recommendations to Payments leadership and collaborators.

  • Ensure data accuracy across internal systems and business intelligence tools.

  • Develop and maintain reporting standards, controls, and validation procedures.

  • Find opportunities for payment and fraud optimization and cost savings.

  • Document root causes, corrective actions, and ongoing monitoring requirements.

  • Experience working with business intelligence platforms like Power BI, Tableau, or Looker.

  • Strong analytical, problem-solving, and investigative skills.

  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills.

  • Interest in or experience with AI methods and approaches for data analysis and fraud detection.

title: Senior Mainframe Storage Administrator
description:
Who We Are

At Kyndryl, we run and reimagine the mission-critical technology systems that drive advantage for the world’s leading businesses. We are at the heart of progress; with proven expertise and a continuous flow of AI-powered insight, enabling smarter decisions, faster innovation, and a lasting competitive edge. For our people—Kyndryls—that means doing purposeful work that powers human progress. Join us and experience a flexible, supportive environment where your well-being is prioritized and your potential can thrive.


The Role

As a System Administrator at Kyndryl, you’ll solve complex problems and identify potential future issues across the spectrum of platforms and services. You’ll be at the forefront of new technology and modernization, working with some of our biggest clients – which means some of the biggest in the world.

There’s never a typical day as a System Administrator at Kyndryl, because no two projects are alike. You’ll be managing systems data for clients and providing day-to-day solutions and security compliance. You’ll oversee a queue of assignments and work directly with technicians, prioritizing tickets to deliver the best solutions to our clients.

Responsibilities

  • Adopt the given technology to meet the drift of customer and business requirements

  • Storage box data migration (DASD to DASD and Tape to tape) and Storage replication

  • Analyze and research options for collaborates with exiting external systems

  • Root Cause Analysis preparation and meeting Service level agreement for submission

  • Develop, document and maintain procedures for system utilities such as backup/restore, performance tuning and configuration of environments as well as incremental backups as required

  • Initialize / add new DASD volumes and Add new tape volumes. Perform the space management activities such as VTOC resizing, Defrag, Compress/Reclaim/Release/Cleaning of datasets

  • Manage and Define SMS rules and ACS routines along with reorganization of storage dataset (RMM/HSM CDS & Catalog file)

  • Disaster recovery planning and performing the recovery test (Tape recovery / DASD Replication / Tape Replication) and Managing the Copy services / GDPS

  • Problem determination and resolution within expected time frame

  • Assume personal responsibility for resolving problems in most effective way possible within SLA reaching root cause and preventing problems

  • Lead daily Operations meetings provided there are no P1 incidents running

One of the benefits of Kyndryl is that we work with clients in a variety of industries, from banking to retail. Whether you want to broaden your knowledge base or narrow your scope and specialize in a specific sector, you can find your opportunity here. You’ll also get the chance to share your expertise by recommending modernization options, identifying new business opportunities, and cultivating relationships with other teams and stakeholders. Does the work get challenging at times? Yes! But you’ll collaborate with a diverse group of talented people and gain invaluable management and organizational skills, which will come in handy as you move forward in your career.

Your future at Kyndryl
Every position at Kyndryl offers a way forward to grow your career, from Junior System Administrator to Architect. We have opportunities for Cloud Hyperscalers that you won’t find anywhere else, including hands-on experience, learning opportunities, and the chance to certify in all four major platforms. One of the benefits of Kyndryl is that we work with clients in a variety of industries, from banking to retail. Whether you want to broaden your knowledge base or narrow your scope and specialize in a specific sector, you can find your opportunity here.


Who You Are

You’re good at what you do and possess the required experience to prove it. However, equally as important – you have a growth mindset; keen to drive your own personal and professional development. You are customer-focused – someone who prioritizes customer success in their work. And finally, you’re open and borderless – naturally inclusive in how you work with others.

Required Technical and Professional Expertise

  • 9+ Years of Experience in Mainframe Storage Administration.

  • Experience with DASD and tape data storage solutions (Experience on DASD/Tape Configuration and Migration) for mainframes.

  • Candidate should possess working knowledge of Z/OS Operating System, z/OS(MVS) fundamentals, Storage fundamentals and Storage Devices.

  • Candidate will be expected to have good knowledge in the following areas: TSO, ISPF, JCL, VSAM, ISMF, JES2, Catalogs, Datasets (PS/PDS/PDSE/GDG), REXX, SAS, SDSF and Spool.

  • Candidate will be expected to have good knowledge & Experience in the following (: MF - Tape & DASD Management) areas: DFSMS, DFSMSHSM, DFSMSDSS, DFSMSDFP, DFSMSRMM, ICF Catalog, VSAM, IDCAMs, CA products (CA Disk, CA allocate and CA-1), FDR products, Omegamon XE or related Storage monitoring tools, ICKDSF, Space abends and SMF/Dcollect/BVIR reports.

Preferred Technical and Professional Experience

  • Bachelor’s degree in computer science or a related field.

  • Provides technical support activities for a production mainframe environment of multiple LPARs, CECs, DASD and VTS controllers.

  • Experience in Storage box data migration (DASD to DASD and Tape to tape) and Storage replication.

  • Candidates have to work in customer work hours- US, Europe and Asia Pacific (weekends and holidays as on call staff).


Being You

The “Kyn” in Kyndryl means kinship, which represents the strong bonds we have with each other, our customers and our communities. We focus on ensuring all Kyndryls feel included and we welcome people of all cultures, backgrounds, and experiences. Even if you don’t meet every requirement, we encourage you to apply. We believe in growth, and we’re excited to see what you can bring. At Kyndryl, employee feedback has told us that our number one driver of employee engagement is belonging. That sense of belonging — being a valued, respected, trusted member of the team — is fundamental to our culture and fueling great experiences for our customers. This dedication to welcoming everyone into our company means that Kyndryl gives you the ability to thrive and contribute to our culture of empathy and shared success. That’s The Kyndryl Way.


What You Can Expect

Your career with us isn’t just a job—it’s an adventure with purpose. We offer a dynamic, hybrid-friendly culture that supports your well-being and empowers you to grow. Our Be Well programs are thoughtfully designed to support your financial, mental, physical, and social health—because we know that when you feel your best, you do your best.

From your very first day, you’ll dive into impactful work that powers the systems our customers rely on every day. You won’t just contribute—you’ll make a difference, tackling meaningful projects that sharpen your skills and fuel your growth.

We’re here to champion your journey. With powerful tools to chart your career path, personalized development goals aligned with your ambitions, and continuous feedback to keep you inspired and on track, you’ll have everything you need to thrive and evolve. You’ll develop in-demand skills to grow your career and achieve your ambitions with access to cutting-edge learning opportunities—from certifications with Microsoft, Google, and Amazon to coaching and hands-on experiences. And through it all, you’ll be part of a culture that values empathy, restless learning, and a devotion to shared success.

We want you to thrive here—and we’re committed to helping you do just that. Ready to make an impact? Join us and help shape what’s next.

Get Referred!

If you know someone that works at Kyndryl, when asked ‘How Did You Hear About Us’ during the application process, select ‘Employee Referral’ and enter your contact's Kyndryl email address.

Together, we push the boundaries of known science and find new ways to connect and protect our world.

Pratt & Whitney is a world leader in the design, manufacture and service of aircraft engines and auxiliary power systems and has been revolutionizing modern flight for over 100 years. Join us and help shape the future of aerospace and defense.

What You Will Do

This is a 2nd Shift Opportunity. this is Monday - Thursday ( 4 -10 hour shifts) 4:00pm- 2:00am

This position is designed to give individuals with little or no machining or grinding background the skills they need to become a Certified Operator at Pratt & Whitney.

Employees selected for this position will attend a 3-week training program and participate in 4-8 weeks of the on the job training.

Learn to set up and operate NC milling/grinding machines, vertical turret lathes or VTC’s to perform routine production operations on a variety of similar weldments and assemblies.

Learn to verify conformance of finished work to specifications using precision measuring instruments.

Obtain operator Certification to be able to accept/reject parts.

Learn to maintain machines by performing required total preventive maintenance (TPM)

Learn to work collaboratively with engineers, quality assurance, programmers and other production personnel or others to resolve machining problems and assist in part process development.

Must be able to read, write, speak and understand English

Skills, systems, and processes critical to aerospace manufacturing within a stat of the art facility.

Training and advancement opportunities at all levels through a supportive and collaborative employee experience.

On -the -job training using the most advanced technology in the industry today.

High School or GED

title: Senior Project Manager
description:
Building a career at Granite may be the most valuable thing you could do...

Find your dream job today, and be part of something great. Our most powerful partnership is the one we have with our employees. Our people are our most valued asset and the foundation of Granite’s century-old success. We’re building more than infrastructure; we are building your future.

General Summary

This position is responsible for the overall direction, completion, and financial outcome of complex construction projects with a revenue range of $50 - $100 million with project durations up to 3 years.

Essential Job Accountabilities

  • Perform accurate project revenue and cost financial forecasting to ensure corporate profitability goals are met.

  • Manage a staff of up to 10 full-time employees including hiring, firing, and completing performance reviews.

  • Coordinate with estimators and project controls group to establish budget.

  • Lead estimating efforts on vertically integrated projects to ensure accurate and consistent bid to build process.

  • Coordinate efforts with estimators, large project sponsor, and manager of construction to manage resources to meet project schedule.

  • Participate in bid review and bid closing to ensure accuracy of bid and evaluate project feasibility; work with estimating team to develop bid schedule.

  • Coordinate with large project sponsor, manager of construction and project team to develop comprehensive plan for project start up and successful kick-off.

  • Provide environment where dynamic project communication occurs between Project Engineers, Foremen, Superintendents and Construction Manager to ensure work is accomplished in an efficient, profitable, and safe manner.

  • Ensure proper job controls, i.e. quantities, costs, revenue and schedule.

  • Establish and maintain working relationships with owners, agencies, subcontractors, inspectors, etc., providing customer service to develop long-term partnerships with client base.

  • Ensure accurate construction reports for the job allowing for continuous improvement in performance.

  • Run projects at profitability levels to meet or exceed expected margins.

  • Comply, understand, and support corporate safety initiatives to ensure a safe work environment.

Education

  • BS degree in Civil Engineering, Construction Management, Business Administration, or related field or equivalent work experience in heavy civil construction.

Work Experience

  • Minimum of ten (10) year’s progressive project experience in heavy civil environments.

  • Minimum of five (5) years experience in paving, dirt, and grading in either private or public environments.

  • Experience as a Large Projects Superintendent preferred.

  • Experience in Design-build projects preferred.

Knowledge, skills, and abilities

  • Knowledge of construction paving, underground, concrete and grading practices.

  • Knowledge and understanding of union agreements and prevailing wage issues.

  • Maintain ability to work in high production environment.

  • Demonstrated decision-making skills.

  • Excellent leadership skills.

  • Excellent supervisory communication and organizational skills.

  • Accuracy at all times.

Physical Demands

The physical demands described here are representative of those that must be met by an employee to successfully perform the essential functions of this job. While performing the duties of this job, the employee is regularly required to talk and hear. The employee frequently is required to stand, walk, sit and use hands to operate a computer keyboard. The employee is occasionally required to reach with hands and arms. The employee must occasionally lift and/or move up to 50 pounds. Specific vision abilities required by this job include close vision, and ability to adjust focus. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions. Subject to outside working conditions. At times will be working around large construction equipment, must be safety conscience.


Additional Requirements/Skills

  • Ability to abide by Granite’s Code of Conduct on a daily basis.

  • A team player.

Our Benefits at a Glance:

Building tomorrow starts with you, and Granite knows that you can excel only if we support you in and out of the workplace. That is why we offer a broad benefits package that includes paid holidays, sick leave, medical, dental, vision, life insurance, disability insurance, flexible spending plans, as well as special programs for musculoskeletal health, mental wellness, and more.

Salaried employees may choose from two PPO medical plans through Anthem BlueCross, including our most popular plan, for which 100% of the premium is paid by Granite for eligible employees and dependents. Employees can also opt into a Health Savings Account (HSA) or a Flexible Spending Account (FSA).

As part of our investment in your future outside of the workplace, Granite provides a 100% match on the first 6% of eligible compensation that salaried employees defer into their 401(k) plans, which vests immediately.

Benefits may vary for positions located outside of the continental United States.

$146,948.00 - $220,424.00

title: Supply Chain Specialist II, Order Book Management, Toronto HQ
description:
Become a Part of the NIKE, Inc. Team

NIKE, Inc. does more than outfit the world's best athletes. It is a place to explore potential, obliterate boundaries and push out the edges of what can be. The company looks for people who can grow, think, dream and create. Its culture thrives by embracing diversity and rewarding imagination. The brand seeks achievers, leaders and visionaries. At Nike, it’s about each person bringing skills and passion to a challenging and constantly evolving game.

PLEASE NOTE:

This hybrid position is 4 days/week at our Downtown Toronto Head Office (Mondays to Thursdays) and Fridays (remote office) and is an individual contributor.

WHO ARE WE LOOKING FOR

We’re looking for a Supply Chain Specialist II for our Order Book Management team. This role provides service and support to our Marketplace Partners team while partnering with our Distribution center.

You will succeed by utilizing reporting and insights to drive timely delivery of all Nike products to support Nike profitability. You will communicate with, develop, and maintain positive relationships with internal cross functional partners through report interpretation, tools, phone and email. You will implement desk level orderbook tasks to deliver overall orderbook and business KPIs.

The candidate needs to have strong time management skills and critical thinking, ability to adapt/embrace change, be able to build rapport and business partnerships and have refined analytical skills.

WHAT WILL YOU WORK ON

This role will be responsible for executing end-to-end order book management, communicate effectively to relevant stakeholders, and will take initiative to identify risk and opportunities for Nike and our partners. You will respond to questions regarding order status and tracking information, working with internal partners to resolve moderately complex customer issues, such as pricing, delivery status, routing, rejections, holds. You will access, execute, and leverage standard and ad hoc reports to support execution to proactively track product delivery, order fill rates, validity, delivery, and returns activities.

Key Responsibilities

  • Collaborate across functions to maintain a shippable orderbook and drive timely resolution and escalation of order-related issues.
  • Monitor, analyze, and improve key performance indicators to maximize service levels and supply chain efficiency, including ship goals and related delivery metrics.
  • Influence internal and external stakeholder decisions by leveraging data analysis, KPIs, and performance targets.
  • Conduct orderbook audits and order writing workshops to improve partner order-writing behavior and enhance supply chain efficiency.
  • Provide visibility into delivery performance, risks, opportunities, and recommendations for internal stakeholders and partners.
  • Partner closely with commercial, planning, and external supply chain teams to support ship goals processes and delivery execution.
  • Provide peer mentorship and training to support team capability and consistency.
  • Manage the overall orderbook as well as launch and key initiatives.

WHO WILL YOU WORK WITH

You will report to Manager, Supply Chain Canada and will work closely with our broader cross functional team, including, Marketplace Partners, Planning and Distribution Centre.

WHAT YOU BRING

  • Strong ability to work cross-functionally and build effective partnerships across teams.
  • Demonstrated commitment to continuous process improvement and operational excellence.
  • High attention to detail and ability to manage multiple priorities effectively.
  • Excellent oral and written communication skills. Strong ability to communicate with people on different levels inside and outside of the organization.
  • Proficiency in systems and tools such as SAP, Excel and PowerPoint.
  • Solid understanding of supply chain processes and order management.
  • Strong problem-solving and critical-thinking skills.
  • Ability to analyze data and use insights to influence decisions and drive action.
  • High school diploma or equivalent and a minimum of 2 years relevant work experience
  • Excellent oral and written communication skills. Strong ability to communicate with people on different levels inside and outside of the organization.
  • Bilingual French, an asset

The annual base compensation for this position generally ranges from CAD $ 67.9K to 70K annually. Actual compensation will vary based on a candidate’s qualifications, skills, and experience.

No matter the location, or the role, every Nike employee shares one galvanizing mission: To bring inspiration and innovation to every athlete* in the world. Collins Aerospace is seeking a qualified algorithm Systems Engineer I to support the Joint Precision Approach and Landing System (JPALS) program.

This individual will be required to run and test modeling and simulation of algorithmic models using Simulink and MATLAB. The work is highly technical, and the individual must be comfortable with documenting equations, derivation, and generation of plots in MATLAB. The individual must be comfortable with data and statistical analysis. In addition to Model-based Development work, the role will also include lab-based contributions on the target products.

The successful candidate must be able to work on individual tasks under limited supervision, or with a team to achieve operational targets and must have the ability to communicate and collaborate with parties within and outside of own job function. Eventually the candidate may be responsible for helping to provide guidance, coaching and training to other employees within their job area.

What You Will do:

Test algorithms and models for the JPALS program
Develop the necessary tools to accomplish sufficient testing
Work on multiple tasks in a software development environment

description:
This is a Senior Lead Principal Engineer position responsible for establishing and implementing innovative technology solutions and programs in coordination with the Technology Team. The overall objective of this role is to lead complex engineering initiatives across various domains, including Business Intelligence (BI) tools, Big Data, Agentic AI, and Machine Learning. We are looking for a Senior Principal Engineer with extensive experience building robust, high-performance, and large-scale applications. We are constantly evolving our significant software assets and are seeking a leader who is passionate about leveraging diverse technologies to drive technical excellence and innovation.

Team Background

The Credit Risk Technology Team is responsible for delivering Counterparty Credit Risk Management software solutions. These tools allow sales, traders, operations staff and risk officers to manage Citi's exposure to financial institutions, governments and corporates that trade with Citi. The team builds and maintains software that provides a complete platform for their users: limit monitoring, exception management, stress testing analysis and escalation workflow capabilities are some key areas of focus.

  • Provide technical leadership and development oversight to the wider team of Software Engineers/Analysts. Ensure application design adheres to the appropriate architectural and design patterns for scalable and intelligent systems.
  • Develop key software components personally, and use your code as a teaching tool across the team for patterns and techniques, especially concerning Agentic AI design and implementation.
  • Host sessions for design and code review at multiple levels of the organization. Improve our engineering standards and process to make the team more capable and efficient, embracing AI-assisted development practices, including the use of tools like Git Copilot and Devin AI.
  • Collaborate effectively with a large global team of software engineers, business analysts, dev-ops and support staff to deliver software solutions for the business.
  • Lead the adoption of new technologies where appropriate to solve business problems while adhering to Citi's architectural guidelines, with a strong focus on Agentic AI and Machine Learning frameworks.
  • Serve as advisor or coach to mid-level/junior developers and analysts, helping build the overall engineering capabilities of the team, particularly in AI/ML and intelligent systems development.

Skills

Extensive experience working with most if not all the technologies listed below:

  • Java Core with extensive hands-on experience with concurrent programming.
  • Spring Framework including Core, Integration, Batch, JDBC, Hibernate.
  • Distributed Caching frameworks such as Oracle Coherence, Redis or equivalent.
  • Cloud computing technologies with practical experience working with containers, microservices and large datasets (Docker, Kubernetes).
  • Expertise in Big Data / Data Lake system architecture that supports enterprise data warehouse, real-time data processing, and large-scale data ingestion for AI/ML workloads.
  • Databases - RDBMS preferably Oracle, NoSQL preferably MongoDB.

Preferred:

Graduate in a STEM (Science, Technology, Engineering and Mathematics) discipline. Master's degree in Data Science or AI/ML an advantage.

description:

Position Overview

The Enterprise Asset Program Manager is responsible for implementing, operationalizing, and owning Autodesk's enterprise hardware asset management capability across PCs, Macs, mobile phones, and other end-user hardware. This role serves as the accountable owner for establishing accurate, governed asset data as the trusted system of record across the full lifecycle, from catalog and standards definition through governance, financial strategy, and cross-departmental asset architecture.

This is a hands-on role. The person in this seat will personally build and operate these processes, carrying forward and executing on recommendations from a recent external assessment of Autodesk's fulfillment, distribution, and ITAD practices, not simply direct others toward them. The role is structured as an individual contributor today; prior experience leading people or cross-functional programs is valued for how someone approaches ownership and accountability, even without direct reports in this seat.

This role owns asset management for a global population of approximately 21,500 employees and contingent workers, covering an estimated 60,000+ devices across computers, mobile phones, and loaner and spare inventory. The role oversees a significant, multi-million dollar annual hardware program and is accountable for continuing this function's demonstrated track record of cost discipline and savings.

Responsibilities

Asset Program Architecture and Governance

  • Define the program's strategy, roadmap, and operating model, including cross-functional roles and governance cadences with Finance, Procurement, and Security, moving the program from initial implementation into stable, ongoing operations

  • Establish and enforce a hardware governance framework, including a governance board, ensuring standards stay current against the market and defined personas

  • Own and mature the customization and exception governance process for requests outside standard catalog offerings

  • Work across departments that use end-user hardware in an advisory and architectural capacity, including managing global VAR vendor relationships

Catalog and Standards

  • Evaluate customization and upgrade requests on technical merit, distinguishing genuine need from preference

  • Build a compliance and security vetting process for new hardware models with the security team

  • Integrate asset management with discovery, endpoint management, identity, CMDB, procurement, and disposition systems, and align asset data with core ITSM processes

  • Drive automation of asset tracking and reconciliation workflows to reduce manual effort

Financial Strategy

  • Demonstrated experience operating at large enterprise scale (e.g., 50,000+ managed assets), including the systems, process rigor, and stakeholder complexity that scale requires

title: Utility Assistance Caseworker
company: Catholic Charities of the Diocese of Pittsburgh
description:
At Catholic Charities, Diocese of Pittsburgh, every client we see is our most important client.

We’re seeking a compassionate Caseworker to assist payment challenged customers and special needs customers obtain necessary social service support through the Duquesne Light Customer Assistance and Referral Evaluation Service Program (CARES).

With your education and experience in human services you know the importance of listening closely and working carefully to meet client needs and help them access the services they need. You’re in a key position, facilitating much-needed relief to members of a vulnerable population. You have a lot of fresh ideas to set people up for success and navigate life’s challenges. You also have a patient heart and enthusiasm to serve those who are struggling.


We offer successful candidates a competitive salary, strong health benefits (including medical, dental and vision that are available the first of the month following hire date) and generous time off programs that includes15 paid holidays a year. We also have a solid retirement plan that is fully funded by Catholic Charities along with other benefits such as Tuition Assistance and Paid Parental Leave.

.

We are proud to be designated as one of the Best Places to Work in Western Pennsylvania by the Pittsburgh Business Times for five consecutive years.

The CARES Caseworker will work a hybrid schedule that consists of making home visits to clients, attending informational "pop up" fairs, working from home, and at times working in the office.

Take a look at the Caseworker description below and let us know if you’re ready to bring healing and hope to the Pittsburgh region.

Caseworker Key Performance Objectives Include:

  • Meet with clients in their homes or other locations to conduct an assessment.
  • Represent and promote the Duquesne Light Customer Assistance Program at community “pop up” resource fairs and events.
  • Determine client eligibility for relevant services.
  • Provide internal and external referrals to social services for clients experiencing hardship.
