title: Supervisor, Financial Services Claims
description:
Are you a people leader who enjoys helping teams perform at their best while navigating change? In this role, you will lead a team of claims adjusters supporting embedded financial-service benefits for a large, highly visible client program. You will create clarity in a fast-moving environment, coach employees through challenges, and help the operation continue to grow and improve.

This is a strong opportunity for a leader who wants to make an impact beyond the daily workflow. You will balance customer needs, claim quality, service levels, employee development, and frequent technology and process enhancements. You will also have the support and visibility to contribute ideas, develop future leaders, and help build a best-in-class claims experience.

What makes us different?

  • Your work supports customers using valuable protections connected to their credit-card benefits, including travel and purchase-related coverage.

  • You will join a growing operation where leaders are encouraged to identify smarter ways of working and influence how the business evolves.

  • The team is investing in automation, AI-enabled capabilities, and new workflows while keeping sound decisions and the customer experience at the center.

  • You will have meaningful opportunities to coach talent, build internal career pathways, and strengthen the future leadership pipeline.

  • This is a remote U.S. opportunity with a collaborative leadership team and strong onboarding support.

What will be my duties and responsibilities in this job?

  • Lead and support a team of up to 15 claims adjusters, setting clear expectations and creating a positive, accountable, and collaborative team environment.

  • Oversee claims activities, including administration, adjudication, compliance, investigations, and sound claim settlements based on coverage.

  • Use productivity, quality, and service data to identify trends, understand performance barriers, and provide focused coaching and feedback.

  • Manage team workload and help employees meet established service levels in a high-volume claims environment.

  • Resolve non-routine claim escalations and serve as a subject matter resource for departmental processes, procedures, and training.

  • Help employees apply frequent system, product, and process changes through clear communication, refreshers, and ongoing support.

  • Conduct performance reviews, support employee development, resolve workplace conflicts, and foster engagement and continuous improvement.

  • Partner across departments, participate in client meetings and audit reviews as needed, and contribute to special projects and operational improvements.

What are the requirements needed for this position?

  • High school diploma or GED.

  • Adjuster license

  • Five or more years of related experience in the function or a similar external activity.

  • Two or more years of leadership experience and/or experience managing people.

  • Attention to detail, advanced investigative skills, and the ability to handle multiple claims efficiently.

  • Advanced communication and negotiation skills, with the ability to work effectively with a variety of people.

  • Excellent problem-solving and decision-making skills, including the ability to make decisions and influence others.

  • Demonstrated ability to provide coaching and feedback, build relationships, manage change, lead others through change, and empower diverse, winning teams.

What other skills/experience would be helpful to have?

  • Experience leading a team of approximately 12 to 15 employees in claims, insurance, warranty, financial services, benefits, or another regulated customer operation.

  • Experience leading remote or geographically distributed employees.

  • Experience using performance and quality data to identify root causes and create targeted coaching or training plans.

  • Experience helping teams adopt automation, AI-enabled workflows, queue-based work assignment, or frequent system releases.

  • Experience delivering training refreshers, process updates, calibrations, or change communications.

  • Experience developing high-potential employees and supporting succession or career-development planning.

What are the working conditions and physical requirements of this job?

General office demands. This position is remote within the United States, with onsite presence as needed. Business needs may occasionally require schedule flexibility to support major releases, troubleshooting, client needs, or implementation planning.

title: Digital S/W Eng Sr Analyst / SDET
description:
The Digital S/W Engineer Sr Analyst is a seasoned professional role. Applies in-depth disciplinary knowledge, contributing to the development of new techniques and the improvement of processes and work-flow for the area or function. Integrates subject matter and industry expertise within a defined area. Requires in-depth understanding of how areas collectively integrate within the sub-function as well as coordinate and contribute to the objectives of the function and overall business. Evaluates moderately complex and variable issues with substantial potential impact, where development of an approach/taking of an action involves weighing various alternatives and balancing potentially conflicting situations using multiple sources of information. Requires good analytical skills in order to filter, prioritize and validate potentially complex and dynamic material from multiple sources. Strong communication and diplomacy skills are required. Regularly assumes informal/formal leadership role within teams. Involved in coaching and training of new recruits Significant impact in terms of project size, geography, etc. by influencing decisions through advice, counsel and/or facilitating services to others in area of specialization. Work and performance of all teams in the area are directly affected by the performance of the individual.

  • Appropriately assess risk when business decisions are made, demonstrating particular consideration for the firm's reputation and safeguarding Citigroup, its clients and assets, by driving compliance with applicable laws, rules and regulations, adhering to Policy, applying sound ethical judgment regarding personal behavior, conduct and business practices, and escalating, managing and reporting control issues with transparency.

  • Strong analytical and quantitative skills; Data driven and results-oriented

  • Experience in affecting large culture change
  • Experience leading infrastructure programs
  • Skilled at working with third party service providers
  • Excellent written and oral communication skills

Education:

  • Bachelor’s/University degree or equivalent experience

title: Model/Anlys/Valid Officer
description:
Citibank, N.A. seeks a Model/Anlys/Valid Officer for its Tampa, FL location.

Duties: Conduct analysis across segmentation, threshold tuning, statistical modeling, and validation, focusing on creating quantitative algorithms for Anti-Money Laundering (AML) Compliance. title: Quality Assurance Analyst
description:
Position Summary

We are seeking a QA Analyst to support testing across multiple products and release cycles through a combination of AI-assisted, automated, and manual testing. This role will use AI tools and agentic workflows to enhance test design, automation development, results analysis, and documentation, while applying professional judgment to validate outputs and identify risks. The ideal candidate brings foundational automation and scripting skills, strong analytical abilities, and a collaborative approach to delivering reliable results within project timelines.

Key Responsibilities

  • Incorporate AI tools and agentic workflows into test design, data generation, automation development, results analysis, and documentation.
  • Evaluate AI-generated outputs, identify inaccuracies or coverage gaps, and perform additional validation when necessary.
  • Determine the appropriate combination of AI-assisted, automated, and manual testing based on risk, complexity, and release priorities.
  • Develop, execute, and maintain automated tests using Playwright, Selenium, or comparable frameworks.
  • Create and maintain automation scripts using JavaScript, TypeScript, Python, C#, or similar languages.
  • Document and communicate test outcomes, escalate quality concerns, and contribute to release-readiness decisions.
  • Collaborate with QA engineers, developers, business analysts, and other stakeholders to clarify requirements, resolve defects, and improve testing processes.
  • Support multiple products and releases while balancing testing coverage, efficiency, risk, and quality.

Required Qualifications

  • 1–3 years of software quality assurance experience, including manual and automated testing.
  • Experience with, or demonstrated aptitude for, using AI tools and agentic workflows in software testing.
  • Familiarity with Playwright, Selenium, or comparable test-automation frameworks.
  • Basic scripting or programming skills in JavaScript, TypeScript, Python, C#, or a similar language.
  • Strong analytical and investigative skills, with the ability to identify defects, coverage gaps, regression risks, and unreliable AI-generated outputs.
  • Ability to select appropriate testing methods based on product risk, requirements, and project priorities.
  • Effective communication and collaboration skills, including the ability to clarify requirements and raise quality concerns.
  • Ability to learn product and business processes, adapt to changing priorities, and contribute across multiple products and release cycles.

Salary range: $50,000 - $60,000 USD per year.

title: Strategic Sourcing Specialist
description:
Badger Meter - Where Every Drop Counts and So Do You

At Badger Meter, we're more than a leading global water technology company - we're innovators with a mission: to preserve and protect the world's most precious resource. For over 120 years, our trusted solutions have enabled our customers to optimize the delivery and use of water, maximize revenue and reduce waste.

Every employee at Badger Meter is an important part of our success. Here, your work doesn't just move a business forward - it shapes a more sustainable future. We are committed to building a workplace where we celebrate differences, empower voices, and encourage fresh ideas that drive innovation.

When you join us, you'll find:

  • Purpose-driven work that makes a real difference in communities around the globe.

  • Career growth and development opportunities designed to help you achieve your potential.

  • A supportive, inclusive culture where collaboration and creativity thrive.

Be part of something bigger. At Badger Meter, your contributions will ripple far beyond the workplace - creating lasting change for people and the planet.


What You Will Contribute:

The Strategic Sourcing Specialist is responsible for supporting the strategic and tactical initiatives within Badger Meter to support changing business needs. You will assist the Strategic Sourcing Manager with managing vendor relationships, new product development, project implementation, process efficiencies, implementing sourcing strategies, finding new suppliers, and evaluating current suppliers. This role may have direct buying responsibilities of commodities as the procurement department requires. The work performed in this role will support all Safety, Quality, On-time Delivery, Cost, and Continuous (SQDCC) improvement activities to achieve Badger Meter’s corporate goals.

Job Duties:

  • Drive proactive involvement in all functional activities related to sourcing (attending project meetings, working with appropriate individuals to understand new part requirements, etc).

  • Review and evaluate supply base by commodity to identify optimal sources for Badger Meter while consolidating to align with strong supply partners.

  • Evaluate and analyze supplier capabilities to determine best overall value and recommend suppliers for development of new or improvements to existing products to the project teams.

  • Perform on-site supplier evaluation visits to assist in the recommendation process.

  • Analyze and schedule material purchases utilizing Badger Meter’s ERP system and tools.

  • Set planning parameters and issue PO’s to support production requirements (optimizing the process to maintain short lead-times, low inventory, yet supplying required materials in a timely manner, etc).

  • Support Procurement Department in necessary metric reporting or any other required procedure in the department (supplier performance reports, supplier risk analysis reports, supplier capacity reviews, supplier quality certification status, on-time delivery reporting, ppm analysis, etc).

  • Up to 15% travel required.

Education and Experience:

  • 3+ years of experience in Supply Chain desired

Qualifications:

  • Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Word, Excel, Outlook, and PowerPoint required

  • Advanced Proficiency in LX preferred

  • Basic ability to read blueprints required

Competencies:

  • Collaboration: Work collaboratively with others across the organization to achieve shared objectives.

  • Communication: Convey information and ideas clearly and concisely to individuals or groups in an engaging manner that helps them understand and retain the message; listen actively to others.

  • Initiating Action: Take prompt action to accomplish work goals; take action to achieve results beyond what is required; be proactive.

  • Work Standards: Setting high standards of performance for self and others; assuming responsibility and accountability for successfully completing assignments or tasks; self-imposing standards of excellence rather than having standards imposed.

Working Conditions:

  • Work is performed in a Manufacturing/Office environment and requires the ability to operate standard office equipment.

In addition to the match, the company will also contribute 5% of your eligible compensation to your Defined Contribution account on an annual basis. Additional access to a certified financial planner to help ensure your money is working for you, at no cost!

  • Employer Paid benefits including: Employee Assistance Program (EAP), Basic Group Life Insurance, Short Term Disability, and more

  • Educational Assistance – Tuition Reimbursement up to $5,250

  • Voluntary benefits including: Additional Life Insurance, Long Term Disability, Accident and Critical Illness coverage

title: Laborant til Antibody & Probe Production
description:
Job Description

I produktionen hos Agilent Technologies spiller vi en vigtig rolle, da hospitaler og laboratorier verden over anvender vores testkits til kræftdiagnostik. Vi søger derfor en dygtig og engageret laborant eller bioanalytiker til vores produktion.

Du vil blive en del af afdelingen Cells & Probes i området Antibody & Probe production (AP). Afdelingen har ansvar for produktion af monoklonale antistoffer, DNA-prober og kontrolcellesnit til diagnostiske kits. Derudover udfører vi forskellige typer kontroltests, inden produkterne sendes videre til oprensning og afsluttende QC-test i andre dele af produktionen.

Afdelingen består af 10 laboranter og 6 akademikere og er kendetegnet ved et stærkt fagligt og socialt samarbejde. Vi arbejder efter GMP-regler, hvilket betyder, at dokumentation er en integreret del af hverdagen. En del af arbejdet omfatter derfor også administrative opgaver såsom udarbejdelse og vedligeholdelse af produktionsdokumentation samt håndtering af afvigelser i samarbejde med afdelingens support.

Vi arbejder løbende med optimering af produktionsprocesser, herunder automatisering og digitalisering, og har ansvar for at sikre, at vores produktionsudstyr lever op til gældende krav. Desuden medvirker afdelingen til overførsel af nye produkter og processer fra R&D til produktionen.

Samlet set er vi en afdeling med en varieret hverdag, hvor opgaverne spænder bredt, og hvor samarbejdet på tværs af organisationen er centralt.

Om jobbet:

Som laborant i Cells & Probes får du et fagligt udfordrende job, hvor du arbejder selvstændigt med blandt andet cellekulturering, DNA-oprensning og mærkning samt skæring af paraffinindstøbte cellelinjer.

Du vil være ansvarlig for batch-dokumentation og registrering af data i overensstemmelse med GMP/GDP og interne procedurer.

Derudover bidrager du til den løbende optimering af vores processer og er med til at sikre et godt samarbejde med kolleger og samarbejdspartnere på tværs af organisationen.

Qualifications

Din profil:

Du er uddannet laborant eller bioanalytiker.

Du har erfaring med én eller gerne flere af følgende metoder:

  • cellekulturering
  • DNA-oprensning, skæring og mærkning
  • skæring af vævssnit
  • testmetoder som ELISA, Cell counting, refraktometri, isotypebestemmelse, elektroforese, FISH eller andre mikroskopiske analyser

Det er en stor fordel, hvis du:

  • har erfaring med GMP og GDP fra en produktion eller laboratorie miljø
  • har erfaring med at arbejde under aseptiske forhold herunder LAF bænk
  • er vant til at arbejde under kvalitetskrav inden for Medical Devices
  • har kendskab til LEAN

Du har gode danskkundskaber, både skriftligt og mundtligt, samt grundlæggende engelskkundskaber

Som person forventes det at:

  • du tager ansvar og udviser personligt lederskab for dit arbejde.
  • du sætter en ære i at levere resultater (planlægge, gennemføre og afslutte opgaver til fastsatte deadlines) i den korrekte kvalitet efter foreskrevne anvisninger.
  • du er i stand til at arbejde både selvstændigt og i team og lægger vægt på det gode samarbejde.
  • du er energisk, har et synligt drive og fokuserer på kvalitet.
  • du har en positiv tilgang til arbejdsopgaverne og det at være en del af et fællesskab.

At UBC, we believe that attracting and sustaining a diverse workforce is key to the successful pursuit of excellence in research, innovation, and learning for all faculty, staff and students. Our commitment to employment equity helps achieve inclusion and fairness, brings rich diversity to UBC as a workplace, and creates the necessary conditions for a rewarding career.

JOB SUMMARY

This position performs a wide variety of media and public relations tasks designed to enhance the university's reputation by communicating activities, facilities, services, goals and objectives to audiences at the local, regional, provincial, national and international levels, as well as to faculty, staff and students. The position works proactively and through relationships: building trust with faculty, staff and students in order to surface stories at the source rather than waiting for them to be brought forward, and building trust with journalists, editors, producers, independent writers and digital creators to place those stories where audiences actually are. The role covers both established news outlets and emerging channels, including podcasts, independent newsletters, digital publications and creator led media, and it looks for opportunities to tell stories visually as well as in writing.


ORGANIZATIONAL STATUS

Reports to the Director, Public Affairs. This position works with independence and maintains close working relationships with deans, department heads, faculty and administrative unit communicators, researchers, staff and students across the UBC Okanagan campus, and with Media Relations colleagues on the UBC Vancouver campus.


WORK PERFORMED


Media relationships and outreach

  • Develops and sustains positive working relationships with journalists, editors, producers and assignment desks across print, broadcast and digital outlets
  • Develops relationships with independent journalists, newsletter writers, podcast hosts, documentary producers, digital publishers and subject matter creators whose audiences align with UBC Okanagan's areas of strength
  • Proactively pitches story ideas, tailoring the approach, format and supporting material to the norms of each outlet or channel
  • Responds to media inquiries, refers media to appropriate experts or other sources of information, and provides factual background information
  • Builds and maintains UBC Okanagan's experts list and media contact lists, including contacts in new and emerging media
  • Tracks how relevant outlets, formats and audiences are shifting, and adjusts outreach approaches accordingly
  • Plans, organizes and conducts news conferences, media availabilities, campus visits and other events as required in conjunction with senior university administrators, faculty and outside organizations, including various levels of government
  • Promotes UBC Okanagan research, people and events at local, provincial, national and international levels

Campus relationships and story development

  • Establishes and maintains ongoing relationships with deans, department heads, campus communicators, faculty, researchers, staff and students in order to proactively identify stories early and consistently
  • Meets regularly with faculties, research units and student groups to understand their work, build familiarity and proactively surface newsworthy activity rather than waiting for it to be submitted
  • Provides media coaching and preparation to faculty, staff and students, including guidance on interviews, podcast appearances and other long form or conversational formats
  • Provides factual background information and actively promotes story ideas across campus
  • Works with researchers proactively to identify the public interest in their work and shape it into stories suited to a general audience

Content in support of outreach

  • Researches and writes media releases, pitches, backgrounders, key messages and short form content in support of media and public relations activity
  • Identifies opportunities to tell stories visually, and works with creative services colleagues to develop video, photography and other visual assets that strengthen pitches and support coverage
  • Prepares supporting material appropriate to the channel, which may include audio, video, photography, other visual assets or written briefing material, developed in coordination with colleagues
  • Ensures material meets UBC brand standards and aligns with campus priorities and UBC Okanagan's strategic plan

Reporting and coordination

  • Coordinates with Media Relations in Vancouver to report on quarterly statistics and high impact stories for internal reporting
  • Monitors and reports on coverage across traditional and emerging channels, and contributes to the ongoing assessment of which approaches are reaching intended audiences
  • Participates in university committees and working groups, as required
  • Other duties, as required

CONSEQUENCE OF ERROR/JUDGEMENT

This position is expected to function with a high degree of autonomy and independence, working under broad guidelines. The consequence of error in this area could be very serious for the university as it concerns the public image and profile of the UBC Okanagan campus on a provincial, national and international level. Incorrect or insufficient information and advice subsequently passed on to senior administration could have grave consequences. The position must exercise tact, diplomacy and discretion when working with confidential or sensitive information. Judgment about which outlets, journalists and creators are credible and appropriate partners for the university is a significant element of the role.


SUPERVISION RECEIVED

Reports to the Director, Public Affairs and works under broad guidelines with minimal technical guidance.


SUPERVISION GIVEN

None. May provide direction to work-study students or co-op students assigned to specific projects.


QUALIFICATIONS

Minimum

  • Undergraduate degree in a relevant discipline. Minimum five years of related experience, or the equivalent combination of education and experience.
  • Willingness to respect diverse perspectives, including perspectives in conflict with one's own
  • Demonstrates a commitment to enhancing one's own awareness, knowledge, and skills related to equity, diversity, and inclusion

Preferred

  • Undergraduate degree in a relevant discipline (e.g., journalism, communications, public relations, English, marketing). Relevant graduate-level education will be considered an asset.
  • Demonstrated experience, in journalism, media relations or public relations, including demonstrated experience pitching and placing stories.
  • Experience at a post-secondary institution or large, multi-faceted organization considered an asset
  • Experience working with digital, independent or creator led media, such as podcasts, independent newsletters or digital first publications, considered an asset
  • Demonstrated experience with visual storytelling, including video, photography or short form vertical content, considered a significant asset
  • Demonstrated ability to work proactively, identifying and pursuing story opportunities rather than responding only to incoming requests
  • Demonstrated ability to build and sustain professional relationships across a range of internal and external audiences
  • Strong interviewing and listening skills, with the ability to draw out the substance of complex or technical work and identify its public interest
  • Demonstrated understanding of the principles and practices of media relations, communications, new media, public engagement and stakeholder relations
  • Ability to identify communications opportunities and select the most effective channel, format or tactic for a situation
  • Sound judgment in assessing the credibility and suitability of outlets, journalists and creators as partners for the university
  • Superior oral, interpersonal and presentation skills
  • Demonstrated ability to write clearly and quickly for a range of audiences and formats, with strong attention to spelling, grammar and accuracy
  • Advanced understanding of digital and social media platforms and content strategies, including visual and video first formats
  • Ability to determine the nature and urgency of inquiries and issues, and triage appropriately
  • Ability to work effectively under pressure to meet deadlines
  • Ability to work effectively independently and within a team environment
  • Ability to work effectively with various levels of senior administration and university personnel at both campuse.

title: Associate Product Manager – Agentic Modernization
description:
Who We Are

At Kyndryl, we design, build, manage and modernize the mission-critical technology systems that the world depends on every day. So why work at Kyndryl? We are always moving forward – always pushing ourselves to go further in our efforts to build a more equitable, inclusive world for our employees, our customers and our communities.

The Role

Kyndryl is looking for an Associate Product Manager to support the vision, strategy, roadmap, and lifecycle of Kyndryl's platform for Agentic Modernization — the platform that enables enterprises to modernize applications, processes, and operations through AI agents and agentic workflows. This role supports translating customer needs and business objectives into platform requirements for a secure, scalable, and enterprise-grade platform for building, deploying, governing, and operating AI agents at scale.

This is an entry-level to early-career role suited for someone building a career in product management. You will work closely with senior product managers, engineering, and delivery teams, taking ownership of well-defined features and backlog items while developing broader product management skills.

What You Will Do

  • Support the definition and execution of the product roadmap for Kyndryl's Agentic Modernization platform, under the guidance of senior product management.

  • Help identify platform capabilities that support the transformation of legacy business processes, applications, and workflows into AI-powered agentic experiences.

  • Gather and document requirements from customers, developers, consultants, architects, and delivery teams.

  • Coordinate with AI engineers, platform teams, UX designers, and modernization specialists on specific features and enhancements.

  • Maintain and groom assigned portions of the product backlog, and support release planning and feature prioritization.

  • Support adoption efforts by helping document and communicate platform capabilities for creating, deploying, monitoring, and governing AI agents.

  • Assist in tracking success metrics, including platform adoption, agent deployment activity, and customer feedback.

  • Help ensure security, governance, compliance, and responsible AI practices are followed throughout assigned work.

  • Assist in triaging and routing requests from extended teams (solution engineering, client and account teams, partners, etc.) to the appropriate owners on the platform team.

Kyndryl currently does not require employees to be fully vaccinated against COVID-19, however, if you are hired to work at a client, customer, or partner location, you may be required to show proof of vaccination to align with their respective COVID-19 vaccination policies. Those who believe they are eligible may apply for a medical or religious accommodation prior to the start of employment.

Who You Are

Why Kyndryl:

We’re a purpose-driven company committed to innovation and empowering our people. Here, your work contributes to meaningful outcomes for clients and communities.

Your Future at Kyndryl

Every position at Kyndryl offers a way forward to grow your career. We have opportunities that you won’t find anywhere else, including hands-on experience, learning opportunities, and the chance to certify in all four major platforms. Whether you want to broaden your knowledge base or narrow your scope and specialize in a specific sector, you can find your opportunity here.

You’re good at what you do and possess the required experience to provide it. However, equally as important – you have a growth mindset; keen to drive your own personal and professional development. You are customer-focused – someone who prioritizes customer success in your work. And finally, you’re open and borderless – naturally inclusive in how you work with others.

Kyndryl is committed to creating a diverse environment and is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, national origin, genetics, disability, age, or veteran status. Kyndryl is also committed to compliance with all fair employment practices regarding citizenship and immigration status.

Required Skills and Experience

  • 0–3 years of experience in product management, business analysis, technology consulting, or a related field.

  • Foundational understanding of software product development and agile delivery practices.

  • Strong analytical and organizational skills, with the ability to manage backlog items and documentation.

  • Good written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to work across technical and business stakeholders.

  • Interest in or exposure to AI, automation, or agentic technology concepts.

  • Ability to work collaboratively in a cross-functional, fast-paced environment.

  • Knows what cloud providers, LLM providers, Broadcom, NVIDIA, and others are doing in the AI space

  • Can identify differentiated, scalable features the market needs

  • Can demonstrate the platform to cloud and LLM providers, internal executives, and clients

  • Can gather feedback, build and manage the roadmap, and work closely with Engineering to ensure delivery

The Division of Neonatology within the Perinatal Institute at Cincinnati Children's is currently seeking full-time Faculty and Staff Physician candidates to provide in-patient clinical attending physician service at nursery locations supported by the Perinatal Institute in the Greater Cincinnati/Northern Kentucky/Dayton areas, including

  • The Cincinnati Children’s Level IV NICU
  • Five (5) Level III NICUs
  • Six (6) Level II NICUs, and
  • Eleven (11) Newborn Nurseries
  • Six (6) Outpatient NICU Follow-Up Clinic locations

The Division provides care for more than 29,000 patients / > 154,000 patient encounters annually. The team includes:

  • > 60 Faculty and Staff Neonatologists
  • > 10 Level II Special Care Hospitalists
  • > 15 Newborn Hospitalists
  • > 115 Advanced Practice Providers
  • A 3-year Neonatal-Perinatal Fellowship Program with 20 Fellows

The Perinatal Institute provides an exciting, innovative, collegial, and collaborative environment dedicated to favorably changing outcomes for newborns and their health. Our team of clinicians and researchers consists of scientists, neonatologists, immunologists, pulmonologists, biologists, neurologists, radiologists, informatics experts and data analysts. Together, we study a broad range of topics—from organ development to early prediction of neurodevelopmental disabilities in preterm infants to how environmental stimuli impact metabolism, growth and development in the NICU and beyond to neonatal health inequities and ways of increasing access to care. Our diverse backgrounds and skill sets give us a comprehensive understanding of varied topics with a singular focus: to improve care for all newborns.

As national leaders in neonatal care, researchers in the Division of Neonatology at Cincinnati Children’s have been pioneering advancements in care for newborns for decades. By coordinating efforts and fostering these multidisciplinary collaborations, we continue to advance our knowledge and develop groundbreaking therapies to help infants thrive.

Clinical exposure is rich and stimulating, ensuring development of strong bedside clinical acumen. Our positions include opportunities for mentorship and teaching of medical students, residents and training fellows, nursing, and allied health care professionals as well as participation in NICU- and newborn-focused quality improvement and research projects. Work Schedules will include day and night shifts in addition to weekend and holiday rotations.

Interested in Learning More? Are you interested in becoming part of the Cincinnati Children's Team?

Contact: Amy Nathan, MD

Level II Special Care Nursery Fellowship Training Program

The Perinatal Institute at Cincinnati Children's is currently seeking Pediatricians to join our Level II Special Care Nursery Fellowship Training Program to focus on learning the skills necessary to independently practice in a Level II Special Care Nursery. Many pediatricians complete their pediatric residency program with as little as two months of Neonatal Intensive Care Unit (NICU) experience. With limited NICU experience during their pediatric residency, many graduates are not prepared to independently practice in a Level II Special Care Nursery upon graduation and often require further training.

We recognized this training gap and in response created our 9-18 month Level II Special Care Nursery Fellowship Program. This non-ACGME accredited fellowship program is administered through the GME office at Cincinnati Children’s Hospital.

The goal of the program is to ensure that all fellows graduate with the education, skills, and experience needed to independently practice in a Level II Special Care Nursery. This includes both the management of a wide breadth of neonatal diseases and physiology present in moderately preterm and term infants after birth as well as the initial resuscitation and stabilization of an extremely preterm or critically ill infant prior to transport to a higher level of care. On a monthly basis, trainees spend one week in each of the following clinical areas: Level I Nursery rotations, Level II Special Care Nursery rotations, Level III NICU rotations, and supplemental learning.

Trainees are hired and compensated as Staff Physicians – Level 1 Newborn Physician. Upon successful completion of this program, trainees transition to the Staff Physician – Level 2 Special Care Nursery Physician role and compensation structure.

title: Outpatient Certified Coder (Remote)
description:
At Memorial Hermann, we pursue a common goal of delivering high quality, efficient care while creating exceptional experiences for every member of our community. When we say every member of our community, that includes our employees. We know that when our employees feel cared for, heard and valued, they are inspired to create moments that exceed expectations, while prioritizing safety, compassion, personalization and efficiency. If you want to advance your career and contribute to our vision of creating healthier communities, now and for generations to come, we want you to be a part of our team.

Job Summary

**If you are located outside of the state of Texas -- you must be located in KANSAS, OKLAHOMA, TENNESSEE, LOUISIANA, GEORGIA, SOUTH CAROLINA, NORTH CAROLINA, or be willing to relocate to one of the eligible states (including Texas). **

Accounts are for Outpatient single and recurring accounts. No CPT coding. Will only code the ancillary/recurring accounts. They would not need experience in any of the other areas mentioned. Preferred experience in medical necessity edits.

Responsible for primary diagnosis and procedural coding for designated ambulatory and hospital outpatient setting. Responsible for proficiently assigning proper and accurate medical codes for diagnosis, procedures, and services performed in an outpatient setting, such as, but not limited to emergency department, outpatient clinics, same day surgeries, or diagnostic testing (radiology and laboratory). Typically reports to the Coding Manager.

Job Description

Minimum Qualifications

Education: High School Diploma or GED required; Associates degree in Health Information Management or any Healthcare Related Field preferred

Licenses/Certifications: Registered Health Information Technician (RHIT), Registered Health Information Administrator (RHIA), or relevant Coding certification(s) from American Health Information Management Association (AHIMA) or American Association of Professional Coders (AAPC) required.

Experience / Knowledge / Skills:

  • Surgery/Observation - Three (3) years of hospital or ambulatory coding experience required.

  • Emergency Department - Two (2) years of hospital or ambulatory coding experience required.

  • Interventional Radiology - Two (2) years of hospital or ambulatory coding experience required.

  • Ancillary/Recurring - One (1) year of hospital or ambulatory coding experience preferred.

  • Experience coding in a level 1 trauma facility/academic teaching facility preferred.

  • Effective oral and written communication skills.

  • Strong knowledge of ICD-10-CM and/or CPT.

  • Analytical skills necessary to interpret data contained in the health records and to assign appropriate codes.

  • Proficient knowledge of human anatomy, physiology, medical terminology and surgical terminology.

  • Critical thinking, good judgment and decision-making skills.

  • Knowledge of coding compliance policies, official coding guidelines, regulatory requirements and internal policies and procedures affecting the coding process.

  • Proficient in navigating a Windows-based application environment.

Principal Accountabilities

  • Reviews medical record documentation to identify pertinent diagnosis/procedures that require code assignment for outpatient records and accurately code the diagnoses and procedures using ICD-10-CM coding conventions for the purpose of reimbursement, research, and compliance with federal regulations.

  • Reviews the medical record to assure specificity of diagnoses, procedures, and appropriate reimbursement for hospital and professional charges.

  • Queries physicians when code assignments are not straightforward or documentation in the record is inadequate, ambiguous, or unclear for coding purposes.

  • Keeps abreast of coding guidelines and reimbursement reporting guidelines and brings identified concerns to manager for resolution.

  • Effectively assigns ICD-10-CM, modifiers, and HCPCS codes to outpatient records.

  • Responsible in maintaining 95% or greater ICD-10-CM and/or HCPCS coding and consistently meet established productivity standards while keeping abstracting errors to a minimum.

  • Abides by the Standards of Ethical Coding as set forth by the American Health Information Management Association (AHIMA) and adheres to official coding guidelines.

  • Ensures safe care to patients, staff and visitors; adheres to all Memorial Hermann policies, procedures, and standards within budgetary specifications including time management, supply management, productivity and quality of service.

  • Promotes individual professional growth and development by meeting requirements for mandatory/continuing education and skills competency; supports department-based goals which contribute to the success of the organization; serves as preceptor, mentor and resource to less experienced staff.

  • Demonstrates commitment to caring for every member of our community by creating compassionate and personalized experiences. Models Memorial Hermann’s service standards by providing safe, caring, personalized and efficient experiences to patients and colleagues.

  • Other duties as assigned.

In addition to your own contributions, you will mentor and guide a talented team of engineers, ensuring technical excellence and fostering growth. You will closely collaborate with cross-functional partners—including product management, firmware, QA, and design—to deliver robust, scalable solutions and explore new technologies.

  • Architect and Drive Technical Solutions
    • Spearhead the end-to-end design and development of next-generation software for Logitech’s Desktop Experience peripherals using modern C++.

  • Project and Team Leadership
    • Lead engineering initiatives for developing and enhancing Logitech’s input peripherals, such as mice, keyboards, presenters, and webcams.

  • Feature Delivery and Operational Excellence
    • Oversee and direct the design, build, implementation, and maintenance of new features, ensuring robust backend logic and seamless integration with front-end services.

  • Cross-Functional Collaboration

    • Effective Software-Firmware interface design discussion and conclusion.
    • Facilitate productive discussions and reach consensus on the design of the software-firmware interface, ensuring an effective and robust integration.
    • Anticipate and resolve complex design and development issues, leveraging input from diverse stakeholders to accelerate feature delivery.
  • Technical Governance
    • Chair technical reviews of system design and interface requirements, providing actionable feedback and ensuring all deliverables meet architectural and business standards.
    • Take the lead in setting and upholding standards for reusable code and shared libraries, promoting best practices for scalability and maintainability.
  • Agile Champion
    • Guide scrum processes, promoting team health and high productivity, and actively unblock team challenges to maintain continuous progress.
    • Foster an environment of innovation, where new ideas are translated quickly into prototypes and production-quality features.
  • Specialization and Domain Depth
    • Provide deep domain expertise in developing commercial software that interacts with hardware devices, especially on MacOS.
    • Encourage and oversee the adoption of new technology solutions and emerging patterns relevant to hardware-software integration, such as advanced device communication and firmware update strategies.

Required Skill Sets

  • Extensive Experience
    • 8+ years of progressive software development, including recent experience in a technical leadership, architectural, or team lead capacity
    • Proven expertise designing and developing desktop applications for Mac and Windows platforms
  • Advanced Programming Skills
    • Expert-level C/C++ and object-oriented programming, with strong command of C++14/17 and experience mentoring others on advanced language features
    • Significant experience applying software design patterns, architectural principles, and coding best practices to large-scale projects
  • Quality & Testing Leadership
    • Deep expertise in unit testing methodologies, enforcing robust test coverage, and driving quality initiatives across multiple projects
    • Exceptional debugging and performance optimization skills, leading efforts to resolve complex technical challenges
  • Hardware & Integration Proficiency
    • Demonstrable commercial experience developing software that interacts with hardware devices, with special focus on Human Interface Device (HID) protocols and MacOS compatibility
    • Hands-on experience in architecting and managing firmware update processes; able to define and oversee reliable integration strategies
  • Communication & Stakeholder Leadership
    • Strong written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to distill complex ideas for both technical and non-technical audiences
    • Experience fostering collaboration among teams, leading technical reviews, and providing actionable feedback
  • Team and Process Leadership
    • Proven ability to guide team members, delegate responsibilities effectively, and establish practices that promote shared code ownership and continuous improvement

Education:


  • B.E. in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a closely related technical field; higher education (M.E./M.Tech/MS) is a plus.
  • Equivalent industry experience with demonstrated technical leadership will also be considered.
  • Professional certifications and evidence of ongoing learning (e.g., advanced C++ courses, architecture workshops, leadership training) are highly desirable.

title: Economic Inclusion Program Quality and Technical Partnerships Specialist (PQTP) India
description:
Location: Kolkata,West Bengal,India

Title: Economic Inclusion Program Quality and Technical Partnerships (PQTP) Specialist - India

Location: Kolkata, India (open to other India-based locations; must have work authorization)

Duration: Initial contract will be for a period of 12 months, with possibility of extension.

Salary and benefits: The salary for this position, inclusive of benefits, is approximately US$25,000 per year, depending upon qualification and experience.
Travel: Up to 40–50% (domestic and international). Travel expenses are covered, as per Trickle Up's travel policies.

Overview

The PQTP Specialist strengthens economic inclusion quality, innovation, learning, knowledge management (KM), and technical excellence across Trickle Up, with a focus on the India and the Asia region. The role is embedded within regional and global teams, and contributes practical tools, methodologies, learning products, technical leadership, and program quality systems, to ensure that programs are aligned with global standards, while being responsive to local contexts.

Key Responsibilities

  • Develop and adapt economic inclusion tools, frameworks, methodologies, technical guidance, knowledge products, and training materials for India and Asia.
  • Systematize Trickle Up’s economic inclusion efforts and quality standards at the regional level, including leading the regional project quality review mechanism (PQRM) and learning process.
  • Contextualize global resources and translate learning into regionally relevant approaches.
  • Design and facilitate capacity strengthening and peer-learning processes.
  • Pilot, refine, and document innovative approaches that strengthen program quality.
  • Serve as Technical Lead or Subject Matter Expert (SME) for proposal and program design efforts.
  • Contribute technical expertise to theories of change (ToC), learning agendas, and measurement frameworks in collaboration with Business Development (BD) and Monitoring, Evaluation, Research, and Learning (MERL) staff.
  • Manage or contribute to a limited number of HQ-led or globally funded technical partnerships initiatives.
  • Participate in EI Working Groups and cross-regional collaboration, driving alignment and two-way knowledge flow.
  • Document, curate, and disseminate regional and global knowledge assets.

Key Deliverables

  • Contributions to regional and global KM activities – Monthly.
  • Capacity-building exchanges with regional staff – Quarterly.
  • Facilitation of PQRM processes – Quarterly.
  • Technical Lead for at least four proposals – by August 2027.
  • Co-design ToCs and MERL frameworks for all new projects - by August 2027.
  • Provide ongoing technical support to EI projects, such as BRAC‑CGSRLM (Chhattisgarh), BRAC ILE (Maharashtra/Tamil Nadu/Telangana), PVTG (Jharkhand), MPOWERED Scale-Up Plus (Jharkhand/Odisha), and others as they come up – through August 2027.
  • Support rollout of global program quality and technical partnership strategies across all regional projects – through August 2027.
  • Technical tools, frameworks guidance notes, curricula, and standard operating procedures developed or adapted for regional use – by August 2027.

Qualifications

Minimum 8 years of experience in technical assistance, capacity building, or strategic consulting, with technical expertise in economic inclusion, livelihoods, or graduation programming, and experience in program design and management in international development settings. Experience working with governments, donors, implementing organizations, training and facilitation, and proposal development required. Preference for expertise in one or more cross-cutting area: gender transformative programming, climate resilience, local systems strengthening, and/or digital agency.

Fluency in English and Hindi (written and verbal), required, and a willingness to travel up to 40–50%. Position priorities excellent communication and stakeholder management skills, ability to manage multiple priorities in fast-paced environments, analytical and solution-oriented problem-solving, and excellence engaging in cross-cultural environments.

Reporting & Coordination

  • Reports to the Senior Advisor, Program Quality & Technical Partnerships (global EI team), with a dotted-line to the Chief Executive Officer, Trickle Up India Foundation and Regional Director, Trickle Up Program.
  • Works in close collaboration with regional teams, MERL, business development, and implementing partners.
  • Participates in EI Team and Working Group coordination and knowledge-sharing processes.

Commitment to Diversity, Equity & Inclusion

Trickle Up is committed to diversity, equity, and inclusion. We strongly encourage applications from individuals of all backgrounds—particularly those with lived experience of poverty or marginalization.

Applications will be reviewed on a rolling basis until filled.

title: AI Platform Engineer
description:
Who We Are

For our people—Kyndryls—that means doing purposeful work that powers human progress. Join us and experience a flexible, supportive environment where your well-being is prioritized and your potential can thrive.


The Role

AI/ML Engineer – Azure Platform Modernization

As part of a large-scale platform modernization journey, the organization is strengthening its AI and Machine Learning capabilities to deliver intelligent, secure, and scalable digital solutions on Microsoft Azure. This transformation focuses on embedding enterprise-grade AI capabilities within the platform engineering landscape—enabling automation, improving data security, and accelerating outcomes through responsible AI adoption.

To support this initiative, we are seeking an experienced AI/ML Engineer. This role will be pivotal in designing, building, and operationalizing a central AI Platform and its supporting capabilities, including AI SDK development, data masking, PII detection, and document intelligence. The engineer will integrate Azure AI services with modern DevOps practices to ensure performance, reliability, and compliance with enterprise governance standards.

Responsibilities

The AI/ML Engineer will be responsible for:

  • Designing and assessing serverless compute architectures for AI workloads.
  • Implementing scalable Azure Databricks Serverless environments.
  • Developing and maintaining CI/CD pipelines in Azure DevOps for AI and Databricks workloads.
  • Ensuring reliability, observability, monitoring, and optimization of Databricks and serverless services.
  • Collaborating closely with Data Science, Cloud Engineering, and DevOps teams as an independent expert—providing consultancy, technical alignment, and best practices for operationalizing AI models efficiently.

Required Experience & Skills

  • Deep understanding of Azure Databricks architecture, including serverless compute capabilities.
  • Hands-on experience with serverless technologies such as Azure Functions, Event Grid, and Logic Apps.
  • Proficiency in Python, PySpark, and SQL for data engineering and model integration.
  • Strong knowledge of CI/CD, MLOps, and Infrastructure-as-Code using Azure DevOps and Terraform.
  • Solid understanding of cloud cost management, scaling strategies, and workload optimization.
  • Familiarity with enterprise security, data protection, and compliance requirements for AI workloads.
  • Ability to design and implement observability, monitoring, and alerting for Databricks Serverless environments.
  • Integrated Mistral AI large language models (LLMs) into a corporate fintech environment

The “Kyn” in Kyndryl means kinship, which represents the strong bonds we have with each other, our customers and our communities. That sense of belonging — being a valued, respected, trusted member of the team — is fundamental to our culture and fueling great experiences for our customers. title: Global Procurement Performance & Value Delivery Manager
description:
Entity:

Technology


Job Family Group:

Procurement & Supply Chain Management Group


Job Description:

Role Synopsis

The Global Procurement Performance & Value Delivery Manager is responsible for establishing and maintaining a single, globally consistent view of procurement value delivery, spend performance and financial outcomes across ASPAC/ANZ, Europe and the Americas. The role provides clear, accurate and timely reporting that reflects the procurement value delivery framework being reported in Compass and is aligned to Finance standards and governance. Serving as the trusted bridge between Procurement and Finance, the role translates procurement activities into measurable, auditable and finance-aligned business outcomes for senior leadership decision-making.

Category, Sourcing and initiative owners remain accountable for finding opportunities, developing the underlying value case and delivering agreed outcomes. This role is accountable for value governance, methodological consistency, independent validation, consolidated reporting and monitoring of benefits realisation.

Key Accountabilities

Global performance reporting and insights

  • Own the global procurement performance reporting framework across ASPAC/ANZ, Europe and the Americas.

  • Deliver accurate, timely and consistent reporting of procurement value delivery, spend performance, sourcing activity and key operational metrics.

  • Provide executive-level reporting and insight packs for Procurement Leadership, Finance and business collaborators.

  • Develop clear performance narratives that explain key trends, risks, opportunities and required actions.

  • Ensure alignment between Compass reporting, regional dashboards and enterprise financial reporting outputs.

Value delivery governance and measurement

  • Ensure alignment against the PVF for value measurement, savings validation, cost avoidance treatment, benefit attribution and reporting consistency.

  • Validate savings, cost avoidance and value-realisation claims to ensure they are credible, defensible and consistently applied across regions.

  • Drive adoption of common reporting standards, critical metric definitions and value governance processes globally.

  • Ensure reported procurement benefits are transparent, auditable and aligned with Finance governance requirements.

Finance alignment and business partnering

  • Supporting regional procurement leadership, partner where required, with Finance, FP&A and business leadership teams to reconcile procurement value delivery with financial outcomes.

  • Partner with Category, Sourcing, Finance and business collaborators to validate and appropriately classify the financial impact of sourcing initiatives and procurement activities across P&L, cash flow, Capex and Opex, in accordance with approved Finance methodologies and governance requirements.

  • Support forecasting, budgeting and business planning cycles through robust procurement performance insight. Identify, investigate and report material variances between forecast, contracted, reported and realised benefits, ensuring that corrective actions, risks and changes in assumptions are clearly documented and communicated.

  • Challenge assumptions, methodologies and benefit calculations to ensure accurate attribution of value.

Global spend analytics and performance insight

  • Maintain global visibility of supplier spend, business spend and procurement performance across regions and business units.

  • Conduct advanced spend analytics, trend analysis, variance analysis and performance modelling to identify insights and opportunities.

  • Identify root causes of performance variance and recommend corrective actions or areas for further intervention.

  • Generate actionable insight across supplier spend, business spend, savings, value delivery, risk and operational metrics.

  • Support category, regional and transformation teams with insight that links procurement activity to business value.

Reporting governance, data quality and process standardisation

  • Act as custodian of procurement performance, spend and value reporting data.

  • Drive improvements in data quality, integrity, transparency and consistency across reporting processes.

  • Maintain reporting controls that increase confidence in management information and support auditability.

  • Create and embed standardised reporting processes so regions work from one trusted version of performance data.

  • Act as Procurement’s primary point of contact for internal and external audits relating to procurement value delivery, savings reporting, spend performance and benefits realisation, coordinating responses with Category, Sourcing, Finance and business partners as required.

Digital enablement and automation

  • Lead continuous improvement of procurement reporting, analytics and visualisation capability.

  • Leverage digital tools, automation and analytics platforms to streamline reporting, reduce manual effort and improve accuracy.

  • Enable intuitive dashboards, self-service reporting and senior-leadership views where appropriate.

  • Partner with central Procurement teams across the subject of Digital, Data and Technology to enhance reporting infrastructure and analytics capability.

  • Apply AI-enabled analytics and automation where they strengthen data quality, insight generation or reporting efficiency.

Stakeholder engagement and governance forums

  • Engage regional procurement teams, global category teams, Finance, Transformation, Digital and business partners in a highly matrixed global environment.

  • Lead or support governance forums focused on value delivery, performance management, reporting quality and benefit validation.

  • Build trusted relationships across regions to drive adoption of common standards and consistent ways of working.

Essential Education

  • Undergraduate degree in Finance, Business, Procurement, Commerce, Economics, Data Analytics or a related subject area; equivalent experience will also be considered.

  • Professional qualification or demonstrated capability in Finance, Procurement, Commercial Analytics, Business Intelligence or Performance Management is beneficial.

Essential Experience and Job Requirements

  • 10+ years experience in Finance, FP&A, Procurement Performance, Commercial Analytics, Business Intelligence, Procurement Excellence or a related field.

  • Demonstrated experience supporting global or multinational organisations and operating across multiple regions, cultures and time zones.

  • Experience managing enterprise reporting frameworks, performance governance and executive reporting cadences.

  • Strong understanding of procurement value-realisation methodologies, savings validation, cost avoidance and benefit tracking.

  • Strong understanding of Source-to-Contract, category management, supplier spend, business spend and procurement operating models.

  • Proven ability to work with Finance collaborators to align procurement performance reporting with financial reporting requirements and planning cycles.

  • Experience managing large, complex data sets and converting them into actionable senior-leadership insight.

  • Strong communication skills with the ability to translate complex financial, commercial and operational data into clear performance narratives.

  • Ability to influence across senior partners and drive consistency in a highly matrixed, global environment.

  • High attention to detail, strong judgement, resilience and the ability to work effectively with ambiguity and competing priorities.

Critical Skills and Capabilities

Financial and commercial competence

  • Strong understanding of P&L, cash flow, Capex and Opex impacts; able to translate procurement activity into measurable financial outcomes and align value delivery reporting with Finance governance.

Global spend and data analytics

  • Advanced analytical capability across supplier spend, business spend, savings, value delivery, risk metrics, data modelling, trend analysis and root-cause diagnosis.

Value delivery governance

  • Expertise in developing and maintaining robust value realisation frameworks, measurement standards, validation processes and benefit attribution methodologies.

Finance business partnering

  • Proven ability to partner with Finance leadership, FP&A and business partners to reconcile procurement performance with financial reporting and planning cycles.

Executive reporting and storytelling

  • Ability to distil complex data into concise executive insight, performance narratives, risks, opportunities and management actions.

Global stakeholder management

  • Excellent partner engagement and influencing skills with demonstrated experience operating in a global, highly matrixed environment.

Data governance and standardisation

  • Experience establishing reporting governance, critical metric standards, data definitions and data-management processes that improve transparency and confidence.

Digital and automation capability

  • Experience demonstrating Power BI, Power Automate, AI-enabled analytics, dashboards and automation to streamline reporting and enhance business insight generation.

Technical Skills

  • Advanced Power BI and Excel capability, including data modelling, dashboard design and executive reporting outputs.
  • Experience with SAP, Ariba, Compass, Tableau or comparable enterprise reporting, procurement and data visualisation platforms.
  • Strong capability in data quality management, benchmark design, automation and self-service reporting enablement.
  • Digital fluency with ability to apply automation and AI-enabled analytics responsibly to improve reporting efficiency, insight quality and consistency.

Desirable Criteria

  • Experience in a global procurement, finance transformation, procurement excellence or centre-of-excellence environment.
  • Membership of, or working towards, a recognised procurement, finance, accounting, analytics or project management qualification.
  • Experience in designing or implementing procurement value management, benefits tracking or enterprise performance reporting frameworks.
  • Familiarity with audit, controls, assurance or governance requirements relating to management information and performance reporting.
  • Experience working cross-culturally and influencing across different levels of the organisation.

title: UX Design Associate
description:
Who We Are

At Kyndryl, we design, build, manage and modernize the mission-critical technology systems that the world depends on every day. So why work at Kyndryl? We are always moving forward – always pushing ourselves to go further in our efforts to build a more equitable, inclusive world for our employees, our customers and our communities.

The Role

Your role
As an AI UX Designer at Kyndryl, you will lead the design activities that connect insight, imagination, and execution for the next era of computing. You aren’t just building interfaces; you are defining the mental models and interaction patterns that allow humans to collaborate seamlessly with autonomous agents.

Join Kyndryl and gain the trust, autonomy and teamwork to help define what comes next for us, our customers and global industries as a whole.

What you will do
Humanize Complex Intelligence
•Architect intentional journeys: You’ll lead user research to uncover pain points in the human-AI relationship, creating journey maps that turn the complexity of multi-step agentic reasoning into clarity for the end user.
•Design for non-deterministic UI: You will move beyond static wireframes to create dynamic interaction patterns that handle AI latency, ambiguity, and error states gracefully, ensuring users always feel in control of the autonomous process.

Choreograph the Collaborative Loop
•Facilitate co-creation: Lead workshops and usability tests to balance desirability with feasibility, working closely with creative technologists and AI engineers to ensure the intelligence of the system matches the intuition of the user.
•Master Human-in-the-Loop (HITL): Design the critical hand-off moments where an agent needs human validation, ensuring that transparency and trust are built into every automated workflow.

Advocate for Inclusive Evolution
•Champion ethical design: Advocate for accessibility and inclusive intelligence, ensuring that our AI experiences are equitable and work for all users across diverse backgrounds.
•Shape the interface era: Maintain a strong perspective on how agentic AI drives human-centered design, using clear storytelling to inspire alignment across the full design lifecycle—from discovery to delivery.

Kyndryl currently does not require employees to be fully vaccinated against COVID-19, however, if you are hired to work at a client, customer, or partner location, you may be required to show proof of vaccination to align with their respective COVID-19 vaccination policies. Those who believe they are eligible may apply for a medical or religious accommodation prior to the start of employment.

Who You Are

Required skills and experience

•UX / experience design or a related field, with a strong portfolio of enterprise or innovation-studio projects
•Deep understanding of user-centered design, interaction design, and usability testing methods
•Comfortable facilitating co-creation sessions and presenting to clients
•Direct experience with AI, agentic AI/UX and data-driven design is preferred
•A POV on how AI can drive human-centered design and co-creation
•Experience with emerging AI assistants (Figma Make, MiroAI, Adobe Firefly, Lovable, etc)
•Fluent in Figma or Sketch, or similar prototyping tools
•Experience working with developers / product managers to translate research into delivery
•Excellent communication skills in English

$63,360 to $114,120 based on a full-time schedule.

Note: If this is a sales commission eligible role, you will be eligible to participate in a sales commission plan in lieu of the annual discretionary bonus program.
Applications will be accepted on a rolling basis.

Being You

Diversity is a whole lot more than what we look like or where we come from, it’s how we think and who we are. We welcome people of all cultures, backgrounds, and experiences. But we’re not doing it single-handily: Our Kyndryl Inclusion Networks are only one of many ways we create a workplace where all Kyndryls can find and provide support and advice. This dedication to welcoming everyone into our company means that Kyndryl gives you – and everyone next to you – the ability to bring your whole self to work, individually and collectively, and support the activation of our equitable culture. That’s the Kyndryl Way.

What You Can Expect

With state-of-the-art resources and Fortune 100 clients, every day is an opportunity to innovate, build new capabilities, new relationships, new processes, and new value. Kyndryl cares about your well-being and prides itself on offering benefits that give you choice, reflect the diversity of our employees and support you and your family through the moments that matter – wherever you are in your life journey. Our employee learning programs give you access to the best learning in the industry to receive certifications, including Microsoft, Google, Amazon, Skillsoft, and many more. Through our company-wide volunteering and giving platform, you can donate, start fundraisers, volunteer, and search over 2 million non-profit organizations. At Kyndryl, we invest heavily in you, we want you to succeed so that together, we will all succeed.

Job Description

About the AI Accelerator

The AI Accelerator drives AI innovation across Cox Automotive. The team builds proof-of-concept agents, ships reusable AI components, sets evaluation and governance standards, and partners with product teams to bring AI into production.

About the Role

Cox Automotive is hiring a Machine Learning Engineer II to own and build the GenAI Evaluation Framework (GEF), the shared capability that measures whether AI agents running in production meet quality standards. This is a builder-owner role. You own GEF as an internal product, which means you set the roadmap, decide what ships and what gets retired, and sequence which teams onboard. You also write the evaluators, pipelines, and reference implementations yourself.

The framework already exists and has been proved in one production implementation with the Virtual Contact Assistant. The current work is turning that implementation into a product other teams adopt on its merits, since adoption across business units is voluntary. You will have the direct support of the Director of Machine Learning and AI on prioritization and executive alignment, and full latitude on the technical and product decisions inside GEF.

What You Will Own

  • GEF product roadmap. Shared accountability with AI leaders of what ships next, what to generalize from the first production implementation, and what to deprecate. You help to maintain the roadmap and the reasoning behind it.
  • Enablement queue. You sequence which product teams onboard, when, and against what success criteria, and you negotiate that sequence with the teams involved.
  • Framework build. You implement and maintain LLM-as-judge, rule-based, and statistical evaluators, and calibrate them against human-labeled baselines.
  • Evaluation pipelines. You build and operate the pipelines that score agent traffic on a schedule and publish results to dashboards and the Cox Agent Registry.
  • Golden datasets. You work with product teams and subject matter experts to assemble, version, and maintain the datasets evaluation depends on.
  • Onboarding and adoption. You integrate GEF into adopting teams' agents, debug failures, and write the documentation and reference implementations that let the next team self-serve.
  • Quality reporting. You publish framework adoption, agent quality health, and cost-per-quality metrics each month, and supply the audit trails and evaluation evidence governance reviews require.
  • Agent instrumentation. You help add tracing and logging to agent workflows and integrate evaluation checks into CI and deployment pipelines.

What Success Looks Like in Year One

  • Three to four product teams onboarded to GEF, with golden datasets curated and evaluators calibrated against human baselines.
  • A published GEF roadmap that adopting teams and leadership both plan against.
  • Framework capability a new team can adopt from documentation and reference implementations without direct support.
  • Quality health published per registered agent in the Cox Agent Registry, on a monthly cadence, without manual assembly.
  • Pipelines that run reliably, with monitoring and runbooks that let someone else operate them.

Who You Will Work With

Inside the AI Accelerator: the engineers building GEF, the team embedded with the Virtual Contact Assistant pilot, and the broader CADS data science group.

Across Cox Automotive: engineering and product teams at VinSolutions, Autotrader, Manheim, Dealertrack, and other business units as they onboard, plus Platform Engineering, Architecture, Enterprise AI, Security, and FinOps.

Required Qualifications

  • Two or more years of professional machine learning engineering experience with a Bachelor’s Degree, OR up to two years combined with a Master’s Degree in a quantitative field.
  • Applicants must currently be authorized to work in the United States for any employer without current or future sponsorship. No OPT, CPT, STEM/OPT or visa sponsorship now or in future.
  • Must currently live within a commutable distance to Atlanta to be considered.
  • Experience owning the direction of a technical product, internal tool, library, or platform used by other teams. Formal product ownership is welcome, and so is having been the de facto owner of something other engineers depended on.
  • Ability to maintain a roadmap, set priorities among competing requests, and explain the tradeoffs to both engineers and product stakeholders.
  • Strong Python, with working habits around testing, version control, code review, and continuous integration.
  • Hands-on experience building with large language models, including prompting, API integration, retrieval, or agent frameworks.
  • Working knowledge of measurement concepts such as sampling, inter-rater agreement, precision and recall, or comparative testing.
  • Experience with cloud services, ideally AWS, and with building data pipelines.
  • Strong written communication, including documentation, roadmap updates, and reporting to senior stakeholders.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Formal product ownership or technical product management experience for developer tools, infrastructure, or ML platforms.
  • Experience with evaluation tooling such as DeepEval, AWS Bedrock AgentCore Evaluations, Langfuse, or RAGAS.
  • Experience in a federated organization where adoption is voluntary and the product must win on merit.
  • Experience with observability and tracing tools such as OpenTelemetry or Datadog.
  • Exposure to model risk, AI governance, or work in a regulated environment.
  • Prior work at the intersection of data science teams and product or platform engineering.

Drug Testing

To be employed in this role, you’ll need to clear a pre-employment drug test. Cox Automotive does not currently administer a pre-employment drug test for marijuana for this position. However, we are a drug-free workplace, so the possession, use or being under the influence of drugs illegal under federal or state law during work hours, on company property and/or in company vehicles is prohibited.

Through groundbreaking technology and a commitment to stellar experiences for drivers and dealers alike, Cox Automotive employees are transforming the way the world buys, owns, sells – or simply uses – cars.
