title: Sr. Engineer - Data Scientist
description:
Who We Are

At Kyndryl, we run and reimagine the mission-critical technology systems that drive advantage for the world’s leading businesses. We are at the heart of progress; with proven expertise and a continuous flow of AI-powered insight, enabling smarter decisions, faster innovation, and a lasting competitive edge. For our people—Kyndryls—that means doing purposeful work that powers human progress. Join us and experience a flexible, supportive environment where your well-being is prioritized and your potential can thrive.


The Role

As a Data Scientist at Kyndryl you are the bridge between business problems and innovative solutions, using a powerful blend of well-defined methodologies, statistics, mathematics, domain expertise, consulting, and software engineering. You'll wear many hats, and each day will present a new puzzle to solve, a new challenge to conquer.

You will dive deep into the heart of our business, understanding its objectives and requirements – viewing them through the lens of business acumen, and converting this knowledge into a data problem. You’ll collect and explore data, seeking underlying patterns and initial insights that will guide the creation of hypotheses.

In this role, you will embark on a transformative process of business understanding, data understanding, and data preparation. Utilizing statistical and mathematical modeling techniques, you'll have the opportunity to create models that defy convention – models that hold the key to solving intricate business challenges. With an acute eye for accuracy and generalization, you'll evaluate these models to ensure they not only solve business problems but do so optimally.

Additionally, you're not just building and validating models – you’re deploying them as code to applications and processes, ensuring that the model(s) you've selected sustains its business value throughout its lifecycle.

Your expertise doesn't stop at data; you'll become intimately familiar with our business processes and have the ability to navigate their complexities, identifying issues and crafting solutions that drive meaningful change in these domains. You will develop and apply standards and policies that protect our organization's most valuable asset – ensuring that data is secure, private, accurate, available, and, most importantly, usable. Your mastery extends to data management, migration, strategy, change management, and policy and regulation.

If you're ready to embrace the power of data to transform our business and embark on an epic data adventure, then join us at Kyndryl. Together, let's redefine what's possible and unleash your potential.

Your Future at Kyndryl
Every position at Kyndryl offers a way forward to grow your career. We have opportunities that you won’t find anywhere else, including hands-on experience, learning opportunities, and the chance to certify in all four major platforms. Whether you want to broaden your knowledge base or narrow your scope and specialize in a specific sector, you can find your opportunity here.


Who You Are

Who You Are
You’re good at what you do and possess the required experience to prove it. However, equally as important – you have a growth mindset; keen to drive your own personal and professional development. You are customer-focused – someone who prioritizes customer success in their work. And finally, you’re open and borderless – naturally inclusive in how you work with others.

Required Skills and Experience

  • Minimum 4+ years of experience

  • Strong knowledge of ELK Stack (Elasticsearch, Logstash, Kibana) for log management, monitoring, analytics, and observability solutions.

  • Experience in cluster setup, cluster management, performance tuning, and troubleshooting across distributed environments.

  • Ability to diagnose and resolve complex production issues related to applications, clusters, and monitoring platforms.

  • Strong experience working with Linux environments.

  • Experience with cloud infrastructure and CLI tools (Azure CLI, AWS CLI, Kubernetes CLI, etc.) for deployment, management, and troubleshooting activities.

  • Excellent problem-solving, analytical, and critical thinking skills.

  • Strong communication and presentation skills, with the ability to explain complex technical concepts and data insights to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.

  • Ability to manage multiple projects simultaneously while maintaining a high level of accuracy and attention to detail.



Preferred Skills and Experience

  • Degree in a quantitative discipline, such as mathematics, statistics, computer science, or mechanical engineering

  • Professional certification, e.g., Open Certified Data Scientist

  • Cloud platform certification, e.g., AWS Certified Machine Learning – Specialty, Google Cloud Professional Machine Learning Engineer, or Microsoft Certified: Azure Data Scientist Associate

  • Understanding of social coding and Integrated Development Environments, e.g., GitHub and Visual Studio

  • Experience in at least one domain, e.g., cybersecurity, IT service management, financial services, or health care


Being You

The “Kyn” in Kyndryl means kinship, which represents the strong bonds we have with each other, our customers and our communities. We focus on ensuring all Kyndryls feel included and we welcome people of all cultures, backgrounds, and experiences. Even if you don’t meet every requirement, we encourage you to apply. We believe in growth, and we’re excited to see what you can bring. At Kyndryl, employee feedback has told us that our number one driver of employee engagement is belonging. That sense of belonging — being a valued, respected, trusted member of the team — is fundamental to our culture and fueling great experiences for our customers. This dedication to welcoming everyone into our company means that Kyndryl gives you the ability to thrive and contribute to our culture of empathy and shared success. That’s The Kyndryl Way.


What You Can Expect

Your career with us isn’t just a job—it’s an adventure with purpose. We offer a dynamic, hybrid-friendly culture that supports your well-being and empowers you to grow. Our Be Well programs are thoughtfully designed to support your financial, mental, physical, and social health—because we know that when you feel your best, you do your best.

From your very first day, you’ll dive into impactful work that powers the systems our customers rely on every day. You won’t just contribute—you’ll make a difference, tackling meaningful projects that sharpen your skills and fuel your growth.

We’re here to champion your journey. With powerful tools to chart your career path, personalized development goals aligned with your ambitions, and continuous feedback to keep you inspired and on track, you’ll have everything you need to thrive and evolve. You’ll develop in-demand skills to grow your career and achieve your ambitions with access to cutting-edge learning opportunities—from certifications with Microsoft, Google, and Amazon to coaching and hands-on experiences. And through it all, you’ll be part of a culture that values empathy, restless learning, and a devotion to shared success.

We want you to thrive here—and we’re committed to helping you do just that. Ready to make an impact? Join us and help shape what’s next.

Get Referred!

title: Assistant Director - Academic Programs
description:

Job Summary

The Assistant Director of Academic Programs creates and executes a strategic plan to grow and enhance the department’s graduate programs. This role advises Master of Science (MS) and PhD students on their academic programs and serves as an integral partner to the Graduate and Undergraduate Faculty Committees in advancing initiatives and enhancing graduate education. Responsibilities include managing graduate admissions processes and data, serving as a liaison between the department and the Graduate School, overseeing course scheduling on a semester basis and for the department’s five-year growth plan, developing workshops and events that enhance the student experience, managing course assessment activities related to accreditation, providing guidance to faculty and PhD students regarding teaching assistant workload and support, and facilitating academic projects through collaboration with partners across and beyond the college. This position is dedicated primarily to the department’s graduate programs (MS, PlusOne, and PhD), with undergraduate-facing responsibilities managed by the Academic Coordinator supervised by this role.

This position follows a hybrid schedule, with three days on site and two days remote each week.

Key Responsibilities & Accountabilities

Academic Program Operations and Recruitment

  • Manage department policies related to student matters.
  • Oversee course scheduling for each academic term and maintain the department’s five-year teaching plan.
  • Oversee annual catalog submissions and catalog changes.
  • Manage TRACE scores and mid-year and annual reviews for PhD students and faculty.
  • Manage recruitment activities associated with MS, PlusOne, and PhD applications.
  • Serve as the primary point of contact for program inquiries.
  • Coordinate and administer orientation programs, welcome events, Graduate Candidates Day, and other graduate recruitment and onboarding activities.
  • Serve as a liaison between the college and department for student-facing events and matters.

Student Data Management

  • Manage tracking processes for PhD student milestones, including qualifying examinations, work-in-progress reviews, proposal defenses, and dissertation defenses.
  • Interact directly with graduate students and monitor timelines related to advisor assignments and reassignments, committee formation, qualifying examinations, proposals, and defense arrangements.
  • Serve as the primary contact for MS students with questions regarding course scheduling and academic timelines.
  • Manage student enrollment and tracking data and serve as the department contact for student-related data management.

Program Development

  • Manage processes related to the development of new MS programs, combined majors and minors, and new research concentrations for the PhD program.
  • Administer approval processes for new courses, concentrations, and academic programs.
  • Collaborate with faculty and administrators across departments and colleges to manage the development and implementation of new academic programs.
  • Document program changes, approval processes, and voting outcomes associated with new programs.

Minimum Qualifications

Required

  • Bachelor’s degree or equivalent.
  • Minimum of four years of experience supporting academic and administrative projects, preferably in higher education, with adult learners, or in a high customer service environment.

  • Ability to balance multiple priorities and respond effectively to the needs of diverse constituencies.

description:

You’ll also have the chance to give back and make a positive impact on where we live and work through volunteerism.

Shape your Career with Citi

We’re currently looking for a high caliber professional to join our team as Vice President, Wholesale Credit Risk - In-Business Quality Assurance - Hybrid (Internal Job Title: Quality Assurance, Monitoring & Testing Lead Analyst- C13) based in Mumbai, India. Being part of our team means that we’ll provide you with the resources to meet your unique needs, empower you to make healthy decisions and manage your financial well-being to help plan for your future.

What We Offer -

  • Opportunities to grow your career locally and collaborate with colleagues across Citi's global network.
  • A hybrid working model that balances in-office collaboration with remote flexibility.
  • Investment in your professional development through training programmes, mentorship, and skill-building opportunities.
  • Employee wellbeing support including medical coverage, mental health resources, parental leave, and family support programmes.
  • Competitive retirement contributions and investment options to support your long-term financial goals.

Institutional Credit Management’s (“ICM”) objective is to provide an integrated “end-to-end” credit underwriting, identification, measurement, management, monitoring for wholesale credit businesses across the enterprise. Wholesale Credit Risk (“WCR”) In-Business Quality Assurance (QA) is an integral part of the ICM organization.

WCR In-Business QA verifies that established standards and processes are followed and consistently applied. WCR and ICM Management utilize the results of Quality Assurance Reviews (QARs) to assess the quality of the group's policies, procedures, programs, and practices as relates to the management of wholesale credit risk. The results enable management to identify risks associated with operational and control weaknesses, training needs, and process deficiencies.

The WCR Head of In-Business QA reports results of QARs providing insight and observations on deficiency and areas of improvement, engaging management of the respective In-Business Credit Risk, Independent Risk, Banking & International Credit Review, Internal Audit and Regulators.

In this role, you’re expected to:

  • Support the Portfolio Leads of In-Business QA in implementation and ongoing delivery of a robust Quality Assurance function covering WCR Underwriting (UW) portfolios - Institutional, Commercial and Wealth
  • Execute High Frequency Testing across dynamic and specialized risk areas, delivering timely assurance and insights on emerging control risks
  • Provide assurance over automated and system-driven credit risk controls, identifying control gaps and enhancement opportunities
  • Identify opportunities to enhance the efficiency and effectiveness of control testing through innovative approaches, automation opportunities, and process improvements
  • Provide effective and credible challenge during QARs to Portfolio Leads and Underwriters, as regards to credit reviews and process adherence weaknesses in such processes are identified and escalated as appropriate
  • Support with the aim to ensure wholesale credit risks within Citi are effectively identified, measured, monitored, and controlled, consistent with the bank’s risk appetite and all policies and processes established within the risk governance framework
  • Under the supervision of the QA Head and QA Portfolio Lead, support execution of the following:
    • Consistent and objective assessments during QARs
    • Subsequent follow-up on corrective actions that were raised during QARs

title: Service Management Lead
description:
Who We Are

At Kyndryl, we run and reimagine the mission-critical technology systems that drive advantage for the world’s leading businesses. We are at the heart of progress; with proven expertise and a continuous flow of AI-powered insight, enabling smarter decisions, faster innovation, and a lasting competitive edge. For our people—Kyndryls—that means doing purposeful work that powers human progress. Join us and experience a flexible, supportive environment where your well-being is prioritized and your potential can thrive.


The Role

Have you been wanting to get into IT but don’t have tech experience, this could be your gateway. Do you love how it feels to help someone solve a problem? Want a chance to see lots of career options up close before you choose your path forward? Then there’s a good chance you’ll love being a Service Management Lead at Kyndryl.

Being great in this job is less about your resume and more about your personality. We are looking for friendly, helpful, and empathetic people who have an interest in technology but not necessarily tech experience. As a Service Management Lead, you’ll be the face and voice of Kyndryl, helping customers solve their problems every day.

A Service Management Lead combines the know-how of tech support with problem solving and customer service, so bring your people skills and we’ll teach you the rest. It’s a fun and fast-paced role where you’ll start learning and contributing right away. The first month, you learn the ropes and get set up with one client on production. Soon, you’ll be multi-tasking and providing interactive solutions (chat, email, MS Teams) while treating our customers to concierge-level care.

You will also work with back-office teams to handle escalations. This is your chance to work alongside senior co-workers who will share their knowledge. As you interact with many different people on a variety of problems, you’ll grow your experience, skill, and grasp of what other job roles do. In addition, there are plentiful opportunities to find and work with mentors.

You can become an expert with Microsoft 365, especially Excel, and get trained on a variety of different platforms. And you can earn certifications including Google Cloud, Azure, Microsoft, etc. In fact, the learning opportunities are what most people like best about this role. It’s fun, challenging, and fast-paced – you definitely won’t be bored!

Roles and Responsibilities:

  • Ensuring that customer communications, triage, 3rd party escalations and service resolution are all managed with urgency, care & professionalism.

  • Lead activities related to the implementation of Major Incident and Problem Management processes across the organization.

  • Assess business impact and urgency of incidents, review and accept incidents recommended for escalation as Major Incidents, and trigger business continuity or disaster recovery (DR) plans as required.

  • Take full ownership of Major Incidents from initiation through resolution. Establish and manage Technical and Business Management Bridge calls throughout the life cycle of a Major Incident.

  • Lead all resolving teams involved in the resolution process, escalating issues if appropriate levels of support are not being provided.

  • Maintain open communication with Management Stakeholders and the wider user base.

  • Perform Major Incident Reviews (MIR), capturing events and lessons learned.

  • Drive root cause identification and develop actionable and well-defined corrective/preventative action plans.

  • Exhibit a high level of command and control during conference calls involving multiple stakeholders.


Your future at Kyndryl
This is a true “start here, go anywhere” opportunity. As you get a close-up look at a wide variety of Kyndryl job roles, you can choose your career path. Many have moved up to the 2nd or 3rd level escalation team. Others go on to further education/certifications and more senior or technical roles.


Who You Are

You’re good at what you do and possess the required experience to prove it. However, equally as important – you have a growth mindset; keen to drive your own personal and professional development. You are customer-focused – someone who prioritizes customer success in their work. And finally, you’re open and borderless – naturally inclusive in how you work with others.

Required Skills and Experience

  • 7+Years of total experience in Service Management.

  • 5-6 years of relevant experience in Incident, Change and Problem management.

  • Strong knowledge of ITIL-based ITSM processes

  • Hands-on experience with Incident, Problem, Change, SLA/SLM

  • Expertise in MIS reporting, dashboards, and trend analysis

  • Good understanding of infrastructure, application, and end-user support services

  • Ability to handle high-pressure situations and major incidents

  • Strong communication and presentation skills

  • Data-driven mindset with attention to detail

Preferred Skills and Experience

B.E/B.Tech or similar degree.


Being You

The “Kyn” in Kyndryl means kinship, which represents the strong bonds we have with each other, our customers and our communities. We focus on ensuring all Kyndryls feel included and we welcome people of all cultures, backgrounds, and experiences. Even if you don’t meet every requirement, we encourage you to apply. We believe in growth, and we’re excited to see what you can bring. At Kyndryl, employee feedback has told us that our number one driver of employee engagement is belonging. That sense of belonging — being a valued, respected, trusted member of the team — is fundamental to our culture and fueling great experiences for our customers. This dedication to welcoming everyone into our company means that Kyndryl gives you the ability to thrive and contribute to our culture of empathy and shared success. That’s The Kyndryl Way.


What You Can Expect

Your career with us isn’t just a job—it’s an adventure with purpose. We offer a dynamic, hybrid-friendly culture that supports your well-being and empowers you to grow. Our Be Well programs are thoughtfully designed to support your financial, mental, physical, and social health—because we know that when you feel your best, you do your best.

From your very first day, you’ll dive into impactful work that powers the systems our customers rely on every day. You won’t just contribute—you’ll make a difference, tackling meaningful projects that sharpen your skills and fuel your growth.

We’re here to champion your journey. With powerful tools to chart your career path, personalized development goals aligned with your ambitions, and continuous feedback to keep you inspired and on track, you’ll have everything you need to thrive and evolve. You’ll develop in-demand skills to grow your career and achieve your ambitions with access to cutting-edge learning opportunities—from certifications with Microsoft, Google, and Amazon to coaching and hands-on experiences. And through it all, you’ll be part of a culture that values empathy, restless learning, and a devotion to shared success.

We want you to thrive here—and we’re committed to helping you do just that. Ready to make an impact? Join us and help shape what’s next.

Get Referred!

If you know someone that works at Kyndryl, when asked ‘How Did You Hear About Us’ during the application process, select ‘Employee Referral’ and enter your contact's Kyndryl email address.

title: Senior Windows Engineer, Endpoint Engineering
description:
Over the last 20 years, Ares’ success has been driven by our people and our culture. Today, our team is guided by our core values – Collaborative, Responsible, Entrepreneurial, Self-Aware, Trustworthy – and our purpose to be a catalyst for shared prosperity and a better future. Through our recruitment, career development and employee-focused programming, we are committed to fostering a welcoming and inclusive work environment where high-performance talent of diverse backgrounds, experiences, and perspectives can build careers within this exciting and growing industry.

Job Description

The Senior Windows/SCCM/Intune Engineer is responsible for the architecture, engineering, automation, security, and lifecycle management of the firm's global Windows endpoint environment. This role serves as a senior technical leader within End User Engineering, driving enterprise device management strategies across Microsoft Configuration Manager (SCCM/MECM), Microsoft Intune, Microsoft Entra ID, and Windows 11 platforms.

The engineer will design and maintain modern endpoint management solutions, software deployment frameworks, operating system lifecycle processes, compliance enforcement, and endpoint security configurations. This individual will collaborate closely with Information Security, Infrastructure, Service Desk, Unified Communications, and Application teams to deliver a secure, scalable, and highly automated digital workplace experience for employees worldwide.

Reporting relationships

Reports to: Senior Manager, Digital Workplace

Primary functions & responsibilities

1. Endpoint Engineering & Management

  • Design, implement, and support enterprise Windows endpoint management solutions.
  • Manage and optimize Microsoft Configuration Manager (SCCM/MECM) infrastructure.
  • Lead migration initiatives from traditional SCCM management toward cloud-native management using Microsoft Intune.
  • Engineer and maintain Microsoft Intune policies for device compliance, configuration, security baselines, endpoint protection, and application deployment.
  • Develop and maintain device provisioning strategies utilizing:
    • Windows Autopilot
    • Microsoft Intune
    • Hybrid Azure AD Join
    • Entra ID Join
  • Establish endpoint configuration standards across global environments.
  • Drive hardware refresh and operating system modernization initiatives.
  • Maintain endpoint inventory, reporting, and lifecycle management processes.

2. Operating System Engineering

  • Lead Windows 11 deployment, maintenance, and upgrade programs.
  • Develop and maintain enterprise OS deployment task sequences and Autopilot provisioning packages.
  • Engineer standardized endpoint configuration profiles and provisioning methodologies.
  • Manage feature updates, quality updates, and servicing channels.
  • Perform application compatibility testing and remediation.
  • Develop rollback and contingency plans for large-scale deployment initiatives.

3. Application Packaging & Deployment

  • Package, test, deploy, and maintain enterprise software solutions.
  • Develop deployment methodologies utilizing:
    • Intune Win32 Applications
    • SCCM Applications
    • PowerShell
    • Winget
  • Troubleshoot complex installation and application-related issues.
  • Create detection methods, superseding strategies, and deployment automation workflows.
  • Manage application lifecycle processes from onboarding through retirement.

4. Automation & Scripting

  • Develop automation solutions using:
    • PowerShell
    • PowerShell App Deployment Toolkit (PSADT)
    • Graph API
    • Azure Automation
    • Azure Functions
  • Automate administrative tasks and operational processes.
  • Create self-healing and proactive remediation scripts.
  • Develop reporting, monitoring, and compliance automation solutions.
  • Reduce operational overhead through infrastructure-as-code methodologies.

5. Endpoint Security & Compliance

  • Partner with Information Security teams to implement endpoint security controls.
  • Engineer and maintain:
    • Intune Patch Management / Autopatch
    • SCCM/WSUS software updates
    • Attack Surface Reduction Rules
    • Device Control Policies
    • BitLocker Encryption
    • Security Baselines
    • Group Policy Management
    • Conditional Access integrations
  • Ensure compliance with regulatory and corporate security requirements.
  • Evaluate vulnerabilities and coordinate remediation activities.
  • Support audit readiness and security reviews.

6. Microsoft Cloud Technologies

  • Support and integrate:
    • Microsoft Intune
    • Microsoft Entra ID
    • Microsoft Defender
    • Microsoft 365 Apps
    • Windows Update for Business
    • Microsoft Graph
  • Develop modern management strategies aligned with Microsoft's cloud-first approach.
  • Manage co-management capabilities between SCCM and Intune.
  • Optimize device management through cloud-based services and automation.

7. Digital Employee Experience (DEX)

  • Utilize Digital Experience Monitoring tools such as:
    • Nexthink
    • Microsoft Endpoint Analytics
    • Lakeside SysTrack
    • ControlUp
  • Analyze endpoint health and performance trends.
  • Develop initiatives to improve:
    • Device performance
    • Boot times
    • Reliability
    • Application experience
    • Employee productivity
  • Create executive-level reporting and operational dashboards.

8. Documentation & Operational Excellence

  • Create and maintain:
    • Technical documentation
    • Standard operating procedures
    • Engineering standards
    • Runbooks
    • Knowledge articles
  • Develop operational dashboards and reporting metrics.
  • Maintain architecture diagrams and platform documentation.
  • Drive continuous process improvement initiatives.
  • Serve as Tier 3/Level 4 escalation support for complex endpoint issues.
  • Perform root cause analysis for recurring incidents and service disruptions.
  • Participate in maintenance windows and critical incident response activities.
  • Establish monitoring and alerting strategies for endpoint services.
  • Maintain service reliability and performance targets.

Qualifications

Education:

Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Engineering, or related technical field.
Advanced degree strongly preferred.

Experience Required:

Required

  • 7+ years of enterprise endpoint engineering experience.
  • 5+ years managing Microsoft Configuration Manager (SCCM/MECM).
  • 3+ years managing Microsoft Intune in a large enterprise environment.
  • Experience supporting environments with 5,000+ endpoints preferred.
  • Experience in financial services, healthcare, legal, or highly regulated industries preferred.

Preferred Certifications

  • Microsoft Certified: Endpoint Administrator Associate
  • Microsoft Certified: Azure Administrator Associate
  • Microsoft Certified: Enterprise Administrator Expert
  • Microsoft Certified: Security Operations Analyst Associate

description:

title: ​​Digital Signal Processing Engineer​
description:
Location:
Meylan, France (Hybrid — Office: Monday–Friday)

Our Team:
Join Semtech's Wireless and LoRa System teams, spanning our Neuchâtel and Grenoble offices, where we develop unique system-level solutions for Low Power Wireless Area Network (LPWAN) products.

As the world's leading experts in long-range, low-power, battery-powered wireless communication, our capability spans everything from antenna design through IC analog and digital design, low-power systems, protocol development, and cloud-based solutions.

You'll be part of the journey shaping the new LoRa and LoRaWAN system architecture, working alongside a highly skilled, multi-disciplinary team at the forefront of IoT connectivity.

Job Summary
As a DSP Algorithm Engineer, you'll design, develop, and optimise signal processing algorithms for wireless modem IP blocks.

Working primarily in Matlab, you'll build and maintain reference models and evaluate algorithm performance under realistic channel conditions, while also contributing directly to hardware implementation through RTL design in SystemVerilog and bit-accurate C modelling — working closely with the digital design and radio validation teams to ensure a smooth transition from algorithm to silicon.

Responsibilities

  • Design and refine PHY-layer signal processing algorithms, including modulation/demodulation, synchronisation, channel estimation, filtering, and error correction; build and maintain the floating-point and fixed-point Matlab reference models used as the golden reference for hardware implementation and validation teams.
  • Simulate and analyse modem performance under various channel conditions (AWGN, fading, interference) across key metrics such as BER/PER, sensitivity, and robustness.
  • Contribute to RTL implementation of modem IP blocks in SystemVerilog and develop bit-accurate C models, supporting fixed-point conversion, assessing implementation trade-offs, and validating hardware behaviour against Matlab references.
  • Support radio validation teams in correlating lab measurement results with simulation models, iterating on algorithm improvements based on findings.
  • Monitor state-of-the-art DSP and wireless communication techniques, evaluating their applicability to Semtech's product roadmap.
  • Produce clear documentation, including algorithm specifications, simulation reports, and performance analyses for internal teams and stakeholders.


Minimum Qualifications

  • MSc or PhD in Signal Processing, Telecommunications, Electronics, or a related field.
  • 3+ years of experience in DSP algorithm development for wireless communication systems.
  • Strong proficiency in Matlab for algorithm modelling, simulation, and performance analysis.
  • Hands-on experience in RTL design (SystemVerilog) and bit-accurate C modelling for signal processing blocks.
  • Solid understanding of wireless PHY layer principles: modulation, synchronisation, channel estimation, FEC.
  • Rigorous analytical mindset with strong mathematical foundations.
  • Good communication and collaboration skills in an international environment.


Desired Qualifications

  • Knowledge of low-power wireless technologies (LoRa, BLE, FSK, or similar).
  • Good understanding of fixed-point implementation constraints and hardware design trade-offs.
  • Knowledge of RF instruments (vector signal generators, spectrum and signal analysers).


🚀 Career Growth Philosophy At Semtech, we believe that innovation starts with people. That's why we're committed to empowering your professional development—through access to mentorship, learning resources, and a collaborative, idea-rich environment. Our pay-for-performance culture rewards initiative, encourages growth, and celebrates meaningful contributions.

There are several factors taken into consideration in determining base salary, including but not limited to: job-related qualifications, skills, education and experience, as well as job location and the value of other elements of an employee's total compensation package.

Join us, and be part of a team that's building the future of connectivity—together.

title: Senior Director, Strategic Planning and Campaign Management
description:
Department

About the Department

The University of Chicago Advancement team cultivates lifelong connections with more than 220,000 alumni, current students, parents, and friends worldwide, building community through intellectual, professional, and other meaningful experiences on campus, around the world and online. Advancement empowers every division, school, department, and institute to thrive, generating support for esteemed faculty, pioneering researchers, visionary practitioners, and ambitious students.

During the Chicago Minds campaign, Advancement seeks to raise over $1 billion annually. This unprecedented philanthropic effort is designed to stretch the boundaries of what is possible, fueling bold discovery and amplifying the University’s global impact.

Our work is rooted in the belief that meaningful connection and lasting experiences inspire ambassadorship and enduring commitment. We champion a culture of innovation and excellence, inviting every member of our community to participate in a future defined by creativity, intellectual rigor, and shared purpose. Through collaborative partnerships, strategic stewardship, and investment in talent, Advancement is reimagining alumni and donor engagement while ensuring UChicago remains a catalyst of impact for generations to come.

The Strategic Planning function in Advancement propels operational excellence and supports enterprise-wide alignment to help us meet, and exceed, our fundraising goals. Acting as a vital bridge between vision and execution, this function brings clarity to priorities, mobilizes cross-functional partners, and keeps complex initiatives on track. With a sharp focus on delivering practical strategies and strengthening core operations, Strategic Planning ensures that Advancement not only performs at a high level today, but is also positioned for long-term, sustainable success.


Job Summary

The Senior Director bridges strategic direction and execution across the Strategic Planning, Campaign Management, and Executive Office functions, connecting people, priorities, and workstreams to advance the Assistant Vice President’s strategic agenda. Reporting to the Assistant Vice President for Strategic Planning and Campaign, the role translates organizational strategy into coordinated action by establishing clarity around priorities, ownership, sequencing, and decision-making across the division.

The Senior Director directly manages project managers embedded within Strategic Planning and Campaign Management who oversee day-to-day implementation, milestones, and delivery within their respective workstreams. Working across rather than within individual workstreams, the Senior Director drives broader organizational progress through cross-functional facilitation, coordination, and problem-solving with colleagues across the enterprise.

This role identifies and resolves complex, ambiguous challenges, including competing priorities, unclear ownership, cross-functional dependencies, and stalled decisions, and develops structures to support sustainable solutions or directs issues to the appropriate owners. Through this enterprise-wide perspective, the Senior Director also surfaces emerging risks, patterns, opportunities, and organizational constraints to the Assistant Vice President and other senior leaders to inform strategy and executive-level decision-making. This position leads the planning, development, and implementation of University objectives, long-range and strategic plans, and identifies the University’s strengths and weaknesses. Identifies new external partners to advance strategic priorities.

This position is not eligible for employer-sponsored employment authorization.

Responsibilities

  • Serves as the operational bridge between the Assistant Vice President's strategic direction and the teams responsible for delivery across Strategic Planning, Campaign Management, and Executive Office Coordination, translating Executive Team priorities into integrated plans with clear ownership, timelines, accountability, and measurable outcomes. Aligns priorities and resources across the portfolio and ensures insights, risks, resource needs, and emerging constraints flow upward to inform strategy.
  • Directly manages project managers embedded within the Strategic Planning and Campaign Management functions, setting priorities, allocating resources, and providing coaching and performance management. Provides the operational leadership and decision-making framework that guides their work and partners with them to build systems and processes that enable efficient, accurate, and repeatable execution.
  • Identifies and resolves complex, ambiguous problems that cross functional boundaries, including competing demands, unclear ownership, contested priorities, and dependencies no single team is positioned to see. Designs and implements governance structures and processes that improve decision-making and, when ownership resides outside the Assistant Vice President's office, elevates issues to the appropriate senior leader and collaborates toward resolution.
  • Facilitates alignment across functional leaders to advance organization-wide campaign and strategic planning objectives, serving as a convener who brings together the appropriate stakeholders to resolve issues, clarify direction, and maintain momentum while surfacing emerging conflicts and resource constraints before they become blockers.
  • Partners with People and Culture to lead the orientation of new senior leaders joining Advancement to the planning process, ensuring they have the context and working knowledge of organizational plans and cross-functional interdependencies needed to lead effectively.
  • Establishes and maintains standards for the quality, accuracy, and completeness of campaign and strategic planning deliverables, serving as the final review point before materials reach the Assistant Vice President or executive audiences and creating infrastructure that promotes consistency and cohesion across deliverables produced by teams throughout Advancement.
  • Oversees campaign governance processes and workstream management, including planning, tracking, and reporting of the campaign budget and the operational infrastructure supporting the Campaign Cabinet, campaign co-chairs, Steering Committee, and other campaign leadership bodies.
  • Oversees the development of Board materials, executive presentations, and other leadership-facing communications that support executive decision-making, provide clarity into Advancement progress and objectives, and articulate campaign strategy. Draws on organizational context and directs the collection and synthesis of information across functions to shape the narrative presented to executive audiences.
  • Supports enterprise campaign initiatives and strategic projects, including campaign case support, executive analyses, and cross-functional initiatives that advance the University's strategic fundraising priorities.
  • Leads execution of Advancement's strategic planning process and cadence, partnering across the organization to coordinate executive updates, annual planning, organizational goal setting, multi-year priorities, campaign milestones, and long-range strategic planning. Tracks progress against annual strategic objectives, develops unit- and team-level planning resources, supports development of the enterprise's three-year strategic plan, and oversees executive presentations and leadership materials that communicate organizational priorities, campaign performance, and strategic direction.
  • Synthesizes progress against strategic objectives and campaign goals into an integrated view of organizational performance, partnering with Operations to assess the feasibility of stated goals against organizational capacity, competing priorities, and current conditions, and surfacing findings and course-correction recommendations to the Assistant Vice President and Executive Team.
  • Provides strategic leadership for Executive Office Coordination, directing the operating rhythm of the Vice President's Office through Executive Team and Senior Leadership Team planning, STAT processes, executive briefings, prioritization of executive initiatives, and coordination across internal and external stakeholders.
  • Continuously improves the systems, governance structures, management tools, and operational processes supporting Strategic Planning and Campaign Management to strengthen decision-making, organizational alignment, and execution across the portfolio.
  • Seeks opportunities for professional development that will enhance job performance including attending webinars, seminars, building networks within the University and with colleagues at peer institutions.

About the Role

The Service Management Consultant is responsible for driving service governance, service performance management, and service improvement initiatives across internal and external service providers. The role serves as the subject matter expert for service management practices, ensuring that services are delivered in accordance with agreed service levels, operational standards, and business requirements.
The position provides strategic consultation to business leaders, partner organizations, and service providers by identifying service risks, performance gaps, capacity constraints, and process improvement opportunities. The role is accountable for establishing service frameworks, influencing stakeholders, driving resolutions of complex service issues, and leading initiatives that enhance customer experience, operational efficiency, and service quality

Roles and Responsibilities:

Service Governance and Oversight

  • Serve as the subject matter expert on service management, service governance, and operational performance across Shared Services.
  • Lead the development, negotiation, implementation, and periodic review of Service Level Agreements (SLAs) and service performance frameworks with internal and external partners.
  • Establish service governance processes, performance review mechanisms, and escalation frameworks to ensure effective service delivery.
  • Provide strategic recommendations to management on service risks, capacity requirements, process enhancements, and service improvement opportunities.

Service Performance Management

  • Analyze service performance trends, operational metrics, service failures, and customer-impacting incidents to identify risks and opportunities.
  • Develop executive-level dashboards, performance reports, and service insights to support decision-making by management.
  • Challenge service providers and internal stakeholders on recurring performance issues and drive sustainable corrective action plans.
  • Lead root cause investigations of significant service issues and ensure preventive controls are established.

Strategic Service Improvement

  • Lead cross-functional service improvement initiatives from business case development through implementation and benefits realization.
  • Identify opportunities for automation, digitization, process simplification, and operational efficiency improvements.
  • Drive transformation initiatives aimed at improving customer experience, turnaround times, service quality, and operating effectiveness.
  • Benchmark service processes and practices against industry standards and recommend enhancements.

Minimum Job Requirements:

Education

  • Bachelor's degree in Business, Management, Engineering, Data Analytics, Communications, Information Systems, or related field.

Experience

  • 5+ years of experience in Service Management, Operations Management, Shared Services, Customer Services, or Process Improvement.
  • Proven experience managing complex stakeholder relationships and third-party service providers.
  • Experience leading enterprise-wide projects and process transformation initiatives.
  • Experience presenting recommendations and service insights to senior leadership.

Preferred Qualifications

  • ITIL Foundation or Service Management certification.
  • Lean Six Sigma certification.
  • Project Management certification (PMP, PRINCE2, Agile, or equivalent).

Competencies

  • Strategic thinking
  • Executive communication and presentation skills
  • Data-driven decision making
  • Service governance expertise
  • Strong business acumen
  • Influencing without authority
  • Project and change management
  • Analytical problem solving

title: Commodities Index Senior Developer
description:
We are seeking a talented and motivated Developer to join our dynamic Commodities Index Technology Team.

In this role, you will be responsible for the design, development, and maintenance of the software and infrastructure that powers our suite of proprietary and benchmark commodities indices.

You will work closely with quantitative researchers, traders, and index managers to implement new index methodologies, ensure data integrity, and optimize our calculation engines for performance and accuracy.

This is a critical role that combines expertise in software engineering with a deep understanding of financial markets, specifically in the commodities space.

You will be responsible for green field index re-engineering projects as well as managing and maintaining existing index platforms.

Key Responsibilities

  • System Development:

Design, build, test, and deploy robust and scalable software for the calculation, publication, and analysis of commodity indices.

  • Methodology Implementation:

Collaborate with quantitative analysts to translate complex index rules and methodologies (including weighting, rebalancing, and corporate actions) into high-quality, production-ready code.

  • Data Integration & Management:

Develop and maintain data pipelines to source, validate, and process commodity price data from various vendors and exchanges (e.g., Bloomberg, Refinitiv, CME, ICE).

  • Back-testing & Analytics:

Create and enhance tools for the historical back-testing of index strategies, performance attribution, and risk analysis.

  • Performance Optimization:

Profile and optimize the index calculation engine and data processing workflows to ensure low latency and high throughput.

  • Production Support:

Provide ongoing support for the index platform, troubleshoot production issues, and ensure the accuracy and timeliness of all index calculations and data distributions.

  • Documentation:

Maintain comprehensive documentation for the index methodologies, system architecture, and operational procedures.

  • Stakeholder Collaboration:

Work effectively with cross-functional teams, including research, trading, operations, and technology infrastructure.

Required Qualifications

  • Education:

Bachelor’s or master’s degree in computer science, Engineering, Mathematics, Physics, or a related quantitative field.

  • Programming Proficiency:

3+ years of strong, hands-on development experience in an object-oriented language such as Python, C++, or Java.

  • Data & Algorithms:

Solid foundation in data structures, algorithms, and software design principles.

  • Database Skills:

Proficiency in SQL and experience with relational databases (e.g., PostgreSQL, SQL Server).

  • Financial Acumen:

A strong interest in financial markets and a foundational understanding of financial instruments.

  • Problem-Solving:

Excellent analytical and problem-solving skills with a keen attention to detail.

  • Communication:

Strong verbal and written communication skills, with the ability to articulate complex technical concepts to non-technical stakeholders.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Domain Expertise: Prior experience working directly with commodities (Energy, Metals, Agriculture), financial indices, futures, and/or other derivatives.
  • Quantitative Libraries: Hands-on experience with numerical and data analysis libraries in Python (e.g., Pandas).
  • Cloud & DevOps: Familiarity with cloud computing platforms and CI/CD practices.

About Us

At Target, we’re dedicated to helping all families discover the joy of everyday life — whether in our stores or online. Alongside our distinctive retail brand, we continually innovate to create a seamless digital shopping experience across Target.com, Target+, and our fulfillment network.

As Target’s 3P marketplace continues to scale, logistics speed, reliability, and cost efficiency are critical enablers of guest trust, conversion, and long-term profitability. The Director, Fulfillment Partnerships, plays a pivotal leadership role in architecting and advancing the fulfillment network strategy that powers Target+ growth.

The Director, Fulfillment Partnerships will own the strategy, business development, evaluation, and pilot commercialization of external fulfillment solutions for Target+ Marketplace. This leader will identify and manage the provider landscape, shape commercial models, structure pilots, define success metrics, and recommend whether Target+ should scale, stop, or evolve external fulfillment models as part of a longer-term Fulfillment by Target strategy that improves speed, reliability, cost-to-serve, and Partner adoption.

The ideal candidate is a strategic, analytical, and commercially minded marketplace logistics leader who can build relationships externally, influence internally without direct authority, and bring structure to ambiguous, high-impact opportunities. This leader must balance speed-to-market with operational discipline, guest experience, Partner economics, and Target profitability.

Key Responsibilities

  • External Fulfillment Strategy & Provider Landscape: Develop the Target+ external fulfillment strategy across 3PL, white-label, regional fulfillment, MCF, LTL / bulky-item, and other logistics service provider models. Build and maintain a provider landscape and evaluation framework that compares capabilities, coverage, cost, scalability, integration complexity, service levels, and strategic fit.

  • Business Development & Commercial Model Design: Lead external provider conversations and partner with Procurement, Legal, Finance, GSCL, and enterprise Supply Chain to shape commercial terms, operating expectations, and contract inputs. Develop pricing, subsidy, rate-card, incentive, and cost-sharing models that balance guest experience, Partner economics, and Target+ profitability.

  • 3PL, White-Label & MCF Exploration: Evaluate 3PL, white-label fulfillment, and MCF models that can improve Target+ delivery speed, seller fulfillment options, and long-term marketplace competitiveness. Assess feasibility, economics, seller adoption, operational requirements, and the role these models could play in a longer-term Fulfillment by Target strategy.

  • Pilot Design, Launch & Commercialization: Design and lead structured pilots with selected fulfillment providers and Marketplace Partners. Define pilot scope, seller and category fit, success metrics, launch readiness, operating routines, issue-resolution paths, and scale/stop/iterate recommendations.

  • Product, Engineering & Data Enablement: Translate external fulfillment models into clear Product, Engineering, and Data Science requirements. Define needs for provider integration, seller onboarding, order routing, inventory visibility, delivery promises, tracking, returns flows, reporting, and performance dashboards.

  • Seller Adoption, Partner Experience & Performance Governance: Develop the seller value proposition, eligibility criteria, onboarding approach, and adoption playbook for external fulfillment solutions. Establish provider scorecards, SLA expectations, operating routines, and business reviews to monitor speed, cost, reliability, promise accuracy, seller adoption, guest impact, returns performance, and escalation trends.

  • Cross-Functional Leadership, Financial Recommendations & Future Scaling: Lead across Target+ and enterprise partners to align fulfillment partnership work with Marketplace growth, guest experience, Partner needs, and enterprise supply chain strategy. Build business cases and scenario models to recommend which fulfillment models should scale, evolve, or stop. Operate as an individual-contributor Director in FY2026 while defining the FY2027 team structure, routines, and talent needs required to scale the Fulfillment Partnerships function.

Core responsibilities are subject to change based on business needs.

About You

  • Four-year degree or equivalent experience required.

  • 8+ years of experience in marketplace, eCommerce, logistics, retail supply chain, business development, strategic partnerships, consulting, or related field.

  • 3+ years of marketplace/3P, eCommerce fulfillment, logistics service provider, or supply chain partnership experience strongly preferred.

  • Proven experience building external partnerships, managing complex business development pipelines, and negotiating or supporting commercial agreements.

  • Experience working with 3PLs, fulfillment providers, transportation providers, marketplace fulfillment services, reverse logistics providers, or related logistics networks preferred.

  • Strong understanding of marketplace seller economics, fulfillment cost-to-serve, delivery speed, operational SLAs, and Partner experience.

  • Strong financial and analytical capability, including business case development, scenario modeling, rate-card evaluation, GMV impact, margin impact, and investment tradeoff analysis.

  • Experience partnering with Product, Engineering, Data Science, Finance, Legal, Procurement, and Operations to translate business needs into scalable capabilities.

  • Strong communication and storytelling skills, with the ability to influence senior leaders and external partners.

  • Demonstrated ability to operate in ambiguity, create structure, and drive decisions in a fast-paced, startup-like environment.

  • Strong project and program management skills, including pilot design, launch readiness, risk management, and executive reporting.

  • Entrepreneurial and performance-driven, with the ability to balance guest experience, Partner needs, speed, cost, and profitability.

  • Resilient, adaptable, and decisive, with a strong bias for action and a high degree of ownership.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience designing or scaling marketplace fulfillment, managed logistics, seller services, white-label fulfillment, or 3PL partnership programs.

  • Experience with marketplace platforms, seller onboarding, order management, fulfillment integrations, or Partner Portal capabilities.

  • Experience working with or evaluating fulfillment models similar to FBA, MCF, WFS, or third-party marketplace fulfillment programs.

title: SENIOR ANALYST, INTEGRATED RISK MANAGEMENT
description:
We are banking at another level.

Choosing BDC as your employer means working in a healthy, inclusive, and skilled workplace that puts forward the best conditions to bring together unique teams where employees are empowered to act. It also means being at the centre of ambitious economic and financial projects to see further and to do things differently, to fuel the success of Canadian entrepreneurs.

Choosing BDC as your employer also means:

  • Flexible and competitive benefits, including an Employee Savings and Investment Plan where BDC matches part of your voluntary contributions, a Defined Benefit Pension Plan, a $750 wellness and health care spending account, to name a few

  • In addition to paid vacation each year, five personal days, sick days as necessary, and our offices are closed from December 25 to January 1

  • A hybrid work model that truly balances work and personal life

  • Opportunities for learning, training and development, and much more...

Explore the BDC Way in our Culture Book


*This position requires bilingualism in French and English.


POSITION OVERVIEW


At BDC, we are the only bank dedicated exclusively to supporting Canadian entrepreneurs. As Canada's business bank, we help entrepreneurs create and develop strong businesses through financing, advisory services, and capital investments. In an increasingly complex and rapidly evolving risk environment, Integrated Risk Management plays a critical role in enabling informed decision-making, supporting resilience, and ensuring the Bank continues to fulfill its mandate while prudently managing risks.

As a Senior Analyst, Integrated Risk Management, you will play a key role in strengthening the Bank's risk management framework by supporting the design, execution, and continuous enhancement of enterprise-wide stress testing and model risk management programs.

You will contribute to assessing the Bank's resilience under a range of adverse economic and financial scenarios, including emerging risks related to economic uncertainty, geopolitical developments, climate change, and other evolving risk drivers. Through rigorous analysis and effective challenge, you will provide valuable insights that support strategic decision-making, capital planning, and risk management across the organization.

You will also help ensure that models used throughout the Bank are effectively governed, appropriately validated, and managed in accordance with internal standards, regulatory expectations, and industry best practices.

Working closely with business lines, Finance, Treasury, Risk Management, and model owners, you will provide analysis, oversight, and recommendations that contribute to sound risk governance and informed decision-making across the Bank.


CHALLENGES TO BE MET


Stress Testing

  • Support the planning, development, execution, and continuous improvement of the Bank's enterprise-wide and ad hoc stress testing exercises.
  • Contribute to the design of macroeconomic and financial stress scenarios and assess their impact on earnings, balance sheet performance, capital adequacy, liquidity, and risk exposures.
  • Consolidate, analyze, and interpret stress testing results and communicate key findings to stakeholders through reports and presentations.
  • Assist in the review and challenge of stress testing assumptions, methodologies, models, and results to support effective risk oversight.
  • Support the development, enhancement, and maintenance of stress testing methodologies, tools, and analytical frameworks.
  • Monitor emerging risks, economic developments, industry trends, and regulatory expectations to identify potential impacts on the Bank and inform scenario development.
  • Conduct quantitative and qualitative research to support strategic initiatives, regulatory requirements, and program enhancements.
  • Collaborate with internal stakeholders across Risk Management, Finance, Treasury, and business units to support the delivery of the stress testing program.
  • Contribute to the evolution and maturity of the Bank's stress testing capabilities and related governance practices.

Model Risk Management

  • Maintain the Bank's Model Inventory and help ensure its completeness, accuracy, and ongoing effectiveness.
  • Coordinate and monitor model validation activities to ensure timely execution and compliance with established requirements.
  • Track, challenge, and report on the remediation of model validation findings and model-related issues.
  • Support the preparation of materials and reporting for the Model Risk Committee and other governance forums.
  • Collaborate with model owners, model developers, validators, and other stakeholders to support effective model lifecycle management.
  • Assist in the development and enhancement of model risk management policies, standards, procedures, and governance processes.
  • Monitor evolving industry practices and regulatory developments related to model risk management and contribute recommendations for continuous improvement.
  • Participate in initiatives aimed at strengthening model governance, transparency, and risk management across the organization.

WHAT WE ARE LOOKING FOR


Education and Experience

  • Bachelor's degree in Finance, Economics, Commerce, Business Administration, Mathematics, Statistics, Data Science, Engineering, or a related field.
  • A minimum of 5 years of relevant experience in stress testing, model risk management, financial risk management, capital management, quantitative analysis, or a related discipline within the financial services industry.
  • Knowledge of Canadian banking practices, risk management frameworks, and applicable regulatory expectations, including OSFI guidance, is considered an asset.

Knowledge and Skills

  • Strong analytical and problem-solving abilities with the capacity to interpret complex quantitative and qualitative information.
  • Demonstrated ability to work with large datasets and perform financial and risk analysis using Microsoft Excel and other analytical tools.
  • Strong understanding of risk management principles, stress testing concepts, and model governance practices.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to clearly communicate complex concepts to both technical and non-technical audiences.
  • Proven ability to prepare high-quality reports, presentations, and executive briefing materials.
  • Strong relationship-building and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to collaborate effectively across teams and functions.
  • Sound professional judgment, intellectual curiosity, and a continuous improvement mindset.
  • Ability to manage multiple priorities, work independently, and deliver high-quality results in a fast-paced environment.
  • Proficiency with Microsoft Office applications, particularly Excel, PowerPoint, and Word.
  • Bilingualism (French and English), spoken and written, is required.

The ideal candidate will use advanced simulation tools to predict product performance, guide design decisions, and ensure structural integrity, reliability, and regulatory compliance.

Qualifications You Must Have:

  • Strong proficiency with commercial FEA software (ANSYS Workbench preferred but Abaqus, NX Nastran, or similar software is acceptable).

  • Solid understanding of structural mechanics, structural load path, materials behavior, and engineering fundamentals.

  • Experience analyzing complex geometries and assemblies.

  • Strong communication and technical writing skills.


Qualifications You Prefer:

  • Experience with scripting and automation tools (Python, MATLAB, VBA, APDL, etc.).

  • Experience leading or guiding mechanical analysis teams as a subject matter expert or related level of responsibilities.

  • Familiarity with CAD software (Creo, Siemens NX, SolidWorks, etc.).

  • Experience with nonlinear analysis, fatigue analysis, harmonic & random vibration analysis, damage tolerance, and fracture mechanics.
