title: Program Coordinator, Clinical Education Interior (RIH)
location: UBC Hospital Site - Kamloops, BC, Canada
description:
Staff - Union

Job Category

BCGEU Okanagan Support Staff

Job Profile

BCGEU OK Salaried - Support Services Assistant 4

Job Title

Program Coordinator, Clinical Education Interior (RIH)

Department

UBCO | Administrative Support Kamloops | Medical Education | Faculty of Medicine

Compensation Range

$4,836.00 - $5,547.00 CAD Monthly

Posting End Date

September 24, 2026

Note: Applications will be accepted until 11:59 PM on the Posting End Date.

Job End Date

Ongoing

This position is based in Kamloops, BC.

Please include a cover letter with your application.

Background

The UBC Faculty of Medicine (FoM), through its Office of Postgraduate Medical Education (PGME), provides postgraduate medical training in Royal College and Family Medicine training programs. These programs span multiple training sites and are distributed to clinical academic campuses and affiliated regional centers across the province. To accommodate the government funded increase in MD undergraduate graduates, the PGME program has progressively increased the number of residents admitted to its programs. Since 2003, the resident cohort has grown from approximately 700 to more than 1,400.

The Postgraduate Medical Education programs currently provide training across more than five sites throughout the Interior region and includes both Family Medicine and Royal College residency programs. The most recent of these is the Royal College of Physicians and Surgeons of Canada (RCPSC) Residency Program in Internal Medicine (RCPSC‑IM). At any given time, more than 70 residents are situated in the Interior region, with continued growth projected as distributed medical education expands over the coming years.

The Southern Medical Program (SMP) is one of four distributed Medical Undergraduate Programs (MDUP) within the University of British Columbia’s Faculty of Medicine. The program is delivered in partnership with the University of British Columbia (UBC), the University of Northern British Columbia (UNBC), and the University of Victoria (UVic), and in close collaboration with the Interior Health Authority (IH). The SMP delivers education and training at five primary education sites—UBC Okanagan, Kelowna General Hospital, Vernon Jubilee Hospital, Royal Inland Hospital, and Kootenay Boundary Regional Hospital—as well as at regional and community hospitals, community health centers, and family physician offices across approximately 30 communities throughout the Interior.

Job Summary

This position provides complex coordination and administrative oversight for the delivery of distributed Internal Medicine clinical education activities and other Postgraduate Medical Education (PGME) and Medical Undergraduate Program (MDUP) program delivery in the Interior Health Region. Examples of coordination and support for UBC PGME programs include Family Practice, Enhanced Skills: CCFP Emergency Medicine.

Organizational Status

This position reports directly to the Site Coordinator (UG/PG) – Royal Inland Hospital (RIH). The position will also receive direction from UBC, Faculty of Medicine departmental faculty and administrative leaders ((for example Internal Medicine and Enhanced Skills CCFP-EM), as well as other Postgraduate (PG) and Undergraduate (UG) program leadership as appropriate.

This position is expected to work closely and effectively with Faculty Leadership, Program Managers, Program Administrators, Clinical Faculty, and Interior Health administrators throughout the region. The incumbent interacts independently with residents and medical students, clinical faculty, medical office assistants, and hospital administrators across the Interior Health (IH) Authority; as well as with University of British Columbia (UBC) Faculty of Medicine (FoM) departments and distributed sites, and external organizations such as the College of Physicians and Surgeons of British Columbia and Resident Doctors of BC.


Work Performed

Responsibilities include initial assistance with the design and development of the new Internal Medicine (IM) Interior PGME program planned for launch in July 2027. Following program launch, the role is responsible for the effective administration and ongoing operations support for successful program delivery.


Administrative

  • Provides complex administrative and program support for distributed Postgraduate Medical Education (PGME) and, Undergraduate Medical Program (MDUP) activities in the Interior region.
  • Supports curriculum development, course delivery, and ongoing program design for the Interior Internal Medicine program
  • Manages resident remediation, probation, and appeal documentation in accordance with Faculty of Medicine policies.
  • Assists with the development of new rotations in the Interior, including supporting Royal College of Physicians and Surgeons of Canada (RCPSC) compliance requirements and onboarding new site leads.
  • Acts as a primary point of contact for residents, medical students, faculty, preceptors, medical office assistants, and hospital administrators, ensuring responsive and professional service.
  • Responds to program inquiries and interprets policies, procedures, and guidelines related to postgraduate and undergraduate medical education.
  • Maintains resident and learner records, personnel files, attendance records, correspondence, and licensure documentation in accordance with UBC and accreditation requirements.
  • Prepares and manages resident documentation and correspondence, including confirmation of training, verification letters, credentialing documentation, and other program related paperwork.
  • Supports accreditation processes by compiling data, coordinating documentation, and assisting with reviews, surveys, and reporting as required.
  • Maintains and updates procedures and operational documentation and contributes to continuous improvement of administrative processes.
  • Monitors learner issues, concerns, and performance indicators and escalates matters to Program Directors, Faculty Leads, or Program Managers as appropriate.
  • Supports learner wellbeing by facilitating communication between learners, faculty, and administrative leadership and assisting with the coordination of learner supports when required.
  • Provides backup coverage for administrative colleagues during absences and performs other related duties as assigned in support of FoM activities in the region
  • Maintains and updates procedures manual for the position
  • Supports facilities maintenance, operational upkeep, and renovation coordination for Interior Health and the UBC FoM educational and administrative spaces within the hospital-based learning environments

Scheduling

  • Develops, maintains, and manages complex schedules for resident and student rotations, electives, call schedules, and academic activities across distributed sites.
  • Coordinates Academic Half Days, teaching sessions, and related educational activities, including scheduling, logistics, and communication with faculty and learners.
  • Tracks and manages resident vacation, sick leave, conference leave, and other absences using approved systems such as RMS and One45.
  • Liaises with internal and external stakeholders, including hospital services and clinical departments, to resolve scheduling conflicts and implement changes as required.
  • Liaises regularly with residents, preceptors, facilitators and lecturers to coordinate any scheduling changes. Maintains resident schedules, call schedules, and Internal Medicine resident rounds.
  • Arranges electives as required.
  • Coordinate and obtain pre-approval for travel to attend academic half days while participating in out-of-town electives.
  • Assists Faculty leadership in the development of new rotations within the Interior Health Authority that meet the Royal College Training Requirements for Internal Medicine, including identifying and working with new site leads to establish rotation capacities, creation of rotation-specific objectives, orienting new leads to evaluation systems, coaching residents in difficulty etc.

Assessment and Evaluation

  • Coordinates, distributes, and monitors resident and preceptor evaluations using approved UBC systems, such as One45.
  • Prepares and coordinates evaluations for review by the Program Director/Faculty Lead, including corresponding with preceptors and forwarding evaluations for review
  • Tracks completion of required assessments, including In‑Training Evaluation Reports (ITERs), Entrustable Professional Activities (EPAs), and other program specific evaluation tools.
  • Identifies low‑performance evaluations and supports remediation and follow‑up processes in collaboration with faculty leadership.
  • Prepares documentation and supports meetings and reviews related to learner progress, assessment outcomes, and program quality.
  • Gathers, collates and analyzes information on the discipline rotations/electives, including community and practice profiles, availability, and local contact information
  • Liaises with Faculty Leads and Program Managers regarding any learner/preceptor issues; supports conflict resolution and allocates supports for students with issues or concerns they may have during their placements to support their academic well-being in collaboration with SMP Student Affairs
  • Supports resident absences and leave requests in RMS/one45 (i.e. vacation dates, conference leaves, sick days, and leaves of absence) and notifies preceptors
  • Maintains resident files and tracks academic training record for residents (i.e. leaves, transfers, remediation, part-time training, etc.).
  • Prepares documentation as required including reference letters and verification of training letters
  • Supports annual process for appointments of Resident Lead and assists with orientation for incoming Resident Lead
  • Creates and maintains relevant content on the on-line learning platforms related to PG/UG learner rotations and electives in the region (currently these are MedNET, Entrada and One45)
  • Assists with identifying physicians requiring Clinical Faculty appointments and supports the relevant application process
  • Assists as required to prepare for Accreditation reviews. This may include compiling data for reporting and providing documentation, surveys, and reviews

Finance

  • Supports budget processes and financial forecasting activities using Workday, in accordance with Faculty of Medicine and UBC financial policies.
  • Processes and advises on resident reimbursements such as Special Conference funding.
  • Tracks and reconciles Resident Activity Fund (RAF) expenditures.
  • Processes resident travel, callback, and community rotation reimbursements through approved resident reimbursement systems, ensuring accuracy, timeliness, and compliance with established guidelines.
  • Tracks, reconciles, and enters teaching payments in accordance with UBC and Faculty of Medicine policies and procedures, and liaises with relevant members to resolve discrepancies as required.

Meetings, Events, and General Support

  • Assists with the planning and coordination of academic events, program meetings, recruitment activities, orientations, and other program related events.
  • Supports the Competency Committee activity for post-grad programs, including compiling resident data, preparing documentation, and coordinating related materials and meetings.
  • Coordinates meetings and supports standing and ad‑hoc committees, including preparation and distribution of agendas, supporting materials, minutes, and follow‑up actions.
  • Provides logistical and administrative support for videoconferencing, room bookings, and educational technology used in program delivery.
  • Participates in exam invigilation, Objective Structured Clinical Examinations (OSCEs), and simulated or assessment sessions as required.
  • Attends and contributes to program administrative meetings.

CaRMS

  • Assists the Interior Associate Program Director with the CaRMS selection process
  • Coordinates and organizes recruitment and program information events for the Canadian Residency Matching Service (CaRMS) annual recruitment and selection process, including applicant file review, interviews, information sessions etc.

Consequence of Error / Judgment

This position works within a high performing, collaborative team environment and is expected to actively participate in identifying and implementing solutions to complex issues. The incumbent must be able to work independently, exercise sound judgment, and set priorities in order to manage competing demands. The role requires the ability to make timely decisions, often under pressure, within a dynamic clinical education environment.

This position routinely handles inquiries and situations that may be urgent, contentious, and/or sensitive in nature and therefore requires a high degree of professionalism, discretion, and confidentiality. Errors in judgment, ineffective communication, or failure to apply appropriate policies and procedures may result in damaged relationships within the medical and academic community, including with faculty, preceptors, learners, and health authority partners.

Significant errors may lead to loss of preceptors for Faculty of Medicine education programs, disruption to resident and learner training experiences, and adverse impacts on program delivery. Such outcomes could compromise program effectiveness and result in long lasting negative impacts on distributed medical education in the Interior region.


Supervision Received

This position reports directly to the Site Coordinator (UG/PG) – Royal Inland Hospital (RIH). The position will also receive direction from departmental faculty and administrative leaders (for example Internal Medicine and Enhanced Skills CCFP-EM), as well as other Postgraduate (PG) and Undergraduate (UG) program leadership as appropriate.

The incumbent is expected to work with a minimal level of direct supervision while maintaining a high level of accuracy and accountability. The position requires initiative, strong attention to detail, sound judgment, and the ability to independently problem‑solve and troubleshoot issues as they arise. The incumbent is expected to apply discretion in determining appropriate courses of action and to follow through independently. Unusual or complex issues, or decisions for which clear procedures are not available, are referred to the relevant manager, Program Director or Faculty Lead, or Administrative Director for guidance, advice, and collaboration.

Supervision Given

Provides direction and coordination to others as the main liaison across all Interior sites and with provincial colleagues.


Qualifications

  • High school graduation and two (2) years of post‑secondary education. Minimum three (3) years’ experience, or the equivalent combination of education and experience.
  • Willingness to respect diverse perspectives, including perspectives in conflict with one’s own
  • Demonstrates a commitment to enhancing one’s own awareness, knowledge, and skills related to equity, diversity, and inclusion
  • Strong interpersonal, communication (written and verbal), and diplomacy skills.
  • Demonstrated project planning skills to meet deadlines and follow up, ensuring deliverables are met.
  • Demonstrated ability to develop and maintain effective working relationships with faculty, learners, staff, preceptors, and external partners.
  • Excellent organizational skills, with the ability to prioritize competing workloads and manage multiple tasks simultaneously.
  • Strong problem-solving skills, sound judgment, and the ability to work independently with minimal supervision.
  • High level of accuracy, attention to detail, tact, and discretion, including the ability to handle confidential and sensitive information appropriately.
  • Flexibility; comfortable working within ambiguity; invigorated by change, often requiring immediate responses and solutions within a high stakes environment.
  • Advanced or intermediate proficiency in Microsoft Office applications (Word, Excel, Outlook, PowerPoint) and collaboration tools such as MS Teams and SharePoint.
  • Ability to learn and work with medical education systems and databases; prior experience with One45, Resident Management System (RMS), and Workday is an asset.
  • Ability to work outside of regular business hours as required.
  • Familiarity with rural and urban communities throughout the Interior and other British Columbia regional health authorities is an asset.
  • Some travel to FoM Education sites and other hospital/clinic sites may be required.
  • Role requires flexibility to assist with special events outside of normal working hours.

Candidates are expected to demonstrate strong delivery background in financial industry, preferably in OTC products. We expect depth of knowledge in Java stack. Candidate should be willing to drive re-architecture and lead by example. Candidate should be able to work in Kubernetes based deployments in both on-prem and external cloud and deal with variety of build technologies. Candidate will have limited line management responsibilities, intentionally designed to provide focus on coding & business analysis.

Growth opportunities are excellent and in future candidate will have options of choosing between engineering, business analysis or and management tracks. The team you’ll be working with is distributed across 3 countries.

Key Responsibilities


Hands-On Engineering & Re-Architecture
• Be an active, hands-on contributor to the codebase — designing, building, and reviewing new Java microservices that replace legacy components.
• Lead the re-engineering of the existing Oasys codebase, breaking down monolithic structures and migrating business logic into a modern, event-driven microservices architecture.
• Establish and enforce application methodologies and standards for program analysis, design, coding, testing, and implementation across the engineering organization.
• Analyze complex business processes, system workflows, and industry standards to define solutions to high-level problems, particularly in the context of post-trade processing and financial accounting.

AI-Assisted Development & Change Leadership
• Serve as the organization's champion and change agent for AI-assisted software development, driving the adoption of tools such as GitHub Copilot, Claude, OpenAI Codex, and Devin across the engineering team.
• Bring deep, practical expertise in prompt engineering and apply it to accelerate development workflows, improve code generation quality, and automate repetitive engineering tasks.
• Lead by example — demonstrating how AI tooling can be integrated into day-to-day development practices to meaningfully improve productivity and code quality.


Transformation Execution
• Lead the design and delivery of the new Oasys platform in parallel with the Sybase IQ exit, overseeing the build-out of high-throughput data pipelines, distributed data stores, and scalable data processing frameworks.
• Drive the integration of new systems and functions to meet strategic goals, deploy new capabilities, and continuously enhance processes.
• Utilize advanced knowledge of the Oasys system flows and a comprehensive understanding of multiple technology domains to achieve transformation milestones on time and at scale.

Leadership & People Development
• Build, lead, and inspire a high-performing, multi-disciplinary engineering organization in Pune.
• Allocate work effectively and act as an advisor and coach to developers, architects, analysts, and new team members, fostering a culture of engineering excellence and continuous learning.
• Develop the next generation of technical leaders within the team.

Stakeholder Engagement
• Influence and negotiate with senior global technology and business leaders, communicating the transformation vision, progress, and risks with clarity and confidence.
• Consult with end users and business stakeholders to identify system function specifications and incorporate them into the overall system design.
• Manage large program budgets and cross-functional, multi-project delivery.

Risk & Governance
• Appropriately assess risk when business decisions are made, demonstrating particular consideration for the firm's reputation and safeguarding Citigroup, its clients, and assets.
• Drive compliance with applicable laws, rules, and regulations, adhering to Policy and applying sound ethical judgment regarding personal behavior, conduct, and business practices.
• Escalate, manage, and report control issues with full transparency.

Qualifications

Required:
• 15+ years of progressive experience in technology, with a significant portion in senior technical leadership roles — and a continued, active hands-on involvement in software development.
• Java Expertise: Expert-level background in Java, including designing and building resilient, high-throughput distributed systems and microservices architectures. Must be comfortable writing and reviewing production code.
• Big Data Mastery: Deep, hands-on expertise in modern Big Data platforms using technologies such as Apache Spark, Kafka, Presto/Trino, and distributed data lakes or lakehouses.
• Transformation Track Record: Demonstrated success leading complex, multi-year legacy modernization and re-engineering programs from concept to production in a global enterprise environment.
• Change Leadership: A proven change agent with the ability to shift engineering culture, introduce modern practices, and bring teams along on a transformation journey.
• Leadership: Exceptional organizational leadership skills with experience managing and developing multiple teams of senior engineers, architects, and technical leads.

Preferred (Highly Desirable):
• Prompt Engineering & AI Tooling: Deep, practical experience with prompt engineering and hands-on use of AI-assisted development tools (e.g., GitHub Copilot, Claude, OpenAI Codex, Devin) to drive engineering productivity and code quality at scale.
• Financial Domain: Experience in financial services, particularly in trading systems, post-trade processing, sub-ledger accounting, or risk platforms.
• Cloud Platforms: Experience with public or private cloud platforms (AWS, GCP, Azure) and their associated data and compute services.

Education:
• Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent professional experience.
• Master's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related quantitative discipline is preferred.

Why Join Us?
• Lead by Example: This is a role for a builder, not just a manager. You will be in the code, setting the standard, and driving change from the front.
• Be a Change Agent: Shape how an entire engineering organization thinks about modern development practices, AI tooling, and software craftsmanship.
• Unmatched Scale: Work on a system that processes millions of trades daily, presenting engineering challenges that are rare in their complexity and consequence.
• Build Something Lasting: Lead the creation of a modern platform that will serve as the foundation of Citi's post-trade operations for years to come.

Job Description

The Quality Assurance Coordinator supports the implementation, monitoring, and continuous improvement of the TGP Quality Management System (QMS) and project-specific requirements under Schedule 11. The role works closely with construction, technical, subcontractors, and other disciplines to ensure all Inspection & Test Plans (ITPs), quality records, and Non-Conformance processes are effectively managed and fully compliant.

  • Liaise with subcontractors and internal departments (engineering, construction, and materials) to obtain missing documentation or clarifications.

title: IT Quality Intermediate Analyst Officer
description:
Citi is looking for a Quality Assurance Engineer who will build and execute automated test solutions that directly protect the quality of financial technology products used by clients and teams across the business. In this role, you will design and run test strategies spanning automation, API, performance, and user acceptance testing — working at the intersection of engineering and quality assurance within Citi's IT Quality function. Your work will have a direct impact on the reliability and delivery speed of software released into production.

Responsibilities

  • Build and execute automation scripts using Selenium and Cypress to expand integration, regression, and UI test coverage across financial technology applications.

  • Integrate automated test suites into CI/CD pipelines to enable continuous testing and faster feedback loops throughout the software delivery lifecycle.

  • Develop API test suites using Postman or SoapUI to validate microservices and verify payload accuracy across system interactions.

  • Design and run performance and load test scenarios in JMeter to detect system bottlenecks before they reach production.

  • Write complex SQL queries to verify data extraction accuracy and confirm metadata is stored correctly in relational databases.

  • Review automation scripts written by team members to maintain code quality, readability, and adherence to coding standards.

Apply today to bring your quality engineering skills to Citi and help shape the reliability of financial technology that matters.

title: UX Design Associate
description:
Who We Are

At Kyndryl, we design, build, manage and modernize the mission-critical technology systems that the world depends on every day. So why work at Kyndryl? We are always moving forward – always pushing ourselves to go further in our efforts to build a more equitable, inclusive world for our employees, our customers and our communities.

The Role

Why Kyndryl:

We’re a purpose-driven company committed to innovation and empowering our people. Here, your work contributes to meaningful outcomes for clients and communities.

Your Future at Kyndryl

Every position at Kyndryl offers a way forward to grow your career. We have opportunities that you won’t find anywhere else, including hands-on experience, learning opportunities, and the chance to certify in all four major platforms. Whether you want to broaden your knowledge base or narrow your scope and specialize in a specific sector, you can find your opportunity here.

You’re good at what you do and possess the required experience to provide it. However, equally as important – you have a growth mindset; keen to drive your own personal and professional development. You are customer-focused – someone who prioritizes customer success in your work. And finally, you’re open and borderless – naturally inclusive in how you work with others.

Kyndryl is committed to creating a diverse environment and is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, national origin, genetics, disability, age, or veteran status. Kyndryl is also committed to compliance with all fair employment practices regarding citizenship and immigration status.

Your role
As an AI UX Designer at Kyndryl, you will lead the design activities that connect insight, imagination, and execution for the next era of computing. You aren’t just building interfaces; you are defining the mental models and interaction patterns that allow humans to collaborate seamlessly with autonomous agents.

Join Kyndryl and gain the trust, autonomy and teamwork to help define what comes next for us, our customers and global industries as a whole.

What you will do
Humanize Complex Intelligence
•Architect intentional journeys: You’ll lead user research to uncover pain points in the human-AI relationship, creating journey maps that turn the complexity of multi-step agentic reasoning into clarity for the end user.
•Design for non-deterministic UI: You will move beyond static wireframes to create dynamic interaction patterns that handle AI latency, ambiguity, and error states gracefully, ensuring users always feel in control of the autonomous process.

Choreograph the Collaborative Loop
•Facilitate co-creation: Lead workshops and usability tests to balance desirability with feasibility, working closely with creative technologists and AI engineers to ensure the intelligence of the system matches the intuition of the user.
•Master Human-in-the-Loop (HITL): Design the critical hand-off moments where an agent needs human validation, ensuring that transparency and trust are built into every automated workflow.

Advocate for Inclusive Evolution
•Champion ethical design: Advocate for accessibility and inclusive intelligence, ensuring that our AI experiences are equitable and work for all users across diverse backgrounds.
•Shape the interface era: Maintain a strong perspective on how agentic AI drives human-centered

design, using clear storytelling to inspire alignment across the full design lifecycle—from discovery to delivery.

Kyndryl currently does not require employees to be fully vaccinated against COVID-19, however, if you are hired to work at a client, customer, or partner location, you may be required to show proof of vaccination to align with their respective COVID-19 vaccination policies. Those who believe they are eligible may apply for a medical or religious accommodation prior to the start of employment.

Who You Are

Required skills and experience
•UX / experience design or a related field, with a strong portfolio of enterprise or innovation-studio projects
•Deep understanding of user-centered design, interaction design, and usability testing methods
•Comfortable facilitating co-creation sessions and presenting to clients
•Direct experience with AI, agentic AI/UX and data-driven design is preferred
•A POV on how AI can drive human-centered design and co-creation
•Experience with emerging AI assistants (Figma Make, MiroAI, Adobe Firefly, Lovable, etc)
•Fluent in Figma or Sketch, or similar prototyping tools
•Experience working with developers / product managers to translate research into delivery
•Excellent communication skills in English

The compensation range for the position in the U.S. is -

$63,360 to $114,120based on a full-time schedule.

Your actual compensation may vary depending on your geography, job-related skills and experience. For part time roles, the compensation will be adjusted appropriately. The pay or salary range will not be below any applicable state, city or local minimum wage requirement.

There is a different applicable compensation range for the following work locations:

California (San Francisco Bay Area):$76,080 to $137,040

California (All Other):$69,720 to $125,640

Colorado: $63,360 to $114,120

Massachusetts$63,360 to $125,640

New York City: $76,080 to $137,040

Washington: $69,720 to $125,640

Washington DC:$69,720 to $125,640

This position will be eligible for Kyndryl’s discretionary annual bonus program, based on performance and subject to the terms of Kyndryl’s applicable plans. You may also receive a comprehensive benefits package which includes medical and dental coverage, disability, retirement benefits, paid leave, and paid time off. Note: If this is a sales commission eligible role, you will be eligible to participate in a sales commission plan in lieu of the annual discretionary bonus program.
Applications will be accepted on a rolling basis.

Being You

Diversity is a whole lot more than what we look like or where we come from, it’s how we think and who we are. We welcome people of all cultures, backgrounds, and experiences. But we’re not doing it single-handily: Our Kyndryl Inclusion Networks are only one of many ways we create a workplace where all Kyndryls can find and provide support and advice. This dedication to welcoming everyone into our company means that Kyndryl gives you – and everyone next to you – the ability to bring your whole self to work, individually and collectively, and support the activation of our equitable culture. That’s the Kyndryl Way.

What You Can Expect

With state-of-the-art resources and Fortune 100 clients, every day is an opportunity to innovate, build new capabilities, new relationships, new processes, and new value. Kyndryl cares about your well-being and prides itself on offering benefits that give you choice, reflect the diversity of our employees and support you and your family through the moments that matter – wherever you are in your life journey. Our employee learning programs give you access to the best learning in the industry to receive certifications, including Microsoft, Google, Amazon, Skillsoft, and many more. Through our company-wide volunteering and giving platform, you can donate, start fundraisers, volunteer, and search over 2 million non-profit organizations. At Kyndryl, we invest heavily in you, we want you to succeed so that together, we will all succeed.

Get Referred!

title: Scrum Master
description:

As a Scrum Master, you will play a pivotal role in facilitating the agile delivery of healthcare software solutions while also providing critical analysis and insights to drive business success.


What your impact will be:


1. Scrum Master Duties:

  • Serve as a Scrum Master for up to two Agile teams, ensuring adherence to Scrum principles, practices, and ceremonies.
  • Facilitate sprint planning, daily stand-ups, sprint reviews, and retrospectives to drive team collaboration, transparency, and continuous improvement.
  • Remove impediments and obstacles that hinder the progress of the team, fostering a culture of problem-solving and self-organization.
  • Coach team members on Agile methodologies and best practices, promoting a culture of agility, innovation, and accountability while following set processes that may be adapted to project needs.

title: Outreach Specialist
description:
Maryland Legal Aid (MLA) advocates with and for Marylanders experiencing poverty to achieve equity and social justice through free civil legal services, community collaboration, and systemic change.


Since 1911, Maryland Legal Aid has provided high-quality legal aid to vulnerable, low-income people and communities – helping to remedy their civil legal issues and become empowered to overcome challenges, achieve stability and independence, and reach their goals. MLA also identifies and seeks to remedy systemic barriers. MLA’s core work includes eviction and foreclosure prevention, family law, children’s rights, consumer protection, securing public benefits, and access to healthcare. MLA advocates operate primarily through the courts, via individual representation of indigent clients, but also engage in impact litigation, public communication and outreach, and policy advocacy.


Through this holistic approach, Maryland Legal Aid serves to amplify the voices of tens of thousands of economically disadvantaged and vulnerable Marylanders each year and seeks to be a leader in the legal services field nationwide.


Job Summary:

MLA seeks an organized, collaborative, creative, impassioned individual as the Outreach Specialist who will lead targeted outreach activities for Community Lawyering and Development in the Midwestern Maryland office. As a member of a statewide outreach team, the Outreach Specialist will work closely with the Community Outreach Manager and regional office staff on developing and executing strategic, data-informed, relationship-driven outreach to communities with a high need for information about the identified priority issues of Community Lawyering and Development, the Tenant Right to Counsel Project, and MLA’s legal services.

The Outreach Specialist will engage externally with community organizations, anchor institutions, service providers, and grassroots partners to develop strategic relationships and to foster collaborations. The position will also require analysis and application of internal and external data to develop targets and high-impact strategies for outreach. The position will also entail frequent collaboration with MLA colleagues on coordinated outreach strategies, effective messaging, and creating media opportunities.


Duties and Responsibilities:

  • Build stakeholder relationships in furtherance of the targeted outreach objectives; foster and grow collaborations among community organizations, grassroots organizations, service providers, and anchor institutions.
  • Strategize, plan, and execute outreach, training, and media opportunities in communities in partnership with community-based entities or leaders focused on housing justice, the Tenant Right to Counsel Project and other Community Lawyering and Development priority legal areas.
  • Identify larger trends and issues for community members and clients, working with MLA staff, external partners, and directly impacted residents to develop strategies informed by the values and best practices outlined by the Strategic Outreach Plan.
  • Actively contribute to and participate in community-based and tenant-led meetings and activities.
  • Contribute to required programmatic reporting and provide quantitative and qualitative data for evaluation of the Office/Unit’s outreach strategies.

title: UX Design Associate
description:
Who We Are

At Kyndryl, we run and reimagine the mission-critical technology systems that drive advantage for the world’s leading businesses. We are at the heart of progress; with proven expertise and a continuous flow of AI-powered insight, enabling smarter decisions, faster innovation, and a lasting competitive edge. Join us and experience a flexible, supportive environment where your well-being is prioritized and your potential can thrive.

The Role

Why Kyndryl:

We’re a purpose-driven company committed to innovation and empowering our people. Here, your work contributes to meaningful outcomes for clients and communities.

Your Future at Kyndryl

Every position at Kyndryl offers a way forward to grow your career. We have opportunities that you won’t find anywhere else, including hands-on experience, learning opportunities, and the chance to certify in all four major platforms. Whether you want to broaden your knowledge base or narrow your scope and specialize in a specific sector, you can find your opportunity here.

You’re good at what you do and possess the required experience to provide it. However, equally as important – you have a growth mindset; keen to drive your own personal and professional development. You are customer-focused – someone who prioritizes customer success in your work. And finally, you’re open and borderless – naturally inclusive in how you work with others.

Kyndryl is committed to creating a diverse environment and is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, national origin, genetics, disability, age, or veteran status. Kyndryl is also committed to compliance with all fair employment practices regarding citizenship and immigration status.

Your role
As an AI UX Designer at Kyndryl, you will lead the design activities that connect insight, imagination, and execution for the next era of computing. You aren’t just building interfaces; you are defining the mental models and interaction patterns that allow humans to collaborate seamlessly with autonomous agents.

Join Kyndryl and gain the trust, autonomy and teamwork to help define what comes next for us, our customers and global industries as a whole.

What you will do
Humanize Complex Intelligence
•Architect intentional journeys: You’ll lead user research to uncover pain points in the human-AI relationship, creating journey maps that turn the complexity of multi-step agentic reasoning into clarity for the end user.
•Design for non-deterministic UI: You will move beyond static wireframes to create dynamic interaction patterns that handle AI latency, ambiguity, and error states gracefully, ensuring users always feel in control of the autonomous process.

Choreograph the Collaborative Loop
•Facilitate co-creation: Lead workshops and usability tests to balance desirability with feasibility, working closely with creative technologists and AI engineers to ensure the intelligence of the system matches the intuition of the user.
•Master Human-in-the-Loop (HITL): Design the critical hand-off moments where an agent needs human validation, ensuring that transparency and trust are built into every automated workflow.

Advocate for Inclusive Evolution
•Champion ethical design: Advocate for accessibility and inclusive intelligence, ensuring that our AI experiences are equitable and work for all users across diverse backgrounds.
•Shape the interface era: Maintain a strong perspective on how agentic AI drives human-centered

design, using clear storytelling to inspire alignment across the full design lifecycle—from discovery to delivery.

Who You Are

Required skills and experience
•UX / experience design or a related field, with a strong portfolio of enterprise or innovation-studio projects
•Deep understanding of user-centered design, interaction design, and usability testing methods
•Comfortable facilitating co-creation sessions and presenting to clients
•Direct experience with AI, agentic AI/UX and data-driven design is preferred
•A POV on how AI can drive human-centered design and co-creation
•Experience with emerging AI assistants (Figma Make, MiroAI, Adobe Firefly, Lovable, etc)
•Fluent in Figma or Sketch, or similar prototyping tools
•Experience working with developers / product managers to translate research into delivery
•Excellent communication skills in English

$63,360 to $114,120based on a full-time schedule.

Being You

The “Kyn” in Kyndryl means kinship, which represents the strong bonds we have with each other, our customers and our communities. This dedication to welcoming everyone into our company means that Kyndryl gives you the ability to thrive and contribute to our culture of empathy and shared success. That’s The Kyndryl Way.

What You Can Expect


Your career with us isn’t just a job—it’s an adventure with purpose. We offer a dynamic, hybrid-friendly culture that supports your well-being and empowers you to grow. Our Be Well programs are thoughtfully designed to support your financial, mental, physical, and social health—because we know that when you feel your best, you do your best.

You’ll develop in-demand skills to grow your career and achieve your ambitions with access to cutting-edge learning opportunities—from certifications with Microsoft, Google, and Amazon to coaching and hands-on experiences. Prospect Development and Research Coordinator

The Prospect Development and Research Coordinator will work as a member of the Endeavor Health foundations’ Philanthropy Operations team to support the identification, research and analysis of prospects for cultivation and solicitation to drive the foundations’ philanthropic portfolio growth and revenue raised in support of Endeavor Health initiatives. Areas of philanthropic support include clinical excellence, patient care, innovative research, and training the next generation of clinicians and staff.

The Endeavor Health foundations seek a detail-oriented and enthusiastic team member to provide fundraising support across the foundations in pipeline development and donor outreach. This position will maintain data integrity and prospect qualifications related to portfolios and pipelines to increase donor loyalty and upgrades to gifts. The candidate should be a problem-solver and an analytical thinker, operating under the direction of the Prospect Development and Research Manager to support the delivery of complex data. The Coordinator will work collaboratively with members of the Philanthropy Operations and foundations’ teams to support fundraising goals.

Position Highlights:

  • Position: Prospect Development and Research Coordinator

  • Location: Evanston or Arlington Heights, IL

  • Full Time/Part Time: Full time (40 hours)

  • Hours: Monday-Friday, 8:00am-4:30pm

  • Required Travel: travel to other Endeavor Health locations may be required for meetings

What you will do:

  • With direction from the Prospect Development and Research Manager and Analyst, conduct proactive and reactive research on prospects and donors to produce thorough, formatted profiles to advance prospect identification, qualification, cultivation and solicitation, including use of wealth screening and data modeling industry tools to enrich prospect evaluations and assessments.

  • Understand and adhere to established ethical standards regarding prospect research, particularly in maintaining confidentiality, discretion, and abiding by HIPAA standards throughout all work conducted.

  • Support the Prospect Development team and foundation teams on donor moves management. Track pipeline progress and donor activity through timely and accurate maintenance of key prospect details in the CRM, while supporting dynamic portfolio activity by working closely with the Prospect Development team and frontline fundraisers.

  • With guidance from Prospect Development Manager and Analyst, maintain and update Standard Operating Procedures to ensure consistency of workflows to inform accurate reporting, analytics and data outcomes across the foundations.

  • Keep up to date with current philanthropic research, industry professional organizations and benchmarked standards to consider best practices for the foundations’ strategies towards reaching goals.

  • Maintain an ongoing depth of knowledge of Endeavor Health’s programs, initiatives, personnel and opportunities to align with prospective donor engagement.

  • Other relevant duties as required to support donor development and outreach.

  • Education: Bachelor’s degree in Fundraising, Technology, Statistics, Business Administration, or related field, required

  • Certification: n/a

  • Experience:

    • 1-2+ years of experience working with data in a consumer or donor-focused environment, including at least 1 year in a development or related role, preferably in healthcare or higher education, required. Candidates should also enjoy working with data and donors.

    • 1-2+ years of experience with Salesforce or another donor CRM, preferred.

  • Unique or Preferred Skills:

    • Knowledge of prospect research and management in non-profits and experience with research tools and methods as well as writing research profiles. Some understanding of frontline fundraising domains and how they are supported by strong prospect development.

    • Proficiency with MS Office and proactively working with Salesforce or similar CRM is required.

    • Tech-savvy and avid learner with a keen interest in fundraising, nonprofit trends, data and donor relations.

    • Strong written, verbal, organizational, and interpersonal and communication skills.

    • Demonstrated ability to relate and interact warmly and professionally with individuals from diverse backgrounds, including system leadership, cross-departmental partners, vendors, prospects and discerning donors.

    • Ability to handle sensitive and confidential information appropriately and with discretion.

    • Excels in project planning: multi-tasking, goal setting, accountability, attention to detail and workload prioritization.

    • Strong written, verbal, organizational, and interpersonal and communication skills; demonstrated ability to relate well to individuals from diverse backgrounds.

    • Must be flexible and adaptable to changing priorities and proactively address challenges in a fast-paced, emerging and dynamic environment with ongoing deadlines.

    • Ability to constructively accept and process feedback and a collaborative working style.

As a Systems Engineer II - Modeling Simulation & Analysis Engineer, you will participate in challenging multi-disciplinary work across integrated product teams consisting of Guidance, Navigation & Control (GNC), Signal Processing and missile-and-sensor-level Performance Simulations. title: Senior Analyst, Salesforce
description:
LOCATION: Mexico City or Gudalajara Remote

REPORTS TO: Global CRM Manager

Company Background:

Ingredion is a Fortune 500 provider of ingredient solutions that helps nourish, comfort, sustain, and delight people around the world. Ingredion’s wide range of ingredient solutions is strategically designed to address changing consumer trends and preferences. Our specialty portfolio includes starch-based texturizers, clean and simple ingredients, plant-based proteins, sugar reduction and specialty sweeteners, and food systems. Our innovative ingredient solutions are used by consumers in everyday products, from foods and beverages to paper and pharmaceuticals. And we do it all in a planet-friendly sustainable manner.

We bring the potential of people, nature, and technology together to make life better.

The Sr. Salesforce Business Analyst will lead high value projects related to Salesforce in an agile development environment, working with business stakeholders, technical staff, and partners to deliver solutions that improve sales and sales support productivity and effectiveness through automation, process improvement, user experience, and analytics. The Sr. Salesforce Business Analyst will evaluate enhancement requests from end users to determine need, feasibility, and offer recommendations to optimize platform functionality and gain consensus among key business stakeholders on harmonized functional requirements with suggested prioritization based on anticipated business impact.


To deliver these solutions, the ideal candidate will become an expert in Ingredion’s business environment, how Salesforce is currently being utilized, and how it can be continuously improved to align with and support business objectives, strategies, and processes. You will lead requirements-gathering sessions, develop product roadmap recommendations, contribute to planning and prioritizing the work to be done, and oversee testing and change management activities and other project work required to bring solutions to light. Ideally you are a diligent, hardworking individual who learns new functions and processes rapidly, and consistently delivers outstanding results.

Additionally, the right candidate will advance CRM analytics to provide actionable insights for Go-To-Market teams and the broader organization to optimize business decisions and identify growth opportunities. This role is well-versed in business process documentation and will be expected to maintain documentation of CRM processes.

The position reports directly to the Global CRM Manager working closely with the Global IT function and Regional CRM business leads and other stakeholders to support an integrated approach to Commercial Excellence.

Core Responsibilities:

  • Work with the business to identify opportunities for driving sales productivity and effectiveness through technology, data, and process improvement.
  • Manage the product roadmap, prioritization, release planning, and delivery of key features for the business processes and technologies you oversee.
  • Perform the Senior Business Analyst role in often complex technical projects, overseeing requirements gathering, research, testing, deployment, documentation, training, communication, and user enablement.
  • Manage, track, and ensure the timely resolution of risks, blockers, issues, and bugs.
  • Review, test, and measure business impact of CRM enhancements to ensure they are providing business value and delivering expected ROI. Develop test cases and user acceptance testing (UAT) plans. Develop best practices for and oversee business user acceptance testing.
  • Stay current with Salesforce releases as well as relevant solutions and best practices in the marketplace, evaluating and implementing new features and solutions, as required.
  • Develop training materials and, in collaboration with Regional CRM Leads and Power Users, facilitate end user training sessions on the Salesforce.com application.
  • Measure and report on performance, achievements, and outcomes.
  • Participate in cross-functional teams that address strategic business issues involving CRM.
  • Partner with Salesforce and other partner vendor Customer Success management teams to drive engagement, adoption and utilization, and capability development.

This position is well-suited for you if you bring:

  • A passion for customers, demonstrated business acumen and digital first mindset
  • Experience managing and or implementing technology enabled end-to-end Customer Relationship Management and familiarity with Sales, Marketing and or Commercial processes
  • Understanding of the lead-to-cash processes, preferably within a B2B manufacturing environment
  • Process orientation with analytical skills to identify and tap improvement opportunities
  • Strong interpersonal and communication skills, with the ability to interact effectively and influence various levels of the organization across functions and or a variety of cultures/geographies
  • Attention to detail and ability to prioritize effectively within a fast-paced environment
  • Experience, working in a B2B environment and/or the manufacturing industry, preferably within the food, nutritional, specialty chemical industries or other relevant B2B environments

Qualified candidates will have:

  • Bachelor's degree or equivalent professional experience
  • 5+ years of increasing responsibility and impact in the areas of business analysis, product management, data analysis, system administration, solution architecture, or business intelligence
  • Salesforce certification is highly desired (e.g., Admin, Advanced Admin, Sales Cloud Consultant)
  • Deep Salesforce expertise, or translatable experience working with other CRM platforms, including system administration, user setup and maintenance, role hierarchy, profiles & permissions, security, page layouts, objects, fields, workflow, approval processes, formulas, queues, assignment rules, and data management
  • Experience with SAP or similar ERP system preferred
  • Experience in leading and managing complex projects with corresponding change management
  • Ability to drive results through collaboration, influence, relationship-building, and teamwork
  • Experience with software development methodologies, tools, and best practices
  • Strong quantitative analysis skills, including advanced knowledge of Excel
  • Ability to troubleshoot issues, identify root causes, and solve complex problems with focus on simplicity and scalability
  • Ability to work independently, with minimal supervision
  • Intellectual curiosity and attention to detail
  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills

title: Electrical, Control & Instrumentation (EC&I) Engineer
description:

Job Description:

Reporting to the Engineering & Maintenance (E&M) Manager, the Electrical, Control & Instrumentation (EC&I) Engineer is responsible for providing professional engineering expertise to support the safe, reliable, and efficient operation of research and development, inclusive of pilot scale equipment.

The EC&I Engineer is accountable for maintaining asset integrity, availability, and regulatory compliance through the implementation of effective maintenance strategies, engineering standards, reliability improvement programmes, and supporting capital projects. The role provides technical support across electrical distribution systems, control systems, instrumentation, automation, and functional safety, ensuring engineering solutions support operational requirements and business objectives.

The EC&I Engineer works collaboratively with operations, maintenance teams, contractors, and customers to deliver engineering excellence while maintaining compliance with applicable legislation, engineering standards, and management systems.

The role will be a site based operational role at Bengaluru R&D centre.

Key Accountabilities

  • Develop, implement, and continuously improve preventative and predictive maintenance strategies for all assigned EC&I assets.

  • Ensure electrical, control, and instrumentation systems are maintained to deliver safe, reliable, and compliant operations.

  • Support reliability improvement initiatives using structured engineering methodologies including Root Cause Analysis (RCA), Failure Modes and Effects Analysis (FMEA), and Reliability Centred Maintenance (RCM).

  • Monitor asset performance, analyse trends, and identify opportunities to improve reliability, availability, and maintainability.

  • Support lifecycle management of electrical and control system assets.

  • Provide technical support and specialist EC&I support for maintenance activities, troubleshooting, shutdowns, plant modifications, and unplanned events.

  • Diagnose complex electrical and control system faults and implement effective corrective actions.

  • Support operational teams in resolving equipment issues impacting safety, quality, production, or facility performance.

  • Specify, design, and review:

    • Electrical distribution systems

    • Motor control centres (MCCs)

    • Instrumentation systems

    • PLC and DCS control systems

    • Safety instrumented systems (SIS)

    • Field instrumentation and associated infrastructure

  • Provide technical assurance for equipment procurement and vendor selection.

  • Ensure all engineering changes are managed through the Management of Change (MoC) process and fully documented.

  • Support commissioning, start-up, validation, and performance testing activities.

  • Support and feed into maintenance plans, inspection programmes, and statutory compliance activities for EC&I equipment.

  • Support planning and execution of facility shutdowns, outages, and major maintenance events.

  • Support compliance with electrical safety legislation, standards, and company requirements.

  • Contribute to the design, maintenance, and verification of safety-related control systems.

  • Participate in HAZOPs, LOPA studies, risk assessments, SIL assessments, and other process safety activities as required.

  • Participate in incident investigations, audits, inspections, behavioural safety initiatives, and corrective action programmes.

  • Ensure all activities are undertaken in accordance with company HSSE standards and expectations.

Essential

  • Degree or Higher National Diploma (HND) in:

    • Electrical Engineering

    • Control & Instrumentation Engineering

    • Automation Engineering

    • Electronic Engineering

    • Or equivalent engineering discipline.

  • Confirmed experience within a research and development environment, utilities, laboratory, chemical, energy, or process environment.

  • Confirmed experience with control systems

  • Knowledge of:

    • Electrical distribution systems

    • Instrumentation and control systems

    • PLC and DCS platforms

    • CMMS systems

    • Root Cause Analysis methodologies

  • Experience leading engineering projects and modifications.

  • Understanding of engineering risk management and Management of Change processes.

  • Strong problem-solving and analytical skills.

title: Research Product Sr Associate - C11 - MUMBAI
description:

Deals with data collection and web scraping problems independently and has some latitude to solve complex data extraction and parsing issues. Integrates in-depth technical knowledge of web scraping frameworks and methodologies with a solid understanding of data management standards and practices. Good understanding of how the data collection and aggregation team integrates with Senior Analyst teams and other business areas in accomplishing research and investment objectives. Applies analytical thinking and knowledge of data analysis tools, web scraping technologies, and database systems. Requires attention to detail when executing jobs, documenting datasets, and performing data quality validation. Typically deals with variable data structures and public web datasets with potentially broader business and research impact. Applies professional judgment when interpreting and aggregating data and results. Breaks down raw, unstructured web information in a systematic, structured, and communicable manner. Developed communication and coordination skills are required in order to interface with a global team of Data Analysts and exchange complex dataset requirements. Moderate but direct impact through close contact with the business's core investment research activities. Quality and timeliness of data service provided will affect the effectiveness of own team and other closely related analyst teams.

Responsibilities:

  • Perform data extraction from major websites, public datasets, and subscription services to identify trends and spot investment opportunities.
  • Deliver aggregated data findings and propose new proprietary dataset opportunities that directly impact key research initiatives across the department.
  • Act as a point of contact for web scraping queries and interface with global teams of Data Analysts and Senior Analysts to gather requirements.
  • Manage multiple data extraction initiatives and scraping jobs simultaneously.
  • Part of a truly global team (strategically located in New York and Mumbai) with very experienced stakeholders who will hold you to an exceptionally high standard.
  • Act as curator of new datasets, documenting and performing detailed data quality validation and quality checks with a clear understanding of the business context.
  • Support, monitor, and maintain scheduled web scraping jobs built out with Python or Kapow to ensure continuous creation of data sets.
  • Understand the Citi Research business and its drivers, aligning data collection efforts with financial research goals.

Job Summary

Student Communications Services (SCS) provides communications leadership and support to UBC's Office of the Vice-President, Students (VPSO) and Enrolment Services (ES). This role is part of a cross-functional unit that works collaboratively to build and maintain a student-centred digital and communications ecosystem for UBC Vancouver students across web, social media, email, and other platforms.

This position actively champions, fosters and ensures the inclusion of voices that have been underrepresented or discouraged in the work they perform.


This position seeks to build and implement a student-focused content operations strategy that reflects the goals of the UBC Student Strategic Plan and connects with student audiences.


This role supports the Content Strategy and Operations for Student Communications Services, ensuring that UBC students on the Vancouver campus are informed, engaged, and empowered while navigating students.ubc.ca web content

The Web Content Specialist is a member of the Student Communications Services (SCS) team. This position reports to the Manager, Content Strategy. An integral member of the Student Communications Services team, they work in close collaboration with VP Students Office, Student Services, and Enrolment Services teams.

Work Performed

Web Content & Maintenance

  • Leads regular content audits with campus units to review and update web content in line with academic timelines and program priorities.
  • Recommends improvements to internal standards and processes to increase quality, performance, and stakeholder satisfaction.
  • Conducts operational management including documentation and training of staff related to the maintenance of the websites.

​

Web Content Design

  • Communicates and develops strong relationships with subject matter experts to understand service and program needs and their relation to web projects and requests.
  • Educates other teams about (and reviews adherence to) Student Content Style Guide, UBC web guidelines and accessibility standards.
  • Evaluates and provides recommendations for web content to ensure it upholds minimum Web Content Accessibility Guidelines (WCAG) requirements, as well as the Content Style Guide for.
  • Champions and fosters the inclusion of diverse student voices and perspectives, and ensures the representation of historically, persistently, or equity-seeking students.

Project Coordination

  • Develops detailed project briefs outlining objectives, target audience, key messages, tasks, timeline, and desired outcomes.
  • Establishes realistic project timelines and sets clear milestones, ensuring all involved parties are aligned and aware of key dates.

title: Senior Certified Inpatient Coding Specialist (Remote)
description:
At Memorial Hermann, we pursue a common goal of delivering high quality, efficient care while creating exceptional experiences for every member of our community. When we say every member of our community, that includes our employees. We know that when our employees feel cared for, heard and valued, they are inspired to create moments that exceed expectations, while prioritizing safety, compassion, personalization and efficiency. If you want to advance your career and contribute to our vision of creating healthier communities, now and for generations to come, we want you to be a part of our team.

Job Summary

POSITION IS REMOTE BUT YOU MUST MEET QUALIFICATIONS LISTED IN JOB DESCRIPTION.

**If you are located outside of the state of Texas -- you must be located in KANSAS, OKLAHOMA, TENNESSEE, LOUISIANA, GEORGIA, SOUTH CAROLINA, NORTH CAROLINA, or be willing to relocate to one of the eligible states (including Texas). **

Responsible for reviewing and abstracting inpatient medical records, as well as, identifying and assigning accurate medical codes for diagnosis, procedures and services in an inpatient setting. The Coding Specialist ensures that all data elements required for federal or state reporting and billing are collected and included in the patient’s demographic record. Typically reports to the Coding Manager.

Job Description

Minimum Qualifications

Education: High School Diploma or GED required; Associates degree in Health Information Management or any Healthcare Related Field preferred

Licenses/Certifications: Registered Health Information Technician (RHIT), Registered Health Information Administrator (RHIA), Certified Coding Associate (CCA), Certified Coding Specialist (CCS), or Certified Inpatient Coder (CIC) Coding Certification(s) from American Health Information Management Association (AHIMA) or American Association of Professional Coders (AAPC) required.

Experience / Knowledge / Skills:

  • Five (5) years of inpatient hospital coding experience required.

  • Experience coding in a level 1 trauma facility/academic teaching facility strongly preferred.

  • Effective oral and written communication skills.

  • Strong knowledge of ICD-10-CM and PCS coding.

  • Analytical skills necessary to interpret data contained in the health records and to assign appropriate codes.

  • Strong knowledge of human anatomy, physiology, medical terminology and surgical terminology.

  • Critical thinking, good judgment and decision making skills.

  • Knowledge of coding compliance policies, official coding guidelines, regulatory requirements and internal policies and procedures affecting the coding process.

  • Proficient in navigating a Windows-based application environment.

Principal Accountabilities

  • Reviews medical record documentation to identify pertinent diagnosis/procedures that require code assignment for inpatient records and accurately code the diagnoses and procedures using ICD-10 coding conventions for the purpose of reimbursement, research, and compliance with federal regulations.

  • Reviews the medical record to assure specificity of diagnoses, procedures, and appropriate reimbursement for hospital and professional charges.

  • Queries physicians when code assignments are not straightforward or documentation in the record is inadequate, ambiguous, or unclear for coding purposes.

  • Keeps abreast of coding guidelines and reimbursement reporting guidelines and brings identified concerns to manager for resolution.

  • Effectively assigns ICD-10 codes and DRGs to inpatient records.

  • Responsible in maintaining 92% to 95% in ICD-10 and DRG assignment and consistently meet established productivity standards while keeping abstracting errors to a minimum.

  • Abides by the Standards of Ethical Coding as set forth by the American Health Information Management Association (AHIMA) and adheres to official coding guidelines.

  • Ensures safe care to patients, staff and visitors; adheres to all Memorial Hermann policies, procedures, and standards within budgetary specifications including time management, supply management, productivity and quality of service.

  • Promotes individual professional growth and development by meeting requirements for mandatory/continuing education and skills competency; supports department-based goals which contribute to the success of the organization; serves as preceptor, mentor and resource to less experienced staff.

  • Demonstrates commitment to caring for every member of our community by creating compassionate and personalized experiences. Models Memorial Hermann’s service standards by providing safe, caring, personalized and efficient experiences to patients and colleagues.

  • Other duties as assigned.

title: Sr. System Analyst, GenAI Application
description:
At AIA we’ve started an exciting movement to create a healthier, more sustainable future for everyone.

As pioneering innovators for over 100 years, we’re now transforming our organisation to be faster, simpler and more connected. Because we want to be even better equipped to develop digital solutions and experiences that help more people live Healthier, Longer, Better Lives.

To get there, we need people with tech/digital/analytics expertise and passion to help develop positive, sustainable change through digitally enhanced experiences that will impact the lives of millions of people and create a healthier future for everyone.

If you believe in developing a better tomorrow, read on.

About the Role

Work with business users and other development teams to deal with technical solutions design, coding and deployment (e.g. Python, Database and web applications)，especially AI-powered intelligent claims review solutions (e.g. LLM, RAG, Agent/Workflow, Multimodal).
Provide strong maintenance support, including model performance monitoring, prompt engineering iteration, and system reliability enhancement to make sure the existing claim AI applications running smoothly and efficiently.

Roles and Responsibilities:

1. GenAI Claims Assessment — Application Development (30%)

  • Elicit and analyze business requirements, translating claims workflows into AI-ready technical specifications.
  • Design and implement Python-based AI services covering multimodal material recognition (documents, images), structured information extraction, and RAG-powered clause retrieval.
  • Develop case analysis, rule validation, risk alert, and review opinion generation modules using LLM reasoning and prompt engineering.
  • Build and maintain Agentic workflows with multi-step reasoning, tool calling, and seamless integration with core claims systems and rule engines.
  • Establish LLM evaluation and monitoring dashboards (accuracy, hallucination rate, latency, cost) to ensure review conclusions are traceable, auditable, and production-reliable.
  • Support GenAI claims assessment expansion across multiple business scenarios, delivering scalable and efficient solutions.

2. Systems Support & Maintenance (35%)

  • Troubleshoot and resolve issues for GenAI claims assessment services to ensure production stability and business continuity.
  • Own incident management end-to-end, including root cause analysis, resolution, and follow-up for application system issues.
  • Ensure all incidents are responded to and resolved within defined SLA targets.
  • Continuously optimize system performance through prompt iteration, RAG retrieval tuning, and model inference efficiency improvements.

3. Project Delivery (20%)

  • Lead or actively participate in projects through the full lifecycle — from requirements gathering, solution design, and development to deployment and post-launch review.
  • Coordinate effectively with internal and external teams to ensure on-target project delivery.
  • Manage vendor relationships and task assignments to maintain delivery quality and timeline control.

4. IT Processes & User Satisfaction Improvement (15%)

  • Adhere to IT standard processes and best practices for application development, CI/CD, and code quality to enhance team efficiency.
  • Produce and maintain high-quality technical documentation, including system design specs, API references, and operational runbooks.
  • Demonstrate strong communication skills in both oral and written forms, effectively bridging technical teams and business stakeholders.

Job Requirements:

  • Bachelor’s degree or above in Computer Science, Artificial Intelligence, Software Engineering, Mathematics, or a related discipline.
  • 3+ years of hands-on experience in Python backend or AI/algorithm engineering, with proficiency in at least one AI agent orchestration framework (e.g., LangGraph, PydanticAI, DSPy, DeepAgents). Experience with Spring Boot, Spring AI, Tomcat, and Kubernetes (K8s) is a plus.
  • Solid experience with the RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation) technology stack, including embedding models, reranker models, hybrid retrieval strategies, metadata filtering, and citation/source tracing.
  • Familiar with relational databases, vector databases, caching, and object storage solutions (e.g., PostgreSQL, Elasticsearch / OpenSearch, Redis, MinIO).
  • 1+ years of experience in project management, with demonstrated coordination and communication skills in working with business users and stakeholders.
  • Hands-on experience in NLP and knowledge graph technologies is a strong plus.
  • Good verbal, written and presentation communication skills of both mandarin and English
  • Life insurance knowledge is preferred
  • Prior experience in developing and maintaining GenAI claims assessment applications is preferred.

Build a career with us as we help our customers and the community live Healthier, Longer, Better Lives.

title: Safety Advisor
description:
ACCIONA is a global company, leading in the development of regenerative infrastructure that creates a positive impact on society. Our workforce consists of more than 65,000 professionals, present in more than 40 countries across the five continents, all contributing in our mission to design a better planet. Are you a passionate individual who wants to make a difference, promote sustainable development, and find solutions to the biggest global challenges including climate change, overpopulation, and water scarcity? Come and join us in building the infrastructure our planet needs to achieve a sustainable future.

Job Description

An 80-year group, COBRA promotes its own efficient business model, the result of the combination of decentralization, geographical diversification and technical specialization of more than 20,000 professionals in more than 43 countries. In this way, it offers a wide range of services throughout the value chain of projects, adapted to each sector and to the scope of the contract required by our clients, both public and private. Cobra is divided into four main sectors of activity, Networks, Specialised installations, integrated projects and concession assets.

ACEREZ, a partnership of ACCIONA, COBRA and Endeavour Energy, has been appointed network operator by Energy Co to design, build, finance, operate and maintain the Central-West Orana Renewable Energy Zone (REZ) transmission network. The ACCIONA COBRA Joint Venture (ACJV), the design and construct (D&C) consortium, will design and build the Central-West Orana REZ transmission project.

The Central-West Orana Renewable Energy Zone (REZ) Transmission Project will build new high-capacity transmission lines, energy hubs and supporting infrastructure to transfer power generated by solar and wind projects to electricity consumers. The new infrastructure is expected to be operational by 2028 and will initially unlock up to 4.5 gigawatts of new network capacity.

The project consists of 90km of 500kV overhead transmission lines and 150 km of 330kV transmission lines for generator connections, stretching from Elong Elong in the west through to Barigan Creek in the east, via an energy hub at Merotherie.

Our Central-West Orana project is currently seeking dedicated Safety Advisors to share their expertise within our growing Energy Hubs and Substations teams.

Key Responsibilities

We're looking for dedicated Safety Advisors to bring their expertise to our Central-West Orana team. You'll help embed a strong safety culture across the project — spotting opportunities to improve our systems, keeping tabs on safety performance, and leading the response if the need arises. Key responsibilities will include but not be limited to:

  • Applying your advanced computer software skills to day-to-day HSE administration.

  • Reviewing HSE systems, processes and products, and recommending practical improvements.

  • Tracking safety metrics to support continuous improvement across the project.

  • Coordinating incident reporting and investigations from start to finish.

  • Leading by example to set the standard for safety on site.

  • Managing document control processes, including recording, monitoring, archiving and producing routine written communications.

Required Skills and Competencies

You're an experienced HSE practitioner who's comfortable working across large-scale construction projects and brings a risk-based approach to everything you do. To be successful, you'll bring:

  • 4+ years' experience as an HSE Practitioner on large-scale construction projects, ideally in high voltage environments.

  • WHS qualifications (Diploma or higher preferred).

  • Safety Lead Auditor qualification (desirable).

  • A strong communicator who applies risk-based methodologies with confidence.

This Safety Advisor role is bus-in, bus-out, with camp-style accommodation provided on a 14 days on/7 days off roster, based out of the Central West Orana Region.

We welcome applicants of all backgrounds, identities, and experiences. If you believe you bring the capabilities to succeed in this role, we’d love to hear from you. We look forward to continuing to build our supportive workplace together.

Please note: This position is being delivered as part of a joint venture between two organisations. As such, your employment may be with either of the parent companies, and this will be confirmed during the recruitment process.

For more information on how your personal data is managed, please refer to the privacy statements of each parent company:
