title: Principal 1, Embedded Software Engineer
description:
This is an onsite based position based out of our Lake Forest, California Office:

At Alcon, we're passionate about enhancing sight and helping people see brilliantly. With more than 25,000 associates, we innovate fearlessly, champion progress, and act swiftly to impact global eye health. We foster an inclusive culture, recognizing your contributions and offering opportunities to grow your career like never before. Together, we make a difference in the lives of our patients and customers. Are you ready to join us?

This role is part of Alcon's Information Technology function, a team that delivers cutting-edge technology solutions to Alcon associates and customers to help our people and the world see brilliantly. The Principal I, Embedded Software Engineer, is primarily responsible for leading the design and development of software solutions, leveraging advanced technical expertise to influence engineering teams and the broader organization

In this role you will work on challenging embedded projects, applying your skills to design, develop, integrate and test computer-controlled electromechanical devices in a Real-Time Operating System (RTOS) environment. You will contribute to software risk management by writing software design and test documentation which thoroughly cover software requirements to ensure our products are safe for use on millions of patients and in compliance with regulations worldwide. As a member of our team, you will work with the latest technologies and software development principles, using your embedded microcontroller experience in C++ and C programming languages. You will also apply your knowledge of embedded analysis, simulation, and debug tools to troubleshoot multi-threaded applications and communication peripherals. You will gain an in-depth understanding of the anatomy, physiology, and pathology of the eye, as our work is focused on developing medical devices for this field.

In this role, a typical day will include :

  • Lead the design and implementation of complex software solutions.
  • Provide technical guidance to engineering teams and mentor junior engineers.
  • Collaborate with product management and business leaders to ensure software solutions meet business needs.
  • Ensure best practices are followed and optimize development processes.
  • Continuously evaluate and improve the software development lifecycle.
  • Lead high-impact engineering projects and drive technical direction for the software engineering team.
  • Contribute to the company’s ability to deliver innovative and high-quality software.
  • Make key technical decisions on software design, architecture, and engineering strategies.
  • Act as a subject-matter expert and provide guidance on complex technical challenges.
  • Associates adhere to GxP regulations, Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs), and on the job training.
  • Associates are responsible for meeting their individual job requirements and contributing to the overall compliance of the organization. Compliance with regulatory requirements and a commitment to continuous improvement are essential to our operations​.

Key Requirements/Minimum Qualifications :

  • Bachelor’s Degree or Equivalent years of directly related experience (or high school +13 yrs.
  • Assoc.+9 yrs.; M.S.+2 yrs.; PhD+0 yrs.)
  • The ability to fluently read, write, understand, and communicate in English
  • 5 Years of Relevant Experience

Preferred Requirements:

  • Proficiency in C /C++ targeting embedded Microcontrollers (Example: ST STM32, NXP, or similar).
  • Understanding of electronic circuitry and ability to read schematics as applicable to design and debugging efforts.
  • Experience with board bring up and interfacing with on and off chip peripherals such as SPI, CAN, UART, I2C, Ethernet, ADC’s and DAC’s.
  • Strong debugging skills at component-level designs on the PCBA or within an integrated product.
  • Proficiency using simulation and debug tools (ex: CANoe, Lauterbach).
  • Proficiency using lab equipment (logic analyzers, in-circuit emulators, oscilloscopes and DVMs) to debug and troubleshoot designs.
  • Proficient knowledge of embedded software architecture and design patterns.
  • Proficient with RTOS (CMX, ThreadX, or similar) and RTOS based applications and multi-threaded applications.
  • Proficient in creating bootloaders, application code, device drivers for embedded boards.
  • Proficient at writing supporting design and test documentation for embedded systems.

  • Build positive working relationships to achieve positive goals and business objectives.

title: Cybersecurity Analyst
description:
Radiance Technologies, a 100% employee-owned company, is seeking a Cybersecurity Analyst to support Test and Training Group. The candidate will assist in safeguarding DoD information systems, ensuring cybersecurity compliance, and implementing DoD cybersecurity policies and standards throughout system lifecycles. This position requires deep knowledge of cybersecurity principles, DoD cybersecurity documentation, and proactive risk management in support of secure system integration and sustainment.

Responsibilities:

  • Support Information Systems Security Managers (ISSMs) and Information System Security Officers (ISSOs) in executing cybersecurity responsibilities across a portfolio of tactical Army programs.
  • Implement and enforce DoD cybersecurity policies and procedures for Information Systems (IS) and Platform IT (PIT) systems.
  • Coordinate with ISSMs and ISSOs to initiate corrective actions or protective measures in response to cybersecurity incidents or vulnerabilities.
  • Maintain up-to-date cybersecurity-related documentation and ensure accessibility to authorized users.
  • Review and analyze reports from penetration tests, static code analysis, and vulnerability scans.
  • Analyze network architecture, data flows, organizational charts, and personnel assignments for potential cybersecurity vulnerabilities.
  • Participate in continuous improvement of system security postures and assist in securing custom-developed applications.
  • Implementation of System Security Plans (SSP), Standard Operating Procedures (SOP), information security policies and the development of information system artifacts, as necessary, to ensure compliance with Risk Management Framework (RMF) guidelines.

Required Skills:

  • Strong understanding of DoD cybersecurity regulations, standards, and tools.
  • Experience with RMF, vulnerability management, system hardening, and secure coding practices.
  • Excellent communication and coordination skills across functional teams.
  • Ability to assess, document, and mitigate cybersecurity risks in complex environments.
  • U.S. Citizenship with the ability to obtain and maintain a security clearance.

Required Experience:

  • At least 7 years of experience supporting the full cybersecurity life cycle for DoD systems.
  • At least 5 years of progressively complex experience in developing, integrating, and implementing cybersecurity and program protection standards for networks, computing environments, and application development.
  • Experience with ATO packages, RMF documentation, vulnerability assessments, and continuous monitoring.
  • Familiarity with DoD cyber compliance tools such as ACAS, eMASS, and HBSS.

Required Certifications:

  • DoDI 8570 IAM Level II certification standards (CCNA-Security, CySA+ (CSIS), GICSP, GSEC, Security+ CE, CND, or SSCP).

Desired Qualifications:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Information Technology, Cybersecurity, Computer Science, Information Systems, Data Science, or Software Engineering.
  • Experience with securing custom application development environments and DevSecOps practices.

Radiance Technologies is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, or protected veteran status.

title: Lead Java Software Engineer - Prime Finance Risk - Vice President
description:
The Opportunity: Shape the Future of Financial Risk Analysis

Join our team at the forefront of financial technology, where we build and maintain the critical platform for Prime Services Risk and Business Intelligence. Our systems are the analytical engine that empowers the firm to manage risk, serve our clients, and make data-driven decisions in a complex, fast-paced market.

We are a global team of innovators and problem-solvers who design and operate sophisticated, computing-intensive solutions to analyze the risk profiles of our clients. This is not just another development role; this is a chance to work on a platform that is fundamental to the firm's stability and success. You will tackle challenging problems in distributed systems, real-time data processing, and financial analytics at scale.

We are looking for a passionate and experienced Lead Java Engineer to not only contribute to our codebase but also to drive technical direction, mentor our team, and own the delivery of robust, scalable solutions.

Key Responsibilities:

As a Lead Engineer, you will be at the heart of our technical decision-making and delivery process.

  • Architect & Build: Design, develop, and own end-to-end software solutions using Java and the Spring ecosystem. You will be responsible for creating services that are not only functional but also resilient, performant, and scalable.

  • Lead & Mentor: Act as a technical leader within the team. Guide architectural discussions, lead sub-teams on complex projects, and actively mentor junior engineers through constructive code reviews and knowledge-sharing sessions.

  • Drive Performance: Engineer high-throughput, low-latency systems. You will optimize applications for maximum speed, design efficient data models in Microsoft SQL Server, and implement intelligent caching strategies (e.g., Redis) to ensure our platform operates at peak performance.

  • Embrace Real-Time Data: Harness the power of our message-driven architecture using Kafka. You will build and maintain data pipelines that feed our real-time analytics engine, powered by Apache Pinot, to deliver instantaneous insights to our business users.

  • Champion DevOps & Automation: Contribute to and enhance our CI/CD pipelines, leveraging internal platforms and Git for seamless integration and deployment. You will deploy and manage applications on our OpenShift container platform, embracing a true DevOps culture.

  • Integrate & Collaborate: Work across teams to integrate with a wide array of upstream data sources and downstream consumers. You will collaborate closely with project managers, business analysts, and senior stakeholders to translate complex requirements into well-architected technical solutions.

  • Own & Support: Take ownership of the full application lifecycle, including providing critical application support. You will leverage your growing knowledge of margin methodology and risk analytics to troubleshoot and resolve production issues effectively.

Qualifications:

  • Extensive Backend Experience: 8+ years of professional experience designing, building, and deploying enterprise-scale, distributed backend systems.

  • Java Expertise: Deep, hands-on knowledge of modern Java (11+) and the Spring ecosystem (Spring Boot, Spring Security, etc.).

  • Database Proficiency: Strong command of SQL and experience with relational databases, particularly Microsoft SQL Server. You should be adept at writing optimized queries and designing efficient schemas.

  • Messaging & Asynchronous Systems: Proven experience working in message-driven architectures with technologies like Kafka, RabbitMQ, or similar.

  • Leadership & Mentorship: A demonstrated track record of leading technical initiatives, making architectural decisions, and mentoring other engineers. Your experience should show that you are a force multiplier for your team.

  • DevOps Mindset: Solid experience with CI/CD principles and tools (e.g., Jenkins, Tekton), and version control with Git. Experience with containerization and orchestration (Docker, Kubernetes, OpenShift) is essential.

  • Strong Communication: Excellent verbal and written communication skills, with the ability to articulate complex technical concepts to both technical and non-technical audiences.

Preferred Qualifications (The "Wow" Factor):

  • Financial Domain Knowledge: Experience or a strong interest in the Finance Sector, especially concepts related to Prime Finance, Counterparty Risk, or Market Risk.

  • Advanced Education: An advanced degree (M.S. or Ph.D.) in Computer Science, Engineering, Mathematics, or a related quantitative field.

  • Real-Time Analytics Experience: Hands-on experience with OLAP datastores like Apache Pinot.

  • Scripting & Automation: Proficiency in Unix/Linux environments and shell scripting.

  • Agile Experience: Experience working in a fast-paced, Agile/Scrum environment, managing priorities, and delivering under tight deadlines.

What We Offer:

  • Impactful Work: The opportunity to work on a business-critical platform that has a direct and measurable impact on the firm's bottom line and risk posture.

  • Technical Challenges: A continuous stream of complex and intellectually stimulating challenges in the realms of distributed computing, big data, and financial modeling.

  • Modern Tech Stack: Access to a modern, evolving tech stack with the freedom to innovate and introduce new technologies and patterns.

  • Career Growth: A commitment to your professional development with a clear path for growth into senior technical leadership or management roles.

  • Collaborative Culture: A supportive and collaborative global team that values diversity of thought, continuous learning, and mutual respect.

  • Competitive Compensation: A competitive salary, performance-based bonus, and a comprehensive benefits package - details below.

Alongside these benefits Citi is committed to ensuring our workplace is where everyone feels comfortable coming to work as their whole self every day. We want the best talent around the world to be energized to join us, motivated to stay, and empowered to thrive.

title: Applications Senior Technical Specialist - Assistant Vice President
description:
Excited to grow your career?

We value our talented employees, and whenever possible strive to help one of our associates grow professionally before recruiting new talent to our open positions. If you think the open position, you see is right for you, we encourage you to apply!

Our people make all the difference in our success.

--------------------------------------------------------------

Global Custody and Clearing provide world class solutions for asset servicing and transaction functions primarily to intermediaries such as broker-dealers, banks, fund managers, insurance companies and other global investors through our proprietary network in over 60 markets. We are the market leader in this range of products and maintain a large share of global custodian and international broker/dealer clients, having a rapidly growing presence in local custody (safekeeping services).

Under Global Custody and Clearing, Global Transaction Manager is client facing platform that offers end-to-end transaction life cycle service which enables clients to access the global presence and expertise of Citi Custody services through an integrated and efficient services. Additionally, our distribution network offers the ability to handle very large transaction volumes and achieve market leading STP rates.

About the Role
The Applications Development specialist is a senior level position responsible for establishing and implementing new or revised application systems and programs in coordination with the Technology team. The overall objective of this role is to perform applications systems analysis and programming activities.

  • Conduct tasks related to applications development, model development, and establish and implement new or revised applications systems and programs to meet specific business needs or user areas

  • Use code reviews and static code analysis to improve the quality of code and highlight vulnerabilities early in the software development lifecycle

  • Apply a security-by-design approach to development, using recommended controls and techniques to secure software, and remediate vulnerabilities where identified

  • Good track record of relevant experience in design and development of Java based systems.

  • Databases – DB2/Oracle or equivalent with SQL, PL/SQL programming expertise.

  • Tools – Well versed with IntelliJ/Eclipse

  • Strong understanding of the Software Development Life Cycle

EDUCATION

title: Senior Java Developer
description:

As a senior member of the team, you will also mentor junior developers, drive engineering best practices, and contribute to architectural and design decisions.

Database & Integration

title: Software Engineer
description:
Introduction
Serco is a leading Space Services Provider with thousands of skilled resources that has supported over 50 space missions on behalf of more than 10 Space or Government agencies around the globe, including the ESA and NASA. Serco Italia S.p.A. is one of the top 50 World Space Manufacturing and Service companies with a long history of providing Earth Observation operations, maintenance and front-end services to the European Space Agency. The company also offers vast experience to a huge number of IT and space markets including central governments, defense organizations, the aerospace industry and commercial companies.
On behalf of our team in Italy, we are looking for a Software Engineer to support our Copernicus Sentinel operations, maintenance and coordination activities, and work on a full time, permanent position with a hybrid working style from our office in Rome. We are seeking a Software Engineer with a development and application-operations mindset, able to support the full lifecycle of our Copernicus EO applications, including dashboards, data pipelines, operational tools, and user interfaces. The role covers software evolution, deployment support and automation, monitoring, incident/anomaly analysis, documentation, and continuous improvement based on operational feedback. The role also requires practical experience with AI-assisted engineering, using coding agents and generative AI tools to support development, testing, documentation, troubleshooting, and analysis.   • Ability to work with SQL and NoSQL databases, including querying, data modelling, and database design in support of software applications.

  • Ability to use JIRA or similar ticketing systems to track activities, actions, incidents, anomalies, and reporting workflows.
  • English Level B2, written and spoken.
Knowledge and experience:

title: Program Coordinator, Events & Communications
description:
Job Description Summary & Additional Information

Organization's Summary Statement:

xFoundry is seeking an experienced, highly dependable Program Coordinator to take ownership of several important workstreams across our programs and events.

The primary focus during this contract will be supporting the planning and execution of the April 2027 NEXPLORE summit. This person will own defined areas of event coordination, including speaker and guest logistics, venue and contract management, information tracking, follow-up, and the preparation of event communications and materials.

Beyond NEXPLORE, the coordinator will support related program and communications projects to support program growth. This includes coordinating additional partner-facing events, drafting practical content, updating existing materials, and keeping time-sensitive projects organized.

This is a hands-on execution role for someone experienced with a fast-moving workplace who can take responsibility for an assignment, exercise good judgment, and carry it through to completion.

About xFoundry

Founded at the University of Maryland, College Park, xFoundry is a novel, timely, and groundbreaking initiative that turns universities into solution engines for higher education in the age of AI. xFoundry runs experiential innovation programs that connect university students to real-world problem solving, entrepreneurship, and industry-backed challenges. Grounded in multidisciplinary collaboration, xFoundry launches students with a passion for technology, entrepreneurship, the arts, athletics, and science (TEAMS) into the market with over a year of experience designed for the next generation of the workforce.

The A. James Clark School of Engineering at the University of Maryland catalyzes high-quality research, innovation, and learning, preparing our students to create innovations that will address the 21st century Grand Challenges (e.g., energy, environment, security, and human health) and improve the human condition. The Clark School is dedicated to leading and transforming the engineering discipline and profession, accelerating entrepreneurship, and transforming research and learning activities into innovations that benefit millions.

Primary responsibilities

NEXPLORE summit coordination

  • Oversee all event logistics, details, deadlines, and coordination

  • Own and maintain accurate speaker, guest, partner, and attendee trackers

  • Coordinate invitations, confirmations, scheduling, pre-event meetings, and follow-up

  • Gather speaker information, biographies, headshots, presentation materials, and logistical requirements

  • Coordinate speaker travel details as needed

  • Serve as a day-to-day liaison among internal team members, speakers, partners, vendors, and the event-production team for assigned workstreams

  • Identify missing information or potential problems and follow through until they are resolved

  • White glove communication and partner asset preparation

  • Support onsite execution during the week of April 5, 2027

Marketing and communications support

  • Coordinate selected meetings, dinners, partner engagements, student-facing events and smaller program events

  • Draft straightforward, elegant, clear, and on-brand content such as emails, invitations, event descriptions, agendas, speaker materials, and program updates

  • Support the Programs team on student outreach and engagement efforts and materials

  • Create or update presentations, flyers, one-pagers, and other materials using established templates

  • Make basic content updates to existing webpages and other digital materials

  • Other duties as assigned

Preferred Qualifications:

  • At least 6 years of professional workplace experience

  • Demonstrated experience coordinating projects with multiple stakeholders and deadlines

  • Strong writing, editing, and proofreading skills

  • Proficiency with standard workplace and collaboration tools

Additional Information:

1. UMD will not sponsor the successful candidate for work authorization in the United States now or in the future. This position can not support a F1 STEM OPT.

2. Location: Preferred in DC, Maryland, Virginia, or the Northeast corridor

3. Type: 6-month contract, Full-time

4. Available to be occasionally onsite (Washington, D.C. metro area), leading up to and for the event (week of April 5, 2027)

Required Application Materials:

1. Resume

2. Brief cover letter explaining your interest and relevant experience

3. Two references (names and contact information)

4. One or two examples of relevant communications or event materials you have created or coordinated

5. Applicants may also submit an optional video of up to 90 seconds responding to the following questions:

  • What type of work are you especially good at owning from beginning to end?

  • How do you keep a project moving when you are waiting on information from multiple people?

  • What interests you about xFoundry and NEXPLORE?

NA

Yes

Physical Demands:
This position requires extended periods of sitting, standing, or walking, as well as occasional bending, reaching, and lifting or carrying event materials weighing up to 30 pounds.


Preferences:

Skills and abilities

  • Strong written and verbal communication skills with meticulous attention to detail, consistency, and clarity, particularly when handling names, dates, schedules, and externally distributed materials

  • Experience leading corporate events or external-facing, large-scale programs

  • Experience supporting external-facing communications, messaging, and events

  • Confidence in efficient, persistent follow-up and problem-solving on the spot

  • Strong project management and organizational skills

NEXPLORE is xFoundry’s annual, national convening of industry, academia, the public sector, startup, and investment communities to explore bold ideas and scale the multidisciplinary model that powers xFoundry at universities across the country. The 2-day event features over 50 speakers, marquee names, industry leaders, visionaries, and a curated executive audience of 400+ alongside student teams working to define and solve society’s grand challenges.

title: Senior Acoustics Systems Engineer, Audio Tech
description:
At Bose Corporation, we believe sound is the most powerful force on earth — and for over 60 years, we have been a company built on innovation, excellence, and independence. Privately owned, fiercely customer-focused, and driven by our values, we continue to lead industries and transform lives through sound.

Today, Bose Corporation is entering an exciting new era. Across multiple global Business Units and Global Functions, we are shaping the future of audio technology, automotive, luxury, and premium experiences. We invite you to join us in this transformation.

Job Description

At Bose, we’ve spent more than 50 years finding new ways to bring quality audio products to people—in their homes, in automobiles, in airplanes, and just about anywhere else that there is a possibility to enjoy music. Our legendary Wave® music system, SoundLink® Mini Bluetooth speaker, or QuietComfort® acoustic noise cancelling headphones may ring a bell with you. Bose relies on outstanding people to build and deliver those products, and we are looking for that next individual to join our team and contribute to delivering phenomenal experiences to customers. We are also expanding beyond our typical customer reach. The Audio Technology Licensing business unit is turning core pieces of our technology, both existing and cutting edge innovations, into products that we can offer to customers in areas such as Bluetooth speakers, banded headphones, and earbuds as well as devices like phones and projectors. The Audio Technology Engineering team is an exciting place to be as we reinvent what it means to deliver differentiating experiences and value to our customers.

Summary:

As a Senior Audio Systems Engineer for the Audio Technology Engineering team, you’ll lead product development activities as we deliver audio technology, services, algorithms, and software to our customers and partners. You will serve as the primary technical point of contact and engineering lead interfacing with myriad internal functions spanning engineering subject matter experts, project management, business development, finance, legal, marketing, product development along with our customers and their contract manufacturers. This is a high-impact role for an experienced engineer to lead the design of new Bose products working with engineers across Bose and external partners.

Hybrid Working Environment: 3-days/week on-site presence is required.

Responsibilities:

The Systems Engineer will develop products that contain a high degree of system complexity while leading cross-functional engineering teams and interfacing directly with technology partners to design products meeting customer needs, development cost targets, and safety/regulatory requirements. The candidate must have product development experience in at least one of the following fields: consumer electronics, automotive, defense industry, medical device, or a related industry.

This role requires technical proficiency in consumer acoustical systems spanning acoustics, digital signal processing, algorithm development, mechanical and electrical elements of hardware, SoCs, digital signal processors, software, and firmware. title: Director, Product & CX - Home Services
description:
With a career at The Home Depot, you can be yourself and also be part of something bigger.

Position Purpose:

As Director of Product, you will lead and develop a team of Product Managers and leaders of Product Management responsible for defining and executing a digital roadmap for the B2C Home Services Online experience and supporting platforms.
You will be responsible for defining and executing bold, high-impact product roadmaps, harness emerging technologies, including multimodal AI, image processing, NLP, and 3D spatial tools. You will lead across organizational boundaries, translate complex technical concepts into clear, audience-tailored narratives, and influence executive leadership to prioritize initiatives that drive measurable financial outcomes.


Key Responsibilities:

40% Strategy, Roadmap & Team Elevation

  • Drive Innovation & Strategy: Define and deliver multi-year roadmap that transforms customer experience, lead generation, visualization, automated pricing, and workforce coordination while driving measurable business outcomes.

  • Foster Collaboration: Partner closely with Product, Engineering, Data Science, UX, business partners, and merchants to align priorities, challenge conventional thinking, and deliver innovative solutions enabled by emerging technologies.

  • Cross-Functional Problem Solving: Apply deep technical domain knowledge to solve complex operational friction points across customer, provider, and field workforce touchpoints.

20% Organizational Change & Operational Excellence

10% Multimodal AI & Dynamic Solutions

Multimodal Systems & Schema Orchestration

AI Operational Velocity

  • AI-First Execution (Plus): Hands-on use of modern AI tooling (e.g., Claude, Cursor) to turn meetings and discussions directly into user stories, specs, and rapid prototypes.

  • Cross-Functional Leader: Proven ability to operate collaboratively across Product, Engineering, Data Science, UX, and operations to break down silos and drive alignment.

  • Talent Developer: Track record of attracting, coaching, and retaining top-tier product talent, fostering a culture of rapid experimentation and operational excellence.

title: Homecare SCheduler
description:
JOB DESCRIPTION: SCheduler

Description

  • Oversee services provided to individuals in their own homes and communities, who need assistance caring for themselves as a result of old age, sickness, disability, and/or other conditions. Home care may include assistance with the activities of daily living, housecleaning, laundry, meal preparation, transportation, companionship, and respite.
  • Home Care Supervisors ensure that employees deliver services in a caring and respectful manner, in accordance with relevant Agency policies and industry standards.

Reporting Relationship

  • Reports to Branch Manager/Lead Supervisor.

Responsibilities/Activities

  • Ensure Agency policies and procedures and industry standards and regulations are followed.
  • Assist with the coordination, evaluation, and planning of home care services.
  • Assist the Branch Manager/Lead Supervisor with administrative activities and optimal use of resources.
  • Develop, implement, and evaluate strategic branch plans, goals, and objectives.
  • Coordinate Staffing/Scheduling activities.
  • Supervise work activities of designated employees.
  • Develop and instruct employees in the use of practices, procedures, and equipment.
  • Provide leadership to employees.
  • Conduct in-home assessments and Home Visits
  • Liaise with community resources and other agencies.

Required Knowledge

  • Knowledge of standards of practice and scope of practice, in accordance with state regulations
  • Knowledge of personal care and home management skills.
  • Knowledge of principles and processes for providing client and personal care services, including needs determinants, meeting quality standards and evaluation of client satisfaction.
  • Knowledge of the information and techniques needed to identify injuries.
  • The agency shall have home services supervisors or trainers that provide initial training and supervision on an ongoing basis to home service workers to address requirements in Section 245.40©(4)(A) through (P). The home services supervisor or trainer shall:
  1. Within the last five years, have a minimum of two years’ experience working in a home health, home services, facility-based healthcare setting, or home nursing environment performing those tasks permitted by this Part to be completed by home services workers, including assistance with activities of daily living; or
  2. Be in a current supervisory or trainer position with a home services agency and have received training within the past year on those tasks permitted by this Part to be completed by home services workers. The training provided to the home services supervisors or trainers shall, at a minimum, demonstrate the general standards of care for each topic in Section 245.40©(4)(A) through (P), and be provided by or developed by someone qualified (e.g., licensed or certified) in their respective field.
  • Agency supervisors and trainers shall be available to home service workers to provide updated and continuing education related to staff responsibilities for client care as outlined in Section 245.40©(4)(A) through (P).
  • Knowledge of clerical procedures such as maintaining records and completing forms.

Required Skills/Abilities

  • Ability to converse with subordinates in a clear, concise, accurate & timely manner.
  • Ability to monitor and assess employees, clients, and the effectiveness of service.
  • Ability to communicate written and oral information so others understand.
  • Ability to work independently and in cooperation with others.
  • Ability to observe and recognize changes in clients.
  • Ability to establish and maintain harmonious relations with clients/families/co-workers.
  • Microsoft Office and other office equipment.

Qualifications/Education

  • High school graduate or equivalent.
  • Current driver’s license.
  • Proper Vehicle Insurance Coverage

Training/Experience:

  • May require related experience.
  • In order to serve as an Alzheimer's services supervisor working in an entity licensed under 77 Ill. Adm. Code 245 or 280, an individual shall complete at least eight hours of training annually related to the care of residents or clients with Alzheimer's disease and other related dementias. The Alzheimer's services supervisor shall also meet at least one of the following requirements:
  1. Achieve a certification from one of the following:
  2. The Alzheimer's Association's EssentiALZ program;
  3. An organization that provides a credentialing certificate for a certified dementia specialist (CDS);
  4. The National Council of Certified Dementia Practitioners (CDP) as a certified dementia practitioner; or
  5. The National Certification Board for Alzheimer and Aging Care; or
  6. Have a minimum of two years of experience working with persons with Alzheimer's disease and other related dementias, at least one year of which is management experience working with persons with Alzheimer's disease and other related dementias, and have completed ability-centered care training.

title: Engineering Technician, Research & Development Process & Product Design
description:
This is an onsite position based out of our Lake Forest, CA Main Office

At Alcon, we are driven by the meaningful work we do to help people see brilliantly. We innovate boldly, champion progress, and act with speed as the global leader in eye care. Here, you’ll be recognized for your commitment and contributions and see your career like never before. Together, we go above and beyond to make an impact in the lives of our patients and customers.

We foster an inclusive culture and are looking for diverse, talented people to join Alcon. As an Engineering Technician, you will be part of the Research & Development (R&D) Process & Product Design team, which interfaces regularly with all R&D engineering departments and stages for the development of medical device product. This includes performing or modifying tests with fixtures, which may be developed internally for the execution of approved test methods. Typical areas of expertise that interface with the products may be: fluidics, mechanics, optics, electronics, interface programming, and lasers.

In this role, a typical day will include:

  • Providing hands-on technical support for product design and development processes by assisting in testing, documentation, and compliance activities, ensuring accurate documentation of test results.
  • Following established protocols to perform routine product evaluations, maintain laboratory equipment, and collect data to support research efforts.
  • Assisting in troubleshooting product design issues and maintaining compliance with regulatory and quality standards.
  • Developing foundational knowledge in product testing, materials analysis, and technical reporting to contribute to the overall development and validation of new products.

Minimum Requirements:

  • Bachelor’s Degree or Equivalent years of directly related experience (or high school +8 yrs. Assoc.+4 yrs.)
  • The ability to fluently read, write, understand, and communicate in English

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Prior engineering or engineering technician experience, specifically in testing, product design, fixture development, and product assembly/rework support, ideally for medical devices.
  • Ability to write and execute Protocols and/or Test Methods a Plus
  • Experience working with electro-mechanical and/or opto-mechanical devices a plus.

title: .NET Full Stack Application Architect
description:
Who We Are

That sense of belonging — being a valued, respected, trusted member of the team — is fundamental to our culture and fueling great experiences for our customers. This dedication to welcoming everyone into our company means that Kyndryl gives you the ability to thrive and contribute to our culture of empathy and shared success. That’s The Kyndryl Way.

Your career with us isn’t just a job—it’s an adventure with purpose. We offer a dynamic, hybrid-friendly culture that supports your well-being and empowers you to grow. Our Be Well programs are thoughtfully designed to support your financial, mental, physical, and social health—because we know that when you feel your best, you do your best.

From your very first day, you’ll dive into impactful work that powers the systems our customers rely on every day. You won’t just contribute—you’ll make a difference, tackling meaningful projects that sharpen your skills and fuel your growth.

We’re here to champion your journey. With powerful tools to chart your career path, personalized development goals aligned with your ambitions, and continuous feedback to keep you inspired and on track, you’ll have everything you need to thrive and evolve. You’ll develop in-demand skills to grow your career and achieve your ambitions with access to cutting-edge learning opportunities—from certifications with Microsoft, Google, and Amazon to coaching and hands-on experiences. And through it all, you’ll be part of a culture that values empathy, restless learning, and a devotion to shared success.

We want you to thrive here—and we’re committed to helping you do just that. Ready to make an impact? Join us and help shape what’s next.

A successful Diesel Technician II complies with all company policies and achieves high level performance metrics.

DUTIES:

  • Perform scheduled preventative maintenance (“PM”), DOT Inspections and follow up repairs on light, medium and heavy-duty vehicles in a mobile/field environment.

  • Perform minor adjustment and repairs on various types of truck equipment including, but not limited to the following: Electrical/Brake/Cooling Systems, Starters/Alternators, Fan clutches, Engine electronics, Diesel steering systems, Engines (gas and diesel), Transmissions (manual and automatic), Clutches, Differentials, etc.

  • Diagnose, adjust, and repair various types of truck equipment including, but not limited to the following: Electrical/Brake/Cooling Systems, Starters/Alternators, Air conditioning systems, Fan clutches, Engine electronics, Diesel steering systems, Engines (gas and diesel), Transmissions (manual and automatic), Clutches, Differentials, etc.

  • Inspect, test, and listen to defective equipment to diagnose malfunctions, using test instruments such as handheld computers and pressure gauges.

  • Road test vehicles to diagnose malfunctions and to ensure that they are working properly.

  • Identify problems, determine accuracy and relevance of information, using sound judgment to generate and evaluate alternatives.

  • Independently manage parts inventory and equipment provided on company-issued service truck and perform periodic reconciliation.

  • Maintain and operate company-issued service vehicle, conduct safety checks, and pre-/post-trip inspections of vehicle.

  • Work with and listen effectively to clients and customers to assess their needs, providing information or assistance, resolving their problems, or satisfying their expectations.

  • Manage concurrent assigned tasks, making effective judgments as to prioritizing work related activities and time allocations.

  • Use hand tools, precision instruments, as well as Diesel tools, welding equipment, lift and jacks.

  • Document according to company standards and upload pictures of work performed, parts used, and all findings observed on Repair Orders (“RO”) using company-issued iOS device and our proprietary TRAIT application.

  • Accurately complete DOT forms and all other forms of documentation in a timely fashion.

  • Work with a high degree of independence and manage own daily schedule.

  • Maintain a high level of productivity and be able to work within or close to most Standard Repair Times.

  • Obtain parts from approved local and national vendors as necessary for the repairs to be performed.

  • Communicate with management and support team via email or phone to obtain approvals on repair estimates, retrieve purchase order numbers and/or discuss RO findings notes.

  • Perform all work in compliance with organizational safety, health and environmental policies, and federal regulations, to include OSHA, EPA, and DOT.

  • Maintain company issued service truck, conduct safety checks and daily pre/post trip inspections.

REQUIREMENTS:

  • High School Diploma/GED and 3 years’ experience in a related field. The right candidate could also have a different combination, such as any level degree/certification beyond a HS diploma/GED in a related discipline; or 5 years’ experience in a related field.

  • Possess and supply a set of hand tools necessary to perform required job duties.

  • Obtain Automotive Service Excellence (ASE) certification T8 (PMI) within eighteen (18) months.

  • This position follows regulations issued by the Department of Transportation’s (DOT) Federal Motor Carrier Safety Administration (FMCSA). Candidate must be able to successfully complete and pass a DOT-regulated pre-employment background screening and DOT physical prior to employment.

  • A current and valid DOT medical card with more than four (4) months remaining until its expiration may be submitted in leu of a DOT physical. If the DOT medical card has four (4) months or less of validity remaining, a DOT physical will be required.

  • Due to interstate operating authority commerce regulations, candidates must be at least 21 years or older.

  • Safe drivers needed; valid driver’s license required. Candidate must hold a valid state-of-residence driver’s license, be able to obtain and maintain their Driver Qualification File.

REQUIRED CERTIFICATIONS OR OBTAINED WITHIN 18 MONTHS

  • ASE T8 (PMI) certification

PREFERRED CERIFICATIONS

  • ASE T3 (Drivetrain) certification

  • ASE T4 (Brakes) certification

  • ASE T5 (Suspension) certification

  • ASE T6 (Electrical and Electronic Systems)

  • ASE T7 (HVAC) certification

  • ASE 608/609 certification*

SKILLS & ABILITIES

title: Software Engineer
description:
About Us

American Century Investments® is a leading global asset manager with over 65 years of experience helping a broad base of clients achieve their financial goals. Our expertise spans global equities and fixed income, multi-asset strategies, ETFs, and private investments.

Privately owned and independent, we focus solely on investment management. But there’s an unexpected side to us, too. We direct 40% of our dividends every year—over $2 billion since 2000—to the Stowers Institute for Medical Research. Our ongoing financial support drives the Institute’s breakthrough work and mission of defeating life-threatening diseases like cancer and Alzheimer’s. So, the better we do for our clients, the more we can do for everyone.

All who work here around the globe are inspired every day by the unique difference our hard work can make in so many lives. It shows in the curiosity we bring to every initiative, the deep relationships we build with our clients, and the way we treat each other in the hallway. If you’re excited to learn more about us, we can’t wait to learn more about you.

Role Summary

The Software Engineer is a role on the IT Client Experience team focused on helping build, support, and improve ACI’s digital client-facing platforms and experiences, including public websites, authenticated web experiences, mobile capabilities, and related Sales and Marketing technology integrations.

The primary responsibility of this role is to learn and contribute across day-to-day engineering and production support activities, including troubleshooting issues, validating releases, making code changes, improving support documentation, and partnering with senior engineers to keep digital experiences reliable, secure, accessible, and easy to use.

This position is well suited for an engineer early in their career who is eager to grow skills in modern web development, cloud-native platforms, integrations, observability, and production support while learning how technology enables client, advisor, sales, and marketing experiences.

This role reports to the IT Manager – Software Engineering.

This hybrid position will be based out of our Kansas City, Missouri office.

This position is not eligible for visa sponsorship. Applicants must be authorized to work in the U.S. without visa sponsorship, now or in the future.

How You Will Make an Impact

Digital Experience Engineering & Production Support

  • Support ACI’s client-facing digital platforms by helping troubleshoot production issues, service requests, defects, and operational questions.
  • Assist with triage by gathering details, recreating issues, reviewing logs or monitoring data, and coordinating with the appropriate engineers, product owners, vendors, or support partners.
  • Help validate releases, hotfixes, content changes, and configuration updates to ensure web and mobile experiences are ready for production use.
  • Provide clear status updates during support issues and contribute to post-incident notes, follow-ups, and documentation.
  • Maintain and improve runbooks, troubleshooting guides, support documentation, and standard operating procedures for owned applications and integrations.

Web, Mobile & Platform Reliability

  • Monitor application behavior, alerts, recurring issues, and client experience impacts across supported web, mobile, and marketing technology platforms.
  • Assist with root-cause analysis and help implement fixes that reduce repeat issues and improve reliability, performance, accessibility, and supportability.
  • Learn how front-end applications, APIs, content platforms, analytics, authentication, and third-party services work together to deliver end-to-end digital experiences.
  • Support operational readiness by reviewing changes, checking deployment results, and confirming that monitoring and documentation are in place.

Software Engineering & Technical Growth

  • Develop and maintain small enhancements, bug fixes, automated tests, and configuration updates for supported digital platforms.
  • Participate in code reviews, testing, deployment activities, and technical discussions with guidance from senior engineers.
  • Build familiarity with modern web development practices, including JavaScript/TypeScript, component-based UI development, APIs, CI/CD, cloud hosting, and observability.
  • Learn and apply team standards for secure coding, accessibility, performance, maintainability, and production readiness.
  • Use AI-assisted engineering tools responsibly to improve productivity while following team review, testing, and governance expectations.

Team Collaboration

  • Work closely with product owners, engineers, QA, UX, Marketing, Sales, operations, and support partners to understand priorities and deliver reliable digital solutions.
  • Ask questions, seek feedback, and actively learn from teammates while building ownership of assigned work.
  • Contribute to team rituals such as stand-ups, backlog refinement, planning sessions, demos, and retrospectives.
  • Communicate clearly with both technical and non-technical partners, especially when explaining issue status, risks, or next steps.

What You Bring to the Team (Required)

  • Bachelor’s degree in computer science, management information systems, finance, business, or an equivalent combination of education and work experience.
  • Professional software development, technical support, internship, co-op, or related technology experience.
  • Experience using AI-assisted software engineering tools (e.g., GitHub Copilot, ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, or similar) to support software development activities such as coding, debugging, testing, documentation, code review, and problem solving, with the ability to evaluate and validate AI-generated outputs
  • Foundational understanding of software engineering concepts, problem solving, debugging, and application support.
  • Interest in learning modern web technologies, APIs, cloud platforms, production operations, and digital client experience systems.
  • Ability to communicate clearly, ask good questions, document findings, and follow established processes.
  • Willingness to support production systems and occasionally respond to urgent issues or release-related needs.
  • Demonstrates the American Century Investments Winning Behaviors: Client Focused, Courageous and Accountable, Collaborative, Curious and Adaptable, Competitively Driven.

Additional Assets (Preferred)

  • Exposure to front-end or full-stack development using technologies such as JavaScript, TypeScript, React, Node.js, Svelte/SvelteKit, HTML, CSS, or related frameworks.
  • 2+ years of software development experience
  • Familiarity with APIs, integrations, authentication, content management systems, analytics tools, or SaaS platforms.
  • Internship, co-op, academic, or early career experience supporting websites, mobile applications, digital platforms, or enterprise applications.
  • Exposure to Agile or product-oriented delivery models, including work in cross-functional pods or scrum teams.
  • Curiosity about digital client experiences, accessibility, observability, monitoring, reliability, and continuous improvement.

The above statements are not intended to be a complete list of all responsibilities, duties, and skills required.

What We Offer

  • Competitive compensation package with bonus plan
  • Generous PTO and competitive benefits
  • 401k with 5% company match plus annual performance-based discretionary contribution
  • Tuition reimbursement, formal mentorship program, live and online learning

Learn more about our benefits and perks.

title: Associate, Asia Direct Lending
description:
Over the last 20 years, Ares’ success has been driven by our people and our culture. Today, our team is guided by our core values – Collaborative, Responsible, Entrepreneurial, Self-Aware, Trustworthy – and our purpose to be a catalyst for shared prosperity and a better future. Through our recruitment, career development and employee-focused programming, we are committed to fostering a welcoming and inclusive work environment where high-performance talent of diverse backgrounds, experiences, and perspectives can build careers within this exciting and growing industry.

Job Description

We are seeking a high-calibre investment professional with a strong analytical foundation and a genuine interest in private credit and direct lending. The Associate will be an integral member of Ares' Asia Direct Lending team, supporting the full investment lifecycle across sourcing, underwriting and credit analysis, transaction execution, and post-closing portfolio management. The role provides exposure to the end-to-end investment process, from opportunity screening and underwriting through execution and ongoing portfolio monitoring.

This is a highly interactive role that combines rigorous financial analysis and modelling with investment judgement, transaction execution, and external engagement. The successful candidate will work closely with senior investment professionals, management teams, and sponsors while gaining meaningful responsibility throughout the investment lifecycle. Candidates with less experience may be considered for the Analyst level.

Primary Functions & Essential Responsibilities

  • Perform detailed financial and market research and analysis to support investment decisions across new credit opportunities

  • Screen and assess new investment opportunities

  • Build and maintain complex Excel financial models, including cash flow analysis, debt sizing and structuring

  • Preparation and presentation of investment committee materials

  • Prepare presentations and pitches for internal and external use

  • Analyse investment and portfolio performance, including maintaining and updating investment valuations and financial models and monitoring relevant market activity, including providing internal pipeline updates

  • Prepare portfolio reporting, including summarising changes in performance and updating forecasts

  • Assist with negotiating and preparing legal documentation and supporting investment closings

  • Meeting with management teams and sponsors in connection with new investment opportunities and ongoing portfolio monitoring

  • Additional duties, including providing direct support as deemed necessary by senior management

Qualifications

  • A relevant Bachelor’s degree or international equivalent from a top-tier institution

  • Minimum of 2 years of relevant experience, with backgrounds in private credit, leveraged finance, investment banking and/or principal investing particularly relevant

  • Strong intellectual ability, with excellent quantitative, financial and analytical skills

  • Advanced Excel modelling capability with strong PowerPoint skills

  • A self-motivated, driven approach and the ability to operate effectively in a collegial, fast-moving, demanding and dynamic environment

  • Appetite to invest in and build a scaled direct lending business in Asia

  • Creative problem-solving ability and sound judgement

  • Strong team player

  • Exceptional interpersonal skills, with the confidence to engage with colleagues, management teams and sponsors

Reporting Relationships

Partner, Head of Asia Direct Lending

This is an opportunity to build your investment banking career at a global institution with a leading presence across energy and financial markets.

  • Analyze sophisticated financial data to support client proposals, strategic plans, and transaction execution materials.

description:
Logitech is the Sweet Spot for people who want their actions to have a positive global impact while having the flexibility to do it in their own way.

The Team and Role:
The Personal Workspace Solution group from Logitech is committed to help people create and communicate their passion and work to the world, anytime anywhere. Putting users front and center, we strive to innovate and elevate their experiences. This is more than computer mice, keyboards, webcams and presentation remotes - it’s about enabling the future beyond today's tools and in a sustainable way. Everything goes through great design and exceptional user experience conveyed in great hardware and elevated by software.

As Lead Imaging Engineer, you will be responsible for imaging/video products (Webcams and other video capable devices). You will be tasked with delivering amazing video image quality by combining image acquisition, image analysis, image quality tuning, image processing, computational photography, computer vision, AI Machine Learning and Deep Learning. You will be responsible for analyzing, designing, specifying and implementing video solutions addressing the needs of current and future generations of products in overall objective and subjective image/video quality as well as integrating them in current and future video capable products.

You will stay on top of the latest innovation in both hardware for our products (sensor, SoC, …) but also equipment required to test and validate our product. As standards for video are constantly evolving, you will monitor their evolution and identify opportunities for Logitech to retain its competitive edge.

Your Contribution:
Be Yourself. Be Open. Stay Hungry and Humble. Collaborate. Challenge. Decide and Do. These are the behaviors you’ll need for success at Logitech. In this role you will be responsible for:

● Applying knowhow and experience in ISP and image quality tuning for both objective criteria and subjective real life use cases.

● Devising improvement in color processing pipeline (Defective pixel correction, Color interpolation, Gamma, Denoise, Sharpness, Brightness, Contrast, Saturation, …) and automatic feedback loops (AutoExposure, AutoWhiteBalance, AutoFocus).

● Originating novel algorithms for improving video image quality in areas of noise reduction, details retention, facial enhancement, etc.

● Creating new imaging features for improving user experience of image quality by intelligent understanding of the scene by the camera.

● Implementing and optimizing algorithms utilizing image processing, computational photography, computer vision, Deep Learning, and AI techniques.

● Collaborating with team members to deliver the best cost/experience compromises.

Your theoretical knowledge and hands-on expertise in imaging will be applied to all Video components of the camera system resulting in optimized and balanced performance.


Key Qualifications:
For consideration, you must bring the following minimum skills and behaviors to our team:

● Knowledgeable in Optics, Image Sensors, ISP and IQ tuning.

● Experience in camera image processing, color science, computational photography, ISP pipeline development (3A, image enhancement algorithms, Auto Scene Detection), HDR (Color Gamuts & Dynamic Range), Deep Learning or ML, and AI.

● Experience in ISP algorithms using Deep Learning techniques, such as Demosaic, Noise Reduction, Super-Resolution is a definite plus.

● Hands-on experience in image and video processing algorithm implementation, optimization, and debugging in embedded systems. Understand the runtime environment of algorithms on ISP hardware, GPU, NPU, and multi-core CPUs.

● Experience in both objective image quality in laboratory environments and subjective image quality in real world user scenarios.

● Familiarity with imaging standards, certification and organizations, Rec.709, BT.2020, Microsoft Teams, Zoom, VCX, SPIE, ...

● Proficiency in:

o Color Science, Camera Image Signal Processing, Digital Video

o OpenCV, Deep Learning, Matlab, GPU programming, Imatest

o C / C++ / Python software programming

o Linux and RTOS environments

Education:

● MS Computer Science or equivalent with 10+ years of relevant working experience in the multimedia, imaging processing field.

This position is based at the Clinical Academic Campus (CAC) at Kelowna General Hospital (KGH) and provides administrative coordination for Year 3 and 4 Medical Undergraduate Program (MDUP) and Postgraduate Medical Education (PGME) programs, supporting mandatory rotations and electives at clinics and hospital sites through the Interior. The incumbent, working with the SMP Clinical Education Program Manager and Course Directors and faculty leads, liaises with faculty, staff, students and residents of the Faculty of Medicine (FoM).

This position is in a state of evolution whereby duties may be modified, systems and procedures will need to be developed as operational requirements and capacity of learner’s increases. This position will require an individual who is comfortable in an atmosphere of ambiguity while systems and processes are being established.

Organizational Status

The incumbent reports directly to the SMP Clinical Education Program Manager and works closely with SMP and FoM Site Directors and Education Leads, clinical Faculty, Program and Site Coordinators and the Assessment and Evaluation Administrator and Interior Health (IH) administrators. The incumbent interacts independently with medical students, residents, clinical faculty and staff, community preceptors, medical office assistants and hospital administrators throughout the Interior Health Authority; UBC Undergraduate and Postgraduate departments in the Faculty of Medicine; and other healthcare professionals.

Work Performed

1. Provides Program Administration of the Medical Undergraduate Program (MDUP):

  • Manages student placements for the mandatory MDUP rotations and electives at the relevant site. Year 4 electives, Rural Family Practice rotations and Integrated Community Clerkship (ICC) programs require support and student management collaboration across sites within the interior.
  • Ensures MDUP students have access to systems, privileges and facilities (UBC and Interior Health) as required for their clinical activity in the region; liaising with medical staff administration as required.
  • Gathers and collates information on rotations/electives, including community and practice profiles, availability, and local contact information. Coordinates and ensures the provision of hospital privileges for students.
  • Maintains up-to-date schedules and relevant confidential records and data on all SMP Year 3/4 students and in some cases, other UBC UG learners who are placed within the Interior.
  • Maintains the on-line learning platforms related to SMP Year 3/4 rotations/electives (currently these are MedNET, Entrada and One45).
  • Responsible for monitoring performance of the placement experience and, along with the Faculty Lead and Clinical Education Program Manager, ensures that the delivery of the rotation/elective meets program objectives and expectations.
  • Liaises with Faculty Leads and Clinical Education Program Manager regarding any student/preceptor issues that may arise during the student placements. In collaboration with SMP Student Affairs, supports students with issues or concerns they may have during their placements to support their academic well-being.
  • Ensures effective internal and external communications between the program and the various staff, students, faculty, preceptors, medical office assistants and hospital contacts (within the Interior, and in some cases rural BC). Responsible for monitoring correspondence on behalf of the FoM rotations/electives, ensuring timely responses and flagging key issues.
  • Analyzes information regarding other programs affecting the undergraduate medical program, provides projections and forecasts of placement numbers. Responsible for working with undergraduate and postgraduate administrative staff and faculty to coordinate learners' schedules.
  • Assists in implementing any planning and policy development related to Year 3/4 clinical education and overall program priorities, including faculty development.
  • Assists the Faculty and Clinical Education Program Manager in responding to recruitment mandates and submits the relevant on-boarding documentation.
  • Initiates and follows through with critical recruitment and onboarding processes for teaching faculty before teaching can occur.
  • Works with distributed staff/faculty to coordinate and manage access of Academic Sessions/Lectures delivery and content using both local and a distributed delivery system.

2. Supports Assessment and Evaluation:

  • Works closely with the SMP Assessment and Evaluation Administrator and Clinical Education Program Manager to support the assessment and evaluation processes. These processes must strictly follow accreditation standards set forth by the Liaison Committee for Medical Education (LCME) and UBC Policies and Procedures, which includes a comprehensive absence policy.
  • Supports the implementation of a system of appraisal for students and teachers.

3. Supports teaching payments:

  • Responsible for accurately gathering, tracking and data entry of clinical teaching activity by Faculty of Medicine (FoM) preceptors to ensure preceptors are paid correctly and timely according to the payment schedule, as it relates to tracking clinical teaching payments.

4. Supports collaborative administration processes for MDUP and PG programs in the region

  • Works with PGME administrative staff to support and coordinate scheduling of PGME program and MDUP activity in the local hospital(s) and clinics.

5. Performs other related duties as necessary in keeping with the qualifications and requirements of the job

Consequence of Error/Judgement

It is imperative that effective partnerships and relationships are built within the various communities and out-patient clinics. Error in judgment, or ineffective communication, may lead to damaged relationships within the community, or with the rotation and program, or loss of preceptors for the program and could have immediate repercussions for the learners and hospital staff, and on medical education program delivery.

Supervision Received

The incumbent reports to the Clinical Education Program Manager, they are expected to work with minimal level of supervision. The incumbent is expected to be able to take initiative, exercise judgement, problem-solve, apply discretion to determine course of action and follow through independently. Unusual issues, or decisions where clear procedures are not available, will be directed to the Clinical Education Program Manager, Site Directors, or the Administrative Director as appropriate for direction, advice and collaboration.

Supervision Given

None.

Preferred Qualifications

High school graduation and two (2) years of post-secondary education supplemented by relevant administrative training. Minimum three (3) years' experience or the equivalent combination of education and experience. Previous experience in an undergraduate medical program or related medical education experience is an asset. - Advanced user of Microsoft Windows and Office applications including Word, Excel, PowerPoint, Outlook and MSTeams and Sharepoint Online.

  • Demonstrated interpersonal and diplomacy skills, as well as demonstrated ability to develop effective working relationships with community members, staff, faculty and students.
  • Enthusiasm to nurture an environment that celebrates diversity, builds on strengths found in differences and seeks to encourage growth in all members of the team.
  • Enthusiasm to work with equity, diversity and inclusion-based approaches to advance UBC and Faculty of Medicine priorities and initiatives.
  • Familiarity with Familiarity with collaborative tools such as MS Teams and SharePoint Online is an asset.
  • Knowledge of Zoom, AV, web conferencing and video conferencing equipment technology.
  • Ability to take initiative, and work with minimal supervision within a team environment.
  • Strong organizational skills and ability to prioritize to accommodate changing workload.
  • Ability to work effectively in a dynamic and demanding environment.
  • Excellent professional judgment.
  • Strong interpersonal skills.
  • Must have superlative problem-solving skills, and the ability to navigate in the changing landscape of medical education.
  • Ability to take initiative, determine course of action and then follow through independently.
  • Ability to communicate effectively, both verbally and in writing.
  • Ability to multi-task with attention to detail.
  • Demonstrate project planning skills to meet deadlines and follow up, ensuring deliverables are met.
  • Flexible; comfortable working within ambiguity; invigorated by change, often requiring immediate responses and solutions within a high stake's environment.
  • Superior knowledge of file and records classification systems and processes.
  • Ability to exercise high level of tact and discretion, project positive image and be diplomatic in stressful situations while maintaining confidentiality in dealing with students and faculty.
  • Familiarity with rural and urban communities throughout the Interior and other British Columbia regional health authorities is an asset. - Some travel to UBC Okanagan campus and other hospital/clinic sites may be required.

title: Director of Finance
location: Bronx County, New York, United States
description:
Location: Bronx County,New York,United States

About DreamYard

DreamYard is a Bronx-based arts and social justice education organization that partners with young people, families, and schools to expand pathways to equity and opportunity. DreamYard is committed to being an anti-racist organization and to advancing its mission through strong community partnerships, sustained learning, and responsible stewardship of resources.

Position Summary

The Director of Finance owns DreamYard’s accounting, budgeting, forecasting, cash management, grant finance, reporting, audit, and internal-control functions. Reporting to the Chief Operating Officer, the Director translates financial information into clear recommendations for leadership and the Board, manages the accountant, and ensures timely, accurate, GAAP-compliant financial operations. The role combines strategic planning with hands-on review and, when needed, transaction-level support.

Key Responsibilities

Financial Planning, Forecasting, and Analysis

  • Lead the annual organization-wide budget process; build the budget calendar, templates, assumptions, department targets, and final consolidated budget for leadership and Board approval.

  • Distribute monthly budget-to-actual reports to department leaders and hold monthly variance reviews with budget owners; investigate material variances, document explanations, and update the full-year forecast and action plan.

  • Maintain a rolling cash-flow forecast, monitor bank balances and liquidity, and alert the COO to projected shortfalls, timing risks, or financing needs.

  • Prepare quarterly forecasts, multi-year financial scenarios, contingency plans, and trend analyses covering revenue, expenses, staffing, cash, and reserves.

  • Prepare Finance Committee and Board materials, including financial statements, budget-to-actual results, cash outlook, key risks, and management recommendations.

  • Partner with the COO and external financial consultant on financial strategy, complex accounting matters, multi-year scenarios, and organizational risk management.

  • Participate in Leadership Team meetings and connect financial decisions to DreamYard’s mission, operating priorities, and racial-equity commitments.

Accounting and Month-End Close

  • Own the monthly close calendar and review accounts payable, accounts receivable, bank and credit-card reconciliations, payroll entries, accruals, prepaids, and other close schedules completed by the accountant.

  • Review the trial balance and reconcile all balance-sheet accounts monthly; investigate unusual balances, aging items and suspense activity.

  • Produce monthly GAAP financial statements and management reports, including the statement of financial position, statement of activities, and budget-to-actual analysis.

  • Maintain the chart of accounts, dimensions, reporting structures, close checklists, and supporting workpapers so reports can be produced consistently from the accounting system.

Grant, Contract, and Revenue Management

  • Review grant and contract agreements when awarded; document funding amount, period, restrictions, match requirements, reporting deadlines, billing terms, and revenue-recognition treatment

  • Maintain grant budgets and revenue schedules and reconcile restricted net assets, releases from restriction, receivables, deferred revenue, and grant expenses each month.

  • Coordinate with Development and Program teams to verify coding, allowable costs, budget availability, deliverables, and reporting data before invoices or funder reports are submitted.

  • Oversee government contract billing portals and schedules; review invoices and supporting documentation, track submissions and collections, and escalate overdue receivables.

  • Review financial reports for foundation, corporate, and government funders and ensure reported amounts tie to the general ledger.

  • Collaborate with Director of Development on monthly reconciliation reports and meetings with leadership

Controls, Audit, Systems, and Team Management

  • Lead the annual financial-statement audit: prepare the audit timeline and request list, assign schedules, review workpapers, coordinate responses, and track open items through issuance.

  • Maintain and update finance policies, approval limits, segregation of duties, documentation standards, and internal controls; test adherence and remediate exceptions.

  • Ensure compliance with GAAP, nonprofit reporting requirements, grant terms, tax and regulatory filings, and organizational policies.

  • Supervise the accountant through clear work assignments, coaching, and training.

  • Improve and document finance workflows; standardize recurring reports, reduce manual work, automate appropriate processes, and strengthen real-time access to accurate data.

  • Administer and optimize Sage Intacct and connected finance tools, including user access, dimensions, report logic, integrations, and data-quality controls.

Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in accounting, finance, business administration, or a related field; CPA is a plus.

  • Seven or more years of progressively responsible nonprofit accounting and finance experience, preferably in a grant-funded organization.

  • Demonstrated experience leading budgeting, forecasting, month-end close, financial reporting, cash management, audit preparation, and internal controls.

  • Strong knowledge of GAAP, nonprofit financial reporting, restricted contributions, government contracts, grant accounting, and revenue recognition.

  • Advanced Excel skills and proficiency with accounting systems; Sage Intacct experience is strongly preferred.

  • Ability to prepare and analyze financial statements, identify risks and trends, and convert findings into practical recommendations.

  • Experience supervising accounting staff and setting clear standards for accuracy, timeliness, documentation, and follow-through.

  • Excellent communication skills and the ability to explain complex financial matters to staff, leadership, Board members, and other non-financial stakeholders.

  • Strong judgment, attention to detail, time management, collaboration, and problem-solving skills.

  • Commitment to DreamYard’s mission, core values, and anti-racism commitment.

Compensation and Benefits

This is a full-time, hybrid, exempt position with a salary range of $125,000-$140,000 commensurate with experience. DreamYard offers a comprehensive benefits package and generous paid time off.

Equal Opportunity Statement

DreamYard is an equal opportunity employer. Employment decisions are made without unlawful discrimination based on race, color, religion, sex, gender identity, age, national origin, genetic characteristics, disability, veteran status, marital status, sexual orientation, sexual identity, or any other status protected by applicable law. DreamYard welcomes applicants from diverse backgrounds; Bronx-based and Spanish-speaking applicants are strongly encouraged to apply.

description:
