title: Head of International Deposit & Payment Execution
description:
The Head of International Deposit & Payment Group Manager is a senior management level position responsible for accomplishing results through the management of a team or department in an effort to establish and implement new or revised application systems and programs in coordination with the Technology Team. The overall objective of this role is to drive applications systems analysis and programming activities.

We are seeking a highly strategic, technical, and people-oriented Product & Technical Delivery Manager to lead a high-performing team of Technical Analysts. In this role, you will be responsible for the end-to-end lifecycle of our Deposits and Payments products, bridging the gap between business strategy and technical execution.

The ideal candidate possesses deep domain expertise in retail/wealth deposits and modern payment rails, combined with a proven track record of managing hybrid teams. You will champion agile methodologies, foster a culture of continuous improvement, and collaborate closely with engineering, architecture, operations, compliance, and business stakeholders to deliver secure, scalable, and customer-centric financial solutions

Responsibilities:

  • Team Leadership & People Management (35%)

  • Direct Management: Lead, mentor, and develop a hybrid team of Technical Analysts (focused on system requirements, API specifications, and data mapping).
  • Talent Development: Establish clear performance goals, conduct regular career development discussions, and provide continuous coaching to elevate the team's product management and technical analysis capabilities.
  • Resource Allocation: Manage capacity planning and resource allocation across multiple agile squads to ensure optimal delivery of the product roadmap.
  • Culture: Foster an inclusive, collaborative, and high-ownership environment that encourages innovation, technical excellence, and customer empathy.

Risk & Fraud: Understanding of payment fraud prevention, transaction monitoring, Anti-Money Laundering (AML), Know Your Customer (KYC), and Office of Foreign Assets Control (OFAC) compliance

Domain-Specific Expertise (Deposits & Payments)

Candidates must demonstrate a strong understanding of the following areas:

Core Deposits: Account lifecycle management (onboarding, maintenance, closure), interest accrual and posting engines, fee structures, ledger systems, and statement generation. Payment Rails: Deep knowledge of domestic and international payment systems, including ACH, Wire transfers, Real-Time Payments (RTP), FedNow, SWIFT, and ISO 20022 messaging standards. Modern Architecture: Familiarity with API-driven banking (RESTful APIs, gRPC), event-driven architectures (Kafka, RabbitMQ), and cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, or GCP).

Stakeholder Management, Compliance & Risk (20%)

Cross-Functional Alignment: Serve as the primary liaison between your team and key stakeholders across Engineering, Operations, Legal, Risk, Information Security, and Compliance. Regulatory Compliance: Ensure all deposits and payments products strictly adhere to local and international financial regulations, security standards, and data privacy laws. Vendor Management: Manage relationships with third-party technology vendors, payment networks, and core banking providers, ensuring deliverables meet SLA and contractual obligations.

Technical Analysis & System Delivery (20%)

Technical Translation: Guide Technical Analysts in translating complex business requirements into robust technical specifications, API contracts, data schemas, and system workflows. Architecture Collaboration: Work closely with Enterprise Architects and Lead Engineers to ensure product designs align with modern, scalable, and secure architectural standards (e.g., microservices, cloud-native infrastructure). Quality Assurance: Oversee the definition of comprehensive testing strategies, including User Acceptance Testing (UAT) and integration testing, to ensure zero-defect delivery. Production Support: Act as an escalation point for critical production incidents, ensuring rapid resolution and post-mortem analysis to prevent recurrence.

2. Product Strategy & Roadmap Execution (25%)

Roadmap Alignment: Partner with business leaders to translate the overarching Deposits and Payments business strategy into a concrete, prioritized product roadmap. Lifecycle Management: Oversee the product lifecycle from conceptualization, market research, and business case development through to launch, maintenance, and decommissioning. Agile Governance: Ensure the team maintains a healthy, well-prioritized product backlog with clearly defined user stories, acceptance criteria, and non-functional requirements. Metrics & Analytics: Define and track key performance indicators (KPIs) for product health, adoption, transaction volume, and system reliability, using data to drive continuous optimization.

Qualifications:

  • Experience:

    • Minimum of 15+ years of experience in digital product management, technical analysis, or systems engineering within the financial services or FinTech sector.
    • Minimum of 8+ years of direct people management experience, successfully leading hybrid teams of product and technical professionals.
  • Methodologies: Strong expertise in Agile/Scrum frameworks, with experience acting as a Product Owner or Product Manager in a SAFe (Scaled Agile Framework) or multi-squad environment.
  • Tools: Proficiency with product management and collaboration tools such as Jira, Confluence, Productboard, and Miro.

  • Preferred Qualifications:

  • Master’s degree or MBA.
  • Professional certifications: Certified Scrum Product Owner (CSPO), Pragmatic Institute, Agile Certified Practitioner (PMI-ACP), or Project Management Professional (PMP).
  • Experience migrating legacy core banking or payment systems to modern, cloud-native platforms.

  • Key Competencies & Soft Skills

  • Strategic Thinker: Ability to see the big picture while maintaining a sharp eye for technical details and execution.
  • Influential Communicator: Exceptional verbal and written communication skills, with the ability to articulate complex technical concepts to non-technical business stakeholders and vice versa.
  • Problem Solver: Strong analytical and troubleshooting skills, with a calm and decisive demeanor under pressure.
  • Collaborative Leader: Proven ability to build consensus, resolve conflicts, and drive alignment across highly matrixed organizations.

Education:

  • Education: Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Business Administration, Finance, or a related field (or equivalent practical experience).
  • Master’s degree preferred

title: Equity Research Analyst - Banks (Vice President)
location: New York New York United States
description:
Citi Research is seeking a Vice President Equity Research Analyst to join the Banks research team, contributing to differentiated, high-quality investment research for institutional clients globally.

This is an opportunity to take on a highly visible role within a dynamic sector at the center of evolving interest rate environments, credit cycles, capital and liquidity trends, regulatory developments, technological disruption, and changing competitive dynamics across financial services.

The Research Analyst will play an integral role across the full research process, from developing investment theses and maintaining sophisticated financial models to producing actionable research, engaging with company management teams, and communicating investment views to institutional investors.

The role requires strong analytical judgment, intellectual curiosity, and the ability to translate complex financial, industry, and macroeconomic developments into clear and differentiated investment insights.

Responsibilities:

  • Conduct in-depth fundamental research and financial analysis across companies within the Banks sector, identifying key earnings drivers, catalysts, risks, and emerging industry themes.

  • Develop differentiated investment theses and actionable investment ideas based on company fundamentals, industry dynamics, macroeconomic trends, regulatory developments, and market conditions.

  • Build, maintain, and enhance detailed financial models, including earnings forecasts, valuation frameworks, scenario analysis, and sensitivity analysis.

  • Author and contribute to high-quality research publications, including company updates, earnings analysis, thematic research, industry reports, and initiation reports.

  • Monitor company, sector, regulatory, and macroeconomic developments and assess their implications for covered companies and investor positioning.

  • Engage with institutional investors, responding to research inquiries and communicating investment views, industry developments, and company-specific insights.

  • Build and maintain relationships with company management teams, industry participants, and other relevant market contacts to deepen the team’s research perspective.

  • Participate in company meetings, investor events, industry conferences, analyst days, and other research-related events.

  • Partner closely with colleagues across Research, Sales, Trading, and other areas of Citi to deliver timely and differentiated insights to clients.

  • Identify and incorporate new data sources, analytical techniques, and emerging technologies, including AI-enabled research tools, to enhance research quality and efficiency.

  • Establish yourself as a subject matter expert within the Banks sector and contribute to the continued development of Citi’s research franchise.

  • Provide informal leadership within the team, including mentoring and supporting junior colleagues and contributing to their professional development.

  • Appropriately assess risk when making business decisions, demonstrating sound judgment and maintaining the highest standards of integrity, transparency, and compliance with applicable laws, regulations, and Citi policies.

Required Qualifications & Skills

  • 6–10 years of relevant professional experience, ideally within equity research, investment banking, asset management, financial services, or another closely related investment research function.

  • Bachelor’s degree in Finance, Accounting, Economics, Business, or a related field.

  • Strong understanding of financial statements, accounting principles, valuation methodologies, and fundamental investment analysis.

  • Demonstrated ability to develop and communicate investment theses through high-quality written research and verbal presentations.

  • Advanced financial modeling and analytical skills, with the ability to evaluate complex financial institutions and identify key earnings and valuation drivers.

  • Strong understanding of financial markets and the macroeconomic, regulatory, and competitive factors affecting the banking sector.

  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to translate complex analysis into clear and compelling investment narratives.

  • Ability to engage confidently with institutional investors, company management teams, and senior internal stakeholders.

  • Strong intellectual curiosity, commercial judgment, attention to detail, and ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced, time-sensitive environment.

  • Demonstrated ability to work collaboratively while taking ownership of research deliverables and investment views.

  • Securities licenses as required by the role, or ability to obtain applicable licenses.

Beneficial Skills & Qualifications

  • Experience using Bloomberg Terminal, FactSet, Capital IQ, or similar financial platforms.

  • CFA designation or progress toward the CFA is preferred, but not required.

  • Prior experience or demonstrated expertise in Banks, Financial Institutions, or the broader Financial Services sector.

  • Strong understanding of bank-specific financial and valuation metrics, regulatory considerations, credit trends, and capital markets dynamics.

  • Experience engaging with institutional investors, company management teams, or other senior market participants.

  • Experience mentoring or supporting junior research professionals is a plus.

What We Offer

At Citi, you will work alongside a team of experienced research professionals operating at the forefront of the global technology sector, with access to the resources, relationships, and reach of one of the world's leading financial institutions.

We are committed to supporting your long-term career growth, professional development, and overall wellbeing.

  • Hybrid working model with 3 days in the office and 2 days working remotely, giving you flexibility and structure in equal measure.

  • Strategic influence over how Citi's Technology & Communications research reaches institutional clients and shapes market perspectives globally.

  • Access to senior leadership, global industry networks, and cross-functional collaboration across Citi's research and investment banking franchise.

  • Ongoing learning and professional development opportunities, including support for advanced qualifications and continuing education.

  • Wellbeing support and work-life balance resources designed to sustain long-term performance and personal resilience.

  • Competitive compensation and financial wellbeing benefits, including access to Citi's broader employee financial programmes.

Apply today and take the next step toward building your career in Equity Research at Citi.

At RTX, the world’s largest aerospace and defense company, 185,000 great minds are united by purpose and inspired to make a difference solving the world’s most complex problems. This role is responsible for managing EACs (Estimate at Completion), Earned Value (EV), and Integrated Master Schedules (IMS) across multiple concurrent contracts. A key focus will be on developing, analyzing, and maintaining EACs to ensure accurate financial forecasting and tracking program performance. This includes monitoring cost, schedule, and technical performance metrics, conducting variance analysis, identifying risks and opportunities, and providing actionable insights to drive informed decisions.

Additionally, this role includes managing 1-2 major program suppliers, overseeing the complete purchase order lifecycle for new contracts, and ensuring supplier alignment with program objectives, schedules, and performance goals.

This position requires experience in supply chain management, material requirements planning (MRP), procurement processes, and supplier engagement to enable successful execution of new program startup activities. Responsibilities will also include contributing to the development of material strategies, fostering supplier relationships, and supporting program objectives during the early stages of contract execution.

Success in this role will require analytical and problem-solving skills, coupled with clearly communicating complex financial and program data to stakeholders. Collaboration across cross-functional teams, suppliers, and leadership is essential, with a consistent focus on meeting cost, quality, and schedule requirements.

What You Will Do

  • Lead the development, analysis, and management of EACs (Estimate at Completion) to ensure accurate financial forecasting and tracking of program performance, including cost, schedule, and technical data.
  • Apply Earned Value Management System (EVMS) principles to monitor program progress, assess performance metrics, and provide actionable recommendations to stakeholders for achieving program objectives.
  • Collaborate with Program Management, Finance, Integrated Product Teams (IPTs), Engineering, Quality, and Procurement to develop and execute Material Strategies that align with program requirements and financial goals.
  • Coordinate and oversee the procurement execution and management of purchase orders for new contracts, ensuring supplier alignment with program schedules, cost objectives, and performance expectations.
  • Support supplier negotiations, ensuring procurement activities are executed accurately, on time, and within budget to meet critical program milestones.
  • Facilitate the seamless transition of supply chain responsibilities from the new contract team to the production execution team.
  • Provide program support, including material requirements planning (MRP) and master data management, ensuring timely and accurate inputs into the supply chain process to enable successful program execution.
  • Manage supplier relationships, addressing risk mitigation, tracking performance, and ensuring compliance with customer requirements, including FAR/DFARS, ITAR, and other regulatory guidelines.
  • Prepare and deliver briefings to program leadership on supply chain status, material constraints, EAC updates, and risk mitigation strategies during program startup and execution phases.
  • Support proposal efforts for new contracts by contributing to supplier strategies, cost estimates, and scope definitions for material-related tasks.
  • Drive accurate and timely financial management activities, including EACs, material sales forecasts, and variance analysis to ensure alignment with program financial expectations.
  • Provide issue resolution, fostering communication and collaboration across internal teams and external suppliers to ensure program success.
  • Travel domestically or internationally as needed (up to 30%) to support supplier engagement and program requirements.

Qualifications You Must Have

  • Typically requires a University Degree or equivalent experience and minimum 10 years prior relevant supply chain experience or an advanced degree and 7 years of prior relevant supply chain experience
  • Experience with Supply Chain, Production Control, and/or Procurement processes and requirements.
  • Experience managing program cost and schedule
  • Experience with Prime Contract Requirements and Statements of Work (SSOWs).
  • Experience using supply chain planning tools

Qualifications We Prefer

  • Advanced Microsoft Office skillset
  • Advanced Supply Chain Planning tool experience (i.e. SAP/PRISM, Kinaxis, MFT, ROMS, etc.)
  • Experience with proposals or material estimating
  • MPM Level 4 (or higher) Certification
  • EVMS Certification
  • Experience with Earned Value Management and/or Financial forecasting.

title: Sr Network Architect
description:
Senior Network Architect | HM- Ashish Pawar

Your Day at Altera Digital Health

The Senior Network Architect is a highly skilled subject matter expert responsible for designing, architecting, and leading complex and strategic network initiatives.

This role involves setting network technology standards, driving innovation, and providing technical leadership in network infrastructure design and implementation.

The Senior Network Architect plays a pivotal role in shaping network strategies and ensuring alignment with overall business objectives.

Location: Pune, India – Remote
Experience: 15–18+ Years
Certification: CCIE – Mandatory

What You'll Be Doing

Key Responsibilities

  • Lead the design and architecture of advanced network solutions, including LAN, WAN, Data Center, Cloud, and Hybrid Cloud environments.
  • Develop highly scalable, secure, resilient, and high-performing network architectures to meet current and future business requirements.
  • Define and establish network technology standards, best practices, architecture principles, and technology roadmaps.
  • Evaluate new networking technologies and recommend their adoption based on business and technical requirements.
  • Contribute to strategic network initiatives that align with the company's long-term technology and business goals.
  • Introduce innovative solutions and approaches to enhance network performance, security, availability, scalability, and operational efficiency.
  • Lead and manage network projects from inception through completion.
  • Ensure project objectives are achieved, resources are allocated effectively, and project milestones are delivered successfully.
  • Collaborate closely with senior leadership, cross-functional teams, and business stakeholders to ensure network solutions align with overall business strategies.
  • Serve as a senior-level subject matter expert and provide technical guidance, mentorship, and knowledge sharing to network engineering and operations teams.
  • Establish and maintain strong relationships with network vendors, service providers, cloud providers, and technology partners.
  • Evaluate vendor offerings and technical solutions and provide recommendations aligned with organizational requirements.
  • Lead efforts to optimize network performance by analyzing traffic patterns, implementing appropriate QoS strategies, improving network resiliency, and enhancing availability.
  • Stay current with emerging networking technologies, industry trends, and technology developments and assess their applicability to the organization.
  • Develop and maintain high-level network documentation, including architecture diagrams, HLD/LLD documents, configuration templates, standards, and technical guidelines.
  • Perform network capacity planning to accommodate anticipated business growth and evolving technology requirements.
  • Provide architectural guidance and technical leadership for network transformation, modernization, migration, and optimization initiatives.
  • Lead architecture reviews and ensure network designs comply with established enterprise standards, security requirements, and best practices.
  • Act as a senior technical escalation point for complex network architecture, performance, and connectivity issues.

Knowledge and Attributes

  • Extensive understanding of advanced networking concepts, protocols, architectures, and services.
  • Extensive proficiency in designing, configuring, and managing complex network environments, including routers, switches, firewalls, load balancers, SD-WAN, and cloud networking technologies.
  • Extensive knowledge of advanced network protocols and technologies such as BGP, OSPF, MPLS, VXLAN/EVPN, SD-WAN, QoS, IPv4/IPv6, and advanced security protocols.
  • Strong understanding of enterprise LAN, WAN, Data Center, Internet, and Hybrid Cloud architectures.
  • Extensive experience with Microsoft Azure and/or AWS cloud networking.
  • Strong understanding of network security architecture, firewalls, IDS/IPS, VPN, network segmentation, and secure connectivity.
  • Extensive hands-on experience with network monitoring, analysis, troubleshooting, and performance management tools.
  • Excellent documentation, communication, presentation, and stakeholder management skills.
  • Extensive proficiency in network administration, configuration, and architecture tools.
  • Proven experience leading and managing large-scale network architecture, transformation, and migration projects.
  • Strong problem-solving skills with the ability to diagnose and resolve complex network issues.
  • Strong ability to translate business requirements into scalable, secure, and resilient network architectures.
  • Strong ability to align network strategies and technology roadmaps with business objectives.
  • Ability to work effectively with global teams, senior leadership, vendors, service providers, and cross-functional stakeholders.

Academic Qualifications and Certifications

  • Bachelor's degree or equivalent in Information Technology, Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field.
  • Active CCIE certification is mandatory.
  • Preferred CCIE specializations include:
    • CCIE Enterprise Infrastructure
    • CCIE Service Provider
    • CCIE Security
  • Relevant cloud certifications such as Microsoft Azure, AWS, or Google Cloud are preferred.
  • Additional networking or security certifications are an advantage.

Required Experience

  • Minimum 15–18+ years of experience in the Network and Security domain.
  • Extensive experience in network engineering, architecture, and progressively responsible technical leadership roles.
  • Extensive experience working in large-scale enterprise networking environments.
  • Extensive experience designing and architecting complex LAN and WAN environments.
  • Extensive experience with network security and enterprise security architectures.
  • Extensive experience with Data Center networking and connectivity.
  • Extensive experience with cloud networking, including Azure and/or AWS.
  • Extensive experience with SD-WAN and software-defined networking (SDN) concepts.
  • Proven experience with network transformation, modernization, migration, and optimization initiatives.
  • Proven experience working with network vendors, ISPs, cloud providers, and technology partners.
  • Demonstrated experience providing technical leadership and architectural direction to engineering and operations teams.

Mandatory Requirements

  • 15–18+ years of relevant Network and Security experience.
  • Active CCIE certification – Mandatory.
  • Strong enterprise network architecture and design experience.
  • Expert-level Cisco networking experience.
  • Strong expertise in BGP, OSPF, MPLS, SD-WAN, LAN/WAN, and Data Center networking.
  • Strong experience with network security technologies.
  • Strong experience with cloud and hybrid network architectures.
  • Proven experience leading complex network projects and strategic initiatives.
  • Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills.

Location

Pune, India – Remote

The successful candidate will work as part of a global network architecture and engineering organization and will be expected to collaborate effectively with teams and stakeholders across different time zones.

Cox Fleet keeps your fleet moving!
Headquartered in Indianapolis, Cox Fleet has grown to become one of the largest fleet maintenance companies in the country.
Cox Fleet is the leading provider of on-site mobile maintenance and repair services nationwide, offering mobile on-site fleet service for light medium, and heavy-duty trucks and trailers. Cox Fleet also services customers utilizing its 50+ nationwide service centers; each offering accident repair, painting, refurbishment, and heavy mechanical repair. We are supported by a 24/7 in-house call-center and provide scheduled maintenance services and unscheduled services to fleets anywhere, anytime.
Cox Fleet is currently hiring a Mobile Diesel Technician Level II. The Mobile Diesel Technician Level II will be responsible for performing licensed DOT inspections, Preventative Maintenance inspections, light and follow-up repairs, light mechanical/hydraulic/electrical and electronic diagnostics, and other duties as assigned. The Mobile Diesel Technician II can perform more advanced diagnostics and repairs under the supervision of a Sr Mobile Diesel Technician or higher. The Diesel Technician II continues to learn additional advanced mechanical skills and diagnostic techniques. A successful Diesel Technician II complies with all company policies and achieves high level performance metrics.
DUTIES:
  • Perform scheduled preventative maintenance (“PM”), DOT Inspections and follow up repairs on light, medium and heavy-duty vehicles in a mobile/field environment.
  • Perform minor adjustment and repairs on various types of truck equipment including, but not limited to the following: Electrical/Brake/Cooling Systems, Starters/Alternators, Fan clutches, Engine electronics, Diesel steering systems, Engines (gas and diesel), Transmissions (manual and automatic), Clutches, Differentials, etc.
  • Diagnose, adjust, and repair various types of truck equipment including, but not limited to the following: Electrical/Brake/Cooling Systems, Starters/Alternators, Air conditioning systems, Fan clutches, Engine electronics, Diesel steering systems, Engines (gas and diesel), Transmissions (manual and automatic), Clutches, Differentials, etc.
  • Inspect, test, and listen to defective equipment to diagnose malfunctions, using test instruments such as handheld computers and pressure gauges.
  • Road test vehicles to diagnose malfunctions and to ensure that they are working properly.

title: Systems Engineer
description:
Radiance Technologies, a 100% employee-owned company, is seeking a technically strong and highly collaborative Systems Engineer to support a U.S. Government space and national security program in Boulder, Colorado.

This position is ideal for an engineer with strong systems engineering expertise and a collaborative, relationship-focused mindset. The successful candidate will apply systems engineering practices to mission design, interface definition, requirements, and technical baseline management while working closely with customers and multidisciplinary teams. We are looking for someone who can solve complex technical challenges while building trust with customers, teammates, and partners. Strong communication, teamwork, ownership, and the ability to contribute to a positive team culture are critical to success in this role. Experience with Model-Based Systems Engineering (MBSE) and Overhead Persistent Infrared (OPIR) missions is highly desirable.

This is a full-time, on-site position in Boulder, Colorado. Remote work is not available. The anticipated compensation for the position is $115,000 -$162,000 based on a full-time schedule. Your compensation will vary depending on your job-related skills, experience, and education.

Responsibilities

  • Contribute to all phases of a system lifecycle including: CONOPS, requirements, architecture, design, development, integration, test, operations, and maintenance
  • Maintain and develop system artifacts, including requirements, architecture designs, ICDs, use cases, system flow diagrams, and test plans
  • Conduct and/or support Technical Interchange Meetings with internal and external stakeholders
  • Work across cross-functional development teams, government teams, and/or vendors to drive problem resolution and collaboration
  • Support additional activities, such as special studies
  • Interface with the customer, leveraging strong interpersonal skills and attention to detail
  • In some cases, mentor junior and mid-level engineers and fill a leadership role within the team

Required Experience & Qualifications

  • US Government Active Secret Security Clearance required with eligibility for TS/SCI with a polygraph
  • Bachelor of Science degree in Engineering, Mathematics, Physical Sciences, Computer Science (relevant experience may be considered in lieu of education)
  • Minimum of eight (8) years of experience in Systems Engineering
  • Experience with multiple stages of the program lifecycle (design, integration, test, operations, maintenance)
  • Significant hands-on experience in one of the following domains: software, cloud, networking, or cyber.
  • Experience working in multi-disciplinary design and development teams
  • Experience with technical risk identification and management strategies
  • Ability to communicate technical information via oral presentation and written format
  • Strong communication (written and verbal) and presentation skills. Ability to passionately deliver high-level messaging to various types of audiences--this will eventually include senior leaders. Ability to explain technical concepts clearly to non-technical personnel
  • Self-motivated individual who actively and independently seeks out opportunities for learning and development
  • Collaborates well; enjoys working as part of a team
  • Live near or be willing to move to the Boulder, CO area since the work must be performed in the office
  • Live near or be willing to move to the Boulder, CO area

Desired Experience & Qualifications

  • Active US Government Security Clearance (Top Secret) with eligibility for SCI and a polygraph
  • A master’s degree in Systems Engineering or a related engineering field.
  • Experience supporting Department of War or Intelligence Community space programs.
  • Experience with Overhead Persistent Infrared (OPIR) ground systems
  • Experience with Model-Based Systems Engineering (MBSE) tools like Cameo, DOORS, Jira, Confluence, or similar engineering and collaboration tools.
  • Experience working within an agile workflow team environment

The Radiance Difference

Radiance is a 100% employee-owned company, and we believe our people are our greatest asset. We are looking for engineers who want to be part of a team—not simply fill a position.

Our most successful engineers combine technical excellence with strong relationships. They take pride in solving difficult problems, but they also understand that great engineering comes from collaboration, trust, communication, and a willingness to help the people around them succeed.

If you are a technically capable systems engineer who enjoys working directly with customers, building strong professional relationships, mentoring teammates, and contributing to a positive engineering culture, we want to hear from you.

Radiance Technologies is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, or protected veteran status.

title: Salesforce Sr. Product Owner (AI, CX, & Revenue)
description:
FICO (NYSE: FICO) is a leading global analytics software company, helping businesses in 100+ countries make better decisions. Join our world-class team today and fulfill your career potential!

The Opportunity

The Salesforce Sr. Product Owner (AI, CX, & Revenue) is a process design and Salesforce expert who brings both the strategic mindset of a seasoned product owner and the technical depth of a hands-on administrator. This person has deep Salesforce platform experience, a strong grasp of end-to-end Sales and Customer Success processes, and hands-on expertise with AI-powered solutions. They can design, build, and deliver Salesforce-enabled solutions independently, or in close partnership with our Salesforce Administrators, Developers, and Architects. This role owns high-impact Salesforce initiatives end to end: defining scope, leading stakeholder alignment, driving delivery, and championing adoption, while serving as the primary bridge between business strategy and technical execution, including agentic and AI-assisted workflows.

What You’ll Contribute

  • Serve as Salesforce/Systems Product Owner for assigned business units, converting requirements conversations and meeting notes into well-crafted user stories, acceptance criteria, and testing notes in Jira, using tools like Claude and Rovo to accelerate discovery, summarization, and documentation.
  • Lead the Salesforce feature release lifecycle and guide project delivery against established roadmaps, intaking, triaging, and synthesizing requests to surface prioritization patterns and stakeholder conflicts, coordinating development, testing, and go-live, and driving issue resolution and change management at speed.

  • Evaluate, design, and champion intelligent automation and agentic workflows, applying a framework that weighs data quality, complexity, and risk to determine where agent-led, agent-supported, or human-in-the-loop solutions best meet business needs.
  • Advise the business on a solution’s feasibility, user experience, and impact, including where agentic solutions deliver measurable value versus where human judgment remains essential, and translate that guidance into compelling executive narratives.
  • Serve as a subject matter expert on FICO’s Salesforce data and integrations, challenging data models, influencing integration design, and supporting data governance and reporting requirements that reliable automation depends on.
  • Build proof-of-concepts and design and execute testing approaches for potential solutions, including Agentforce agent configurations, prompt templates, AI-assisted user experiences, test scripts, and validation of AI agent behaviors.
  • Develop training materials and drive adoption of technology and process changes in partnership with global operations teams, including train-the-trainer programs and modeling best-in-class use of FICO’s AI tools (Claude, Rovo, Agentforce).

What We’re Seeking

  • Experience in business analysis, consulting, and/or administration on the Salesforce platform; experience with Salesforce Sales Cloud, Service Cloud, Experience Cloud, and Lightning preferred.
  • Strong subject matter expertise across core Salesforce CRM sales and customer experience principles, including Opportunity Management, Account and Contact Management, Lead Management, Quoting, Case Management, Entitlements, SLA Management, and Customer Onboarding.
  • End-to-end understanding of pre- and post-sale customer journeys, from demand generation and sales conversion through onboarding, adoption, expansion, renewal, and advocacy, with working knowledge of sales, marketing, finance, customer success, and support operations.
  • Demonstrated hands-on experience using AI tools (e.g., Claude, Copilot, ChatGPT, or similar) as a core part of daily work, identifying high-value use cases for business analysis, documentation, and solution design; hands-on experience with Salesforce Agentforce or similar agentic AI platforms strongly preferred.
  • Strong knowledge of data structures, governance, internal controls, and permission security, including impacts on reports, integrations, AI feature reliability, and responsible AI use.
  • Flexible and adaptable in fast-moving environments, with experience in agile methodologies (technology consulting or startup experience a plus) and a demonstrated ability to quickly learn evolving tools and AI capabilities.
  • Excellent communication and presentation skills, able to lead cross-functional meetings, engage both technical and business audiences, and convey complex solutions clearly to senior stakeholders; proficiency in Microsoft PowerPoint, Word, and Excel required.
  • Proven organizational, analytical, and project management skills, with the ability to manage multiple concurrent priorities and projects with strong attention to detail.
  • Bachelor’s degree in Business Administration, Computer Science, Information Technology, or related field. Salesforce certifications preferred, such as Salesforce Certified Platform Administrator, Platform App Builder, Agentforce Sales Consultant, Agentforce Service Consultant, Revenue Management Consultant, Experience Cloud Consultant, Agentforce Specialist, or Data 360 Consultant.

Our Offer to You

  • An inclusive culture strongly reflecting our core values: Act Like an Owner, Delight Our Customers and Earn the Respect of Others.
  • The opportunity to make an impact and develop professionally by leveraging your unique strengths and participating in valuable learning experiences.
  • Highly competitive compensation, benefits and rewards programs that encourage you to bring your best every day and be recognized for doing so.
  • An engaging, people-first work environment offering work/life balance, employee resource groups, and social events to promote interaction and camaraderie.

  • The targeted base pay range for this role is: $96,600 to $151,800 with this range reflecting differences in candidate knowledge, skills and experience.

At FICO, you can develop your career with a leading organization in one of the fastest-growing fields in technology today – Big Data analytics. You’ll play a part in our commitment to help businesses use data to improve every choice they make, using advances in artificial intelligence, machine learning, optimization, and much more.

description:

Job Summary

The Senior Director of Fund Management is a senior leadership role responsible for the oversight and integration of gift processing, donor record management, fund management, and donor due diligence within Advancement Resources. Ensures the integrity, compliance, and strategic alignment of advancement operations to support institutional fundraising goals.

The Senior Director leads multiple functional teams and establishes policies, procedures, and controls to ensure adherence to IRS regulations, CASE standards, donor intent, and university policies. Oversees donor due diligence and gift acceptance practices, assessing reputational, financial, and legal risk associated with philanthropic contributions. The Senior Director partners closely with Advancement leadership, Finance, Legal, and Technology teams to ensure compliant, efficient, and scalable operations across the advancement enterprise.

  • Exceptional analytical, organizational, and problem-solving skills

Leadership & Oversight of Gift Administration, Records & Fund Management

Provide strategic oversight of gift processing, donor record management, and fund administration. Ensure accurate fund setup and management in alignment with donor intent and institutional policies. Allocate resources and set priorities across teams to support efficient and compliant operations.

Donor Due Diligence & Gift Acceptance Oversight

Lead donor due diligence and gift acceptance processes to assess reputational, financial, and legal risk. Establish protocols for evaluating complex or high-risk gifts and partner with leadership, Legal, and Prospect Development on decision-making.

Data Integrity & Donor Record Management

Financial Integration, Reporting & Audit Readiness

title: Security Officer (Internal Candidate)
description:
Location: Yulee,Florida,United States

Job Title: Security Officer
Department: Security
Reports To: Head of Security
FLSA Status: Non-exempt
Effective Date: September 2025
White Oak conserves and sustains some of the earth's rarest wild animals through innovative training, research, education, and conservation breeding programs that contribute to the survival of wildlife in nature. The conservation programs span 600 acres along the St. Mary’s River in northeast Florida, surrounded by 22,000 acres of mixed forest and wetlands that make up the beautiful White Oak property. Founded in 1982, White Oak leads professional efforts to improve veterinary care, develop holistic animal management techniques, and better understand the biology of critically endangered species by providing excellent care and managing conservation programs for over 30 species of imperiled wildlife in large, naturalistic habitats.
White Oak Mission:
Saving endangered wildlife and habitats through sustainable populations, expanding education initiatives, and responsible land stewardship.
Job Summary:
The Security Officer is responsible for the safety and security of White Oak’s guests, staff, collection, and property.
Essential Duties:
o Performs regular safety checks on AEDs and fire extinguishers, ensuring all equipment meets operational standards and compliance requirements.
o Controls access into White Oak property by ensuring that all persons are authorized to enter.
o Monitors and accompanies external personnel, including contractors, vendors, and visitors while on-site to prevent unauthorized access and ensure adherence to facility guidelines.
o Retrieves and delivers incoming and outgoing mail and packages across designated areas in a timely and secure manner. Ensures company mail is secured daily, and any perishable items are delivered promptly.
o Enforces all company policies and procedures and reports all violations to immediate supervisor.
o Maintains awareness of daily activities on property including special projects, meetings, Wildlife activities, construction activities, special deliveries, events and Support Services dept work.
o Utilizes the White Oak calendar and other updates through email and any other forms of communications to track guest arrival/departure information.
o Makes prompt notifications to White Oak personnel when visitors, vendors and contractors arrive.
o Follows VIP/owner operating procedures and carries out responsibilities accordingly.
o Escorts vehicles throughout the property when necessary or requested to ensure road safety and arrival to desired destinations.
o Accounts for property keys at the beginning and conclusion of each shift.
o Documents accurate and detailed information via computer on department documents and logs, including employee entry/exit, security department radio logs, and visitor logs.
o Maintains knowledge of property geography in order to provide accurate directions, respond to incidents, provide escorts and carry out emergency response procedures.
o Maintains cleanliness standards in security buildings and vehicles.
o Works when property is closed for emergencies or circumstances when it is not possible to conduct business (example, severe storm damage), as required.
o Assists in conducting emergency drills.
o Conducts safety inspections at the direction of the Head of Security and/or Safety/Medical Lead Officer.
o Assists in inspecting medical and fire safety equipment and systems at the direction of the Head of Security and/or Safety/Medical Lead Officer.
o Provides quick and appropriate communications (dispatching) by radio and phone during emergency situations and coordinate necessary solutions. This may include contacting external emergency entities such as law enforcement, EMS and Fire/Rescue services.
o Attends required internal training courses as directed.
o Provides transportation of guests to/from the airport or throughout White Oak property. Performs security patrols throughout the property; makes security checks of lodges and other facilities and provides status/action reports.
o Investigates unusual activities and incidents and creates formal reports as necessary.
o Monitors alarm, camera and gate access systems.
o Informs outside emergency agencies of any unusual or suspicious situations on property.
o Generates written reports regarding security-related incidents involving guests, employees and/or the facility.
o Maintains communications with the rover and monitors the base station radio, while on gate duty.
o Provides access control, monitors alarm systems, and provide coordination for emergency response/casualty control.
o Monitors CCTV of back gate and operates gate remotely, as required.
o Monitors email, guest relations calendar, arrival/departure schedules, and utilizes internet to maintain updated information, as needed.
o Inspects jump bags to ensure equipment has batteries and is in working order.
o Monitors weather and traffic conditions and communicates severe warnings to all personnel.
o Ensures safe and engaging experience for White Oak guests.
o Performs other duties that are not specifically identified above, but are required to provide a safe, clean, healthy, and enjoyable environment for guests.
The above cited duties and responsibilities describe the general nature and level of work performed by people assigned to the job. They are not intended to be an exhaustive list of all the duties and responsibilities that an incumbent may be expected or asked to perform.
Education and Work Experience Requirements:
• High School diploma or equivalent required.
• Minimum of one year of security, law enforcement, or military experience.
• Minimum of one year of hospitality or customer/guest service experience.
• Report writing experience.
• Current First Responder and/or CPR & AED Certifications.
Knowledge/Skills/Abilities:
• Proficient computer software skills, including Microsoft Office.
• Ability to multi-task in a fast-paced environment.
• Excellent hospitality skills, including guest and employee relations.
• Must be dependable, trustworthy, reliable, and have a good moral character.
• Ability to communicate effectively and follow directions, both written and verbal.
• Must always remain alert while on duty.
• Capable of making sound judgments.
• Ability to remain calm in an emergency/crisis and carry out needed procedures.
• Ability to maintain control over your own emotions.
• Confident in own abilities to perform the duties required.
• Guest service orientation and drive.
• Highly responsible with a professional presentation.
• Strong attention to detail.
• Reliable means of communication for emergencies (cellphone).
• Capable of logical reasoning.
Physical Requirements, Hazards, and Special Working Conditions:
• Must be 21 years of age or older.
• Must be able to work nights, weekends, and holidays.
• Must be able to lift up to 50 pounds regularly.
• Must have valid Florida or Georgia driver’s license.
• Shifts are twelve hours in length.

We are proud to be an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to gender, race, color, age, national origin, religion, disability, marital status, sexual orientation, gender identity/expression, citizenship, pregnancy or maternity, veteran status, or any other status protected by applicable national, federal, state, or local law.

title: Assistant Director, Teaching and Learning
description:
Department

UCP Teaching & Learning


About the Department

Innovative, career-driven learning experiences define University of Chicago Professional. In our commitment to spread the University's knowledge as broadly as possible, we offer impactful and flexible programs and courses that introduce individual and corporate audiences to up-to-the-minute research, the latest standards in their field, a new professional network, and the University of Chicago's rich intellectual community. Our instructors, seasoned professionals all, deliver unparalleled expertise drawn from years of industry experience. We give our students the tools to succeed in our fast-moving, interconnected world and achieve a competitive edge at any stage of their careers.


Job Summary

We are seeking an Assistant Director of Teaching and Learning to join our Program Strategy and Innovation team. Responsibilities will include overseeing course production and delivery operations on the learning management system (LMS), Canvas; executing new programs; and customizing existing ones for different formats. This role will also involve collaborating with learning designers, instructors, and partners to design engaging in-person and hybrid courses guided by adult learning principles.

Reporting to the Director of Teaching and Learning, the Assistant Director will ensure that learning content is accurately configured, tracked, and continuously improved on Canvas. They will also work closely with partners to ensure that the LMS runs smoothly and provides a seamless user experience from course access to completion. This position requires a passion for learning design for professional, adult audiences. The ideal candidate will be able to think creatively about course delivery across a variety of modalities, audiences, and formats, and bring an energetic, solution-focused mindset to the team.

Responsibilities

  • Designs and develops engaging online, hybrid, and in-person learning experiences grounded in adult learning theory, instructional design best practices, and accessibility standards.
  • Partners with faculty, instructors, and subject matter experts to design innovative learning activities, assessments, and instructional materials that support defined learning outcomes for online, hybrid, and in-person learning experiences.
  • Consults with instructors and program teams to implement course revisions and continuous improvements based on learner feedback and program goals.
  • Designs, administers, and analyzes course evaluations and learner surveys to assess learner satisfaction and provides recommendations that enhance course design, delivery, and learner outcomes.
  • Ensures course materials meet accessibility standards, such as WCAG, institutional guidelines, and quality assurance expectations.
  • Coordinates the planning, publishing, maintenance, and lifecycle of certificate programs and courses in Canvas and resolve delivery issues prior to course releases.
  • Conducts quality assurance (QA) reviews in Canvas to ensure course content is accurate, functional, accessible, and aligned with established quality standards.
  • Develops, documents, and maintains standards, policies, procedures, templates, and quality control checklists that support consistent, high-quality course delivery.
  • Identifies opportunities to streamline workflows, improve production processes, and increase operational efficiency across course development and delivery.
  • Collaborates with cross-functional teams to align LMS functionality with evolving instructional, operational, and learner experience needs.
  • Evaluates new Canvas features, integrations, and educational technologies, recommending enhancements that improve instructional quality, learner engagement, and operational effectiveness.
  • Maintains accurate documentation and tracking systems to support course production, revisions, and ongoing program maintenance.
  • Monitors and analyzes trends, identifies opportunities, and explores innovative approaches to teaching and learning problems. Works with other units across campus to aggregate services in an academic context.
  • Identifies existing content and converts it into an e-learning environment, then creates user support materials.
  • Performs other related work as needed.

The Commercial Services Specialist II (Inside Administrator) provides administrative and operational support for commercial consignment accounts, auction sales processes, and internal departments. This position serves as a key liaison between commercial clients, dealership personnel, auction operations, and corporate partners to ensure accurate and timely processing of vehicle inventory, documentation, account maintenance, and customer service activities.

The role requires strong organizational skills, attention to detail, problem-solving abilities, and the capability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced auction environment.

Essential Duties and Responsibilities

Customer and Account Management

  • Serve as a primary point of contact for assigned commercial accounts.

  • Build and maintain strong relationships with clients, dealers, lenders, and internal departments.

  • Respond to customer inquiries regarding vehicle status, sale results, title processing, and account activities.

  • Provide exceptional customer service through phone, email, and in-person interactions.

Administrative Operations

  • Process vehicle run lists, account updates, sale preparation documents, and post-sale reports.

  • Maintain accurate customer records and account information in auction management systems.

  • Review and verify vehicle information for accuracy and completeness.

  • Assist with scheduling, vehicle assignments, and inventory management activities.

Sale Support

  • Coordinate pre-sale and post-sale activities for commercial consignors.

  • Prepare auction sale packages, reports, and account summaries.

  • Monitor vehicle movement through the auction process and resolve discrepancies.

  • Ensure vehicles are properly represented and marketed according to client requirements.

Documentation and Compliance

  • Verify ownership documents, titles, and required paperwork.

  • Ensure compliance with company policies, state regulations, and client-specific requirements.

  • Maintain confidential customer and vehicle information.

  • Support audit activities and documentation reviews as needed.

Reporting and Analysis

  • Generate and distribute operational reports to clients and management.

  • Track account performance metrics and key service indicators.

  • Identify process improvement opportunities and recommend solutions.

  • Assist leadership with data analysis and account performance reviews.

Cross-Functional Collaboration

  • Work closely with Operations, Title, Arbitration, Transportation, and Sales departments.

  • Coordinate issue resolution to ensure timely customer satisfaction.

  • Support special projects and initiatives that improve operational efficiency.

  • OR the right candidate could also have a different combination, such as any level degree/certification beyond a HS diploma/GED in a related discipline.

  • OR 5 years’ experience in a related field

  • Previous experience in automotive, auction, fleet management, logistics, or related administrative roles.

  • Strong organizational skills with the ability to manage multiple priorities.

  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills.

  • Proficiency in Microsoft Office Suite (Excel, Outlook, Word).

  • Ability to work under pressure in a fast-paced auction environment.

  • High level of accuracy and attention to detail.

​Preferred

  • Experience with auction management software (e.g.,AS400, ASI, Auction Edge, AutoIMS, DRIVIN, etc.).

  • Knowledge of title processing and vehicle remarketing operations.

  • Prior experience supporting commercial accounts or B2B clients.

Key Competencies

  • Customer Focus

  • Accountability

  • Communication

  • Attention to Detail

  • Teamwork

  • Problem Solving

  • Adaptability

A successful Commercial Services Specialist II:

  • Maintains high levels of customer satisfaction.

  • Consistently meets documentation and reporting deadlines.

  • Reduces processing errors and account discrepancies.

  • Demonstrates strong partnership with commercial clients and internal stakeholders.

  • Supports efficient auction operations and revenue growth through excellent administrative execution.

However, we are a drug-free workplace, so the possession, use or being under the influence of drugs illegal under federal or state law during work hours, on company property and/or in company vehicles is prohibited.

Employees are eligible to receive a minimum of sixteen hours of paid time off every month and seven paid holidays throughout the calendar year. Employees are also eligible for additional paid time off in the form of bereavement leave, time off to vote, jury duty leave, volunteer time off, military leave, and parental leave.

Through groundbreaking technology and a commitment to stellar experiences for drivers and dealers alike, Cox Automotive employees are transforming the way the world buys, owns, sells – or simply uses – cars. Cox Automotive employees get to work on iconic consumer brands like Autotrader and Kelley Blue Book and industry-leading dealer-facing companies like vAuto and Manheim, all while enjoying the people-centered atmosphere that is central to our life at Cox. title: VP - Head of Financial Institutions and Issuer Client Servicing
description:
Calling all innovators - find your future at Fiserv.

We're Fiserv, a global leader in Fintech and payments, and we move money and information in a way that moves the world. We connect financial institutions, corporations, merchants and consumers to one another millions of times a day - quickly, reliably, and securely. Any time you swipe your credit card, pay through a mobile app, or withdraw money from the bank, we're involved. If you want to make an impact on a global scale, come make a difference at Fiserv.

Job Title

VP - Head of Financial Institutions and Issuer Client Servicing

About your role:

As the Vice President, Client Technical Support, you will lead a globally distributed client technical support organization across North America and APAC providing strategic support and partner-facing service functions for our Financial Solutions business. You will work across clients, internal partners, and enterprise stakeholders to strengthen global service delivery, optimize partner relationships, and improve operational performance by aligning regional execution, service standards, and operating rhythms to deliver consistent client outcomes. This role is critical to advancing tailored consulting and support capabilities while fostering innovation and continuous improvement across the organization.

What you'll do:

  • Lead 24x7x365 production support operations for multiple lines of business, ensuring timely incident response, service continuity, operational quality, and measurable performance outcomes.
  • Design and execute a transformation of the service delivery model to an artificial intelligence (AI)-first operating approach, improving issue prevention, intelligent routing, resolution speed, associate productivity, and service economics.
  • Build and scale a segment-based servicing model that aligns support motions, service levels, and coverage strategies to client complexity, revenue profile, product adoption, and business needs.
  • Lead across multiple geographies, building organizational alignment and decision-making discipline that support high-performance global operations.
  • Partner with Product, Product Development, and Enterprise Technology Group leaders to define and deliver technology-first support capabilities, including self-service, automation, predictive insights, and digital workflows that improve client experience and operational margin.
  • Lead segmentation and service model redesign efforts that improve alignment between client needs and support delivery, enabling differentiated service experiences while optimizing capacity, productivity, and margin performance.
  • Define global governance, performance measures, and adoption plans for new support capabilities, ensuring transformation initiatives deliver measurable improvements in service quality, client satisfaction, and operating leverage.
  • Influence senior leaders across the global peer group to align on common service strategies, governance models, and platform investments that improve consistency, efficiency, and long-term support performance.
  • Advocate for focused investment in common global capabilities that strengthen scalability, reduce fragmentation, and improve service delivery across regions and lines of business.
  • Lead the Partner Optimization and Support teams, providing tailored consulting services and support to clients and internal partners.
  • Drive excellence in the professional services group dedicated to optimizing partner relationships.
  • Establish and manage performance benchmarks, service metrics, governance routines, and documented processes that improve accountability, repeatability, automation, and customer satisfaction.
  • Oversee budget, revenue, expense, and cost management activities for the support organization while identifying opportunities to improve efficiency and reduce total cost of support.
  • Lead, coach, and develop a team of directors and senior leaders across multiple locations and time zones, building succession plans and a culture focused on execution, collaboration, and continuous improvement.
  • Responsibilities listed are not intended to be all-inclusive and may be modified as necessary.

Experience you'll need to have:

  • 12+ years of experience in client support, partner support, professional services, service delivery, or operations within payments, fintech, financial services, or enterprise technology environments.
  • 10+ years of experience managing and developing teams, including senior leaders, with responsibility for coaching, organizational design, succession planning, and performance management across multiple teams or locations.
  • 10+ years of experience building and managing internal partner relationships, including delivering consulting or support services that improve operational performance and client satisfaction.
  • Proven experience driving or operational delivery model transformation, including defining strategy, establishing outcome-based KPIs, developing investment business cases, and executing change with broad adoption across teams.
  • Proven experience in technology-driven product development and management that enhances operational processes and support functions for client technology organizations.
  • Experience establishing measurable service benchmarks, governance processes, escalation frameworks, and operational controls using data to drive decisions and continuous improvement.
  • Experience managing budgets, expense models, resource planning, and organizational performance in a complex enterprise environment.
  • Bachelor's degree or higher in business, information technology, engineering, or a related field, or equivalent combination of education, related experience and/or military experience.

Experience that would be great to have:

  • Experience leading partner optimization, professional services, or consulting organizations in a financial technology environment.
  • Familiarity with support models that serve both external clients and internal business partners.
  • Experience driving service innovation, process automation, or operational transformation initiatives.

How you'll work:

  • This role is on-site Monday through Friday. Fiserv considers in-person collaboration to be an essential part of this role as in-person office experiences help you with your overall onboarding experience and leads to stronger productivity.
  • This role requires use of a computer and audio equipment.

  • 2-5 years of experience in media, branding or advertising analytics

  • Experience successfully implementing and validating platform integrations across AdTech and data systems
  • Experience tagging and tracking frameworks supporting campaign execution and measurement in an accurate and reliable fashion
  • Experience documenting integration specifications, data flows, and system configurations
  • Experience generating QA validation outputs ensuring data accuracy and system performance

At RTX, the world's largest aerospace and defense company, 185,000 great minds are united by purpose and inspired to make a difference solving the world’s most complex problems. Raytheon brings the strength of more than 100 years of experience and renowned engineering expertise to meet the needs of today’s mission and stay ahead of tomorrow’s threat. We deliver solutions that help our nation and allies defend freedoms and deter aggression, creating a safer, more secure world. Join us and help shape the future of aerospace and defense.

The Effectors PG&C Center is currently hiring for a Systems Engineer II - Guidance, Navigation, and Control Engineer position in Tucson, AZ to support execution of the portfolio of current and upcoming missile programs. As a Systems Engineer II - Guidance, Navigation, and Control Engineer, you will play a critical role in helping with the evaluation, design, implementation, and integration of embedded software algorithms. You will collaborate with a team of engineers in an integrated product team that will be responsible for tactical embedded software, firmware, and integrated flight software 6 Degrees-of-Freedom simulations to achieve overall system performance requirements. This position is an onsite role located in Tucson, AZ.

What You Will Do

  • Development, integration, and testing of embedded tactical missile flight code
  • Definition and execution of system level performance studies and analyses to inform the development and integration of new capabilities, refinement of existing capability, or to address obsolescence
  • Work within an agile framework to lead development of backlogs, plans, and metrics
  • Provide experience and guidance to help the program train new engineers and execute efficiently and effectively
  • Support missile performance analysis including model development, system optimization, and Monte Carlo assessments with expected system disturbances.

Qualifications You Must Have

  • Typically requires a Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Science, Physics, Mathematics, or a related STEM degree and a minimum of 2 years prior relevant experience
  • GNC, Signal Processing, and/or Modeling / Simulation experience
  • Engineering experience in system applications to include at least one of the following:
    • Digital and/or modern control systems
    • Dynamics
    • Kalman filter design
    • Monte Carlo analysis
    • Development and/or simulation of physical systems
    • Signal processing
    • Verification and validation
    • System-level performance assessments
    • GPS/INS navigation systems, sensors, and algorithms
    • Assured Positioning, Navigation, and Timing (APNT) systems, sensors, and algorithms for navigation in GPS-degraded environments
  • Experience with MATLAB, Python, C, C++, and/or Object-Oriented design
  • Experience with GNC and/or Signal Processing algorithms within a simulation or physical environment
  • Ability to obtain an Interim Secret U.S. government issued Security Clearance is required prior to start date with the ability to obtain special program access after start. U.S. citizenship is required, as only U.S. citizens are eligible for a security clearance.

Qualifications We Prefer

  • Active and current Secret or above level Security Clearance
  • Advanced Degree in Engineering, Science, Physics, Mathematics, or a related STEM degree with or more years of GNC, Signal Processing, and/or Modeling / Simulation experience
  • Ability to communicate effectively with internal leadership regarding matters of importance
  • Ability to balance multiple concurrent priorities with overlapping deadline in an Agile environment
  • Experience with and demonstrable achievement in systems engineering principals with regards to product development

What We Offer

  • Our values drive our actions, behaviors, and performance with a vision for a safer, more connected world. At RTX we value: Safety, Trust, Respect, Accountability, Collaboration, and Innovation.

title: Senior Chemist
description:
At doTERRA we encourage all employees to seek out opportunities that will expand their skill set. We strive to help achieve personal career goals by providing opportunities of growth and movement throughout the company.

DESCRIPTION: Responsible for maintaining quality control processes, supporting compliance with GMPs and testing best practices, ensuring the identity, purity, strength, potency, and composition of doTERRA products through testing, recording, and analyzing results. Serves as a technical resource within the quality control chemistry laboratory. Performs routine and complex laboratory testing while providing technical leadership, coordinating daily laboratory activities, mentoring team members, and supporting continuous improvement initiatives. Partners closely with the Chemistry Lab Supervisor to promote efficient laboratory operations, maintain compliance, and ensure high-quality test results. This position does not have direct supervisory responsibility.

REPORTS TO: Chemistry Lab Supervisor

JOB RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Perform analyses on finished products, raw materials, and components using entry, review, and/or approval of data in lab notebooks and a computerized database (LIMS).
  • Follow standardized test methods, procedures, and work instructions, document test results, and communicate status of test results. Collaborate with peers and cross-departmentally.
  • Prepare reagents, solutions, and other materials needed for testing. Monitor chemical and reference standard inventory supply.
  • Ensure all documentation and quality records are conducted in accordance with Good Manufacturing Practices (GMP), Good Documentation Practices (GDP), and Good Laboratory Practices (GLP) requirements.
  • Demonstrate and develop experience on a variety of instrumentation and equipment including GC-FID, GCMS, HPLC, LCMS, ICPMS, polarimeter, densitometer, refractometer, viscometer, FTIR, UV-Vis, titrations, organoleptic evaluations, and other analytical techniques, including troubleshooting, maintenance, calibrations, and minor repairs. Communicate with vendors and contractors to troubleshoot instrument issues and/or schedule repairs. Coordinate instrument calibration and preventative maintenance schedules.
  • Serve as a technical resource for chemists, analysts, and laboratory technicians.
  • Author and review test procedures, Standard Operating procedures (SOPs), and protocols as assigned.
  • Assist in the execution of method transfers under the guidance of a Method Developer or Chemist.
  • Communicate frequently with team members and management about sample and instrument status, out of specification results, and other work-related topics. Monitor laboratory workflow and communicate emerging issues.
  • Train new employees on laboratory tasks and mentor junior members of the team.
  • Perform lab cleaning and maintain an organized work environment.
  • Support all continuous improvement activities, including suggesting methods for increasing efficiency of chemistry lab operations.
  • Perform all job duties with minimal oversight from the Chemistry Lab Supervisor. Assist Chemistry Lab Supervisor with delegation of tasks when appropriate.
  • Coordinate daily workload assignments in collaboration with the Chemistry Lab Supervisor.
  • Must be available for ad hoc meetings, calls, or questions during business hours.
  • While the company does strive to maintain a safe workplace, this position requires that employees in this role contribute to a safe work environment by following all safety related procedures and detecting and reporting potential hazards.
  • May be asked to perform non-routine work on occasion to assist the department.
  • Other related duties as assigned.

JOB QUALIFICATIONS

Education and Experience:

Either:

  • Bachelor’s degree in chemistry or related field and 5+ years of progressively responsible technical work experience in a chemistry related field.
  • Master’s degree in chemistry or related field and 2+ years of progressively responsible technical work experience in a chemistry related field.

Required Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities:

  • Ability to work on projects or matters or moderate complexity independently.
  • Knowledge of cGxP and FDA, NSF, ISO, TGA, etc. regulations.
  • Must be able to work in close proximity to products with strong aromas.
  • Advanced mathematical skills, deductive reasoning skills, and organizational skills.
  • Proficiency in Microsoft office, basic computer programs, and laboratory software.
  • Ability to communicate in a timely manner by reading, writing, and speaking in English, including in person real-time communication.
  • Ability to work under pressure and prioritize and plan tasks to achieve daily workload.
  • Willingness and ability to teach, train, and mentor junior team members. Able to provide constructive feedback in a respectful manner.
  • Advanced knowledge of chemical and solution handling.
  • Advanced knowledge of laboratory techniques and practices.
  • Ability to traverse varying distances and travel between different floors of the building. Traveling between buildings (outside) may be required occasionally.
  • Must be able to elevate and/or move up to 40 pounds, with assistance.
  • Must be able to stand for extended periods of time.
  • Must be able to wear required personal protective equipment for extended periods of time, including but not limited to closed-toed shoes, lab coats, safety glasses/goggles, nitrile/latex gloves, and face shields.
  • Ability to manipulate small objects such as bottle lids, small hand tools, etc.
  • Must maintain positive relationships in the workplace by treating others with respect, dignity, and integrity.
  • Must work well in a team environment.

We are Newark, an Avnet Company, part of Farnell Global, the fast and reliable distributor of products and technology for electronic and industrial system design, maintenance, and repair.
