title: Creative Technologist
description:
Who We Are

At Kyndryl, we design, build, manage and modernize the mission-critical technology systems that the world depends on every day. So why work at Kyndryl? We are always moving forward – always pushing ourselves to go further in our efforts to build a more equitable, inclusive world for our employees, our customers and our communities.

The Role

Job Description

Who We Are
At Kyndryl, we design, build, manage and modernize the mission-critical technology systems that the world depends on every day. So why work at Kyndryl? We are always moving forward always pushing ourselves to go further in our efforts to build a more equitable, inclusive world for our employees, our customers and our communities.

Are you a creative technologist who wants to bridge the gap between design vision and engineering execution, using experimentation to solve problems in new and novel ways? Then you’ll love working at Kyndryl Vital.

At Kyndryl Vital, we are looking for creative, curious, empathic systems thinkers who want to tackle wicked problems with some of the best technical colleagues in the world. Kyndryl Vital is a global network of designers, engineers, writers, researchers, and strategists. We are bound together by a desire to help our customers make sense of complexity and co-create intelligent and adaptive experience ecosystems that resonate with their users and transform their businesses. We believe the next evolution of experience will emerge from the artful blending of behavioral insight and business intelligence into elegantly simple, deeply human moments. We are fortunate to work with the world’s best IT experts to ensure that we can not only imagine a great experience, but that we can build it, deliver it, optimize it, and sustain it.

The Role

A Creative Technologist is a cross-disciplinary person that bridge between a design vision and engineering execution, using experimentation to solve problems in new and novel ways. They Combines technical expertise with human-centered design to prototype and implement innovative solutions. Creative technologists blend expertise in code, hardware, and emerging technologies to bring ideas to life.

As a Creative Technologist at Kyndryl Vital, you will:

  • Collaborate with designers, engineers, and stakeholders to shape technical concepts aligned to human-centered design.

  • Rapidly prototype interactive, testable experiences to drive alignment, learning, and value, including agentic AI-driven interactions.

  • Apply emerging technologies to business challenges, including AI/ML/GenAI (including agentic AI), IoT, and immersive interfaces.

  • Lead feasibility analysis and ethical review of technology choices, including agentic AI safety and governance considerations.

Your Future at Kyndryl
Every position at Kyndryl offers a way forward to grow your career. We have opportunities that you won’t find anywhere else, including hands-on experience, learning opportunities, and the chance to certify in all four major platforms. Whether you want to broaden your knowledge base or narrow your scope and specialize in a specific sector, you can find your opportunity here.

Kyndryl currently does not require employees to be fully vaccinated against COVID-19, however, if you are hired to work at a client, customer, or partner location, you may be required to show proof of vaccination to align with their respective COVID-19 vaccination policies. Those who believe they are eligible may apply for a medical or religious accommodation prior to the start of employment.

Who You Are

Who You Are

You’re good at what you do and possess the required experience to prove it. However, equally as important, you have a growth mindset; keen to drive your own personal and professional development. You are customer-focused, someone who prioritizes customer success in their work. And finally, you’re open and borderless, naturally inclusive in how you work with others.

Required Technical and Professional Expertise

  • Human-Centered Design: You have a deep understanding of human-centered design methods and mindset

  • Cross-disciplinary Collaboration: You excel at uniting design and engineering

  • Innovation: You can apply new applications for emerging tech

  • Rapid Prototyping: You can create context-appropriate, low- to high-fidelity digital and physical prototypes.

  • Human-in-the-Loop Patterns: You can design interaction patterns for approvals, escalation, rollbacks, and exception handling so agents act safely and users stay in control.

  • Feasibility Analysis: You can assess design’s technical feasibility, system integration, and implementation pathways

  • Storytelling: You can translate prototypes and technical insights into compelling narratives

  • AI and Data Ethics: You leverage AI tools and data strategies with awareness of equity, bias, and transparency. This includes responsible agentic AI patterns (tool permissioning, human-in-the-loop controls, auditability).

  • Tool Building for APIs (Agent Tools): You can define and prototype lightweight “agent tools” that expose capabilities via APIs (REST/GraphQL), including clear input/output schemas, error handling, and versioning so AI engineers can reliably wire tools into agent runtimes.

  • Front-End Engineering for Agentic Experiences: You can build modern web interfaces (e.g., React/TypeScript) that integrate with agentic systems—supporting streaming responses, conversation + workflow state, and human-in-the-loop actions (approve/deny/escalate) with traceable outcomes.

  • Agent Evaluation & Quality: You can define basic evaluation criteria for agent behavior (accuracy, reliability, safety, latency, and user trust), and iterate using test prompts, structured cases, and lightweight metrics.

Preferred Professional and Technical Expertise

  • 1-3+ years of relevant experience (dependent on level)

  • Vertical domain experience (e.g., finance, retail, healthcare, industrial)

  • Experience in both enterprise and agency worlds

  • Knowledge and experience in IT infrastructure, architecture, and platform capabilities

  • Background in behavioral science, change management, or design research

  • Applied or academic experience with data science, AI/ML, or HCI

  • You can partner with AI engineers working in open-source agent runtimes and translate experience requirements into tool contracts, UI behaviors, and evaluation criteria without blocking engineering velocity.

You may specialize more deeply in:

  • AI/ML/GenAI

  • Phygital / Immersive Design

  • IoT / Connected Product Design

  • Mobile and Web Front-End Engineering

Required Education

  • Bachelor’s Degree in a relevant field (or equivalent demonstrable portfolio of work).

Preferred Education

  • Advanced degree or certification in design, HCI, computer science, or related (e.g., MDM, MDes, MFA, d.MBA or equivalent) is a plus.

title: Relief Technician
description:
OVERVIEW OF THE COMPANY

Fox TV Stations

FOX Television Stations (FTS) owns and operates 29 full power broadcast television stations, including stations in 14 of the top 15 markets and duopolies in 11. Eighteen are FOX Network affiliates, and together the stations produce approximately 1,300 hours of local news every week. FOX LOCAL, the company's free ad-supported digital and streaming product, extends that news, weather and local content across connected TV & mobile devices. LiveNOW from FOX expands the FTS portfolio even further as the only national streaming services to be truly live 24/7, covering breaking news and events as they happen.

JOB DESCRIPTION

Position Summary

We are seeking an experienced Relief Technician to join our team on a temporary, per diem basis to provide flexible operational assistance and shift coverage for live control room and master control operations. In this role, you will operate production automation systems and control room equipment to deliver error-free live newscasts, sports events, local productions, and daily on-air commercial transmission. The ideal candidate thrives in a fast-paced environment and excels at executing rapid, real-time direction from news, sports, and traffic teams.

Key Responsibilities

  • Production Automation: Demonstrate high proficiency in operating Sony ELC production automation systems and Evertz Mediator (or comparable master control playout platforms).
  • Live Newscast Execution: Operate production equipment for daily live newscasts, maintaining close collaboration with News Directors and Producers to carry out fast-paced directional changes.
  • Sports & Local Programming: Execute live and taped local sports and public affairs productions under the direction of local production teams.
  • On-Air Playout & Traffic Integration: Manage automated transmission operations to integrate commercial content with live programming, coordinating with Sales, Traffic, and centralized Hub personnel.
  • Technical Quality Control: Monitor on-air signals and equipment status to ensure consistent, high-quality broadcast execution.
  • General Operations: Perform additional operational duties as assigned by leadership.

Qualifications & Requirements

  • Experience: 3–4 years of operational experience in a medium to major market broadcast environment.
  • Education: Associate degree or equivalent hands-on broadcast experience required; Bachelor’s degree in Communications, Telecommunications, or a related field preferred.
  • Schedule & Availability: Available to work on a temporary, per diem basis to assist with short-term coverage, planned leave, breaking news, weekends, or holidays as needed.
  • Technical Skills: Proven proficiency with Sony ELC, Evertz Mediator (or equivalent automation/playout systems), and standard live control room hardware.
  • Adaptability: Exceptional ability to maintain composure and perform reliably under high-stress, live-air conditions.
  • Physical & License Requirements: Must hold a valid driver's license and be able to safely lift up to 50 lbs.

We are an equal opportunity employer and all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, gender identity, disability, protected veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law. We will consider for employment qualified applicants with criminal histories consistent with applicable law.

The Effectors PG&C Center is currently hiring for a Principal Systems Engineer - Missile Guidance, Navigation, and Control Engineer position in Tucson, AZ to support execution of the portfolio of current and upcoming missile programs. As a Principal Systems Engineer - Missile Guidance, Navigation, and Control Engineer, you will play a critical role in helping with the evaluation, design, implementation, and integration of embedded software algorithms. You will collaborate with a team of engineers in an integrated product team that will be responsible for tactical embedded software, firmware, and integrated flight software 6 Degrees-of-Freedom simulations to achieve overall system performance requirements. This position is an onsite role located in Tucson, AZ.

What You Will Do

  • Development, integration, and testing of embedded tactical missile flight code
  • Definition and execution of system level performance studies and analyses to inform the development and integration of new capabilities, refinement of existing capability, or to address obsolescence
  • Work within an agile framework to lead development of backlogs, plans, and metrics
  • Provide experience and guidance to help the program train new engineers and execute efficiently and effectively
  • Support missile performance analysis including model development, system optimization, and Monte Carlo assessments with expected system disturbances.

Qualifications You Must Have

  • Typically requires a Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Science, Physics, Mathematics, or a related STEM degree and a minimum of 8 years prior relevant experience
  • GNC, Signal Processing, and/or Modeling / Simulation experience
  • Engineering experience in missile system applications to include at least two of the following:
    • Digital and/or modern control systems
    • Dynamics
    • Kalman filter design
    • Monte Carlo analysis
    • Development and/or simulation of physical systems
    • Signal processing
    • Verification and validation
    • System-level performance assessments
    • GPS/INS navigation systems, sensors, and algorithms
    • Assured Positioning, Navigation, and Timing (APNT) systems, sensors, and algorithms for navigation in GPS-degraded environments
  • Experience with MATLAB, Python, C, C++, and/or Object-Oriented design
  • Experience with GNC and/or Signal Processing algorithms within a simulation or physical environment
  • Experience managing or leading others in a technical and/or functional capacity within an engineering environment
  • Ability to obtain an Interim Secret U.S. government issued Security Clearance is required prior to start date with the ability to obtain special program access after start. U.S. citizenship is required, as only U.S. citizens are eligible for a security clearance.

  • 8 or more years of GNC, Signal Processing, and/or Modeling / Simulation experience
  • Ability to communicate effectively with executive leadership and customers regarding matters of significant importance
  • Ability to balance multiple concurrent priorities with overlapping deadline in an Agile environment
  • Subject Matter Expert in at least one of the following areas: RF algorithm design, GNC algorithm design, autopilot algorithm design or Software in Simulation
  • Experience with and demonstrable achievement in systems engineering principals with regards to product development

description:
Department

ADV Foundation & Corporate Relations 3


About the Department

The University of Chicago Advancement team cultivates lifelong connections with more than 220,000 alumni, current students, parents, and friends worldwide, building community through intellectual, professional, and other meaningful experiences on campus, around the world and online. Advancement empowers every division, school, department, and institute to thrive, generating support for esteemed faculty, pioneering researchers, visionary practitioners, and ambitious students.

During the Chicago Minds campaign, Advancement seeks to raise over $1 billion annually. This unprecedented philanthropic effort is designed to stretch the boundaries of what is possible, fueling bold discovery and amplifying the University’s global impact.

Our work is rooted in the belief that meaningful connection and lasting experiences inspire ambassadorship and enduring commitment. We champion a culture of innovation and excellence, inviting every member of our community to participate in a future defined by creativity, intellectual rigor, and shared purpose. Through collaborative partnerships, strategic stewardship, and investment in talent, Advancement is reimagining alumni and donor engagement while ensuring UChicago remains a catalyst of impact for generations to come.

The Foundation and Corporate Relations (FCR) team fosters strong relationships between the University and independent philanthropic organizations to secure foundation and corporate funding for faculty research, teaching, and University initiatives. FCR works closely with faculty and staff University-wide on all phases of proposal development and stewardship for grants and gifts from organizations.


Job Summary

This position conducts biographical and financial research on individuals, corporations, and/or foundations to support fundraising. Identifies prospective donors using research and analysis through use of standard procedures. Forecasts and measures the effectiveness of the fiscal year and overall campaign progress, which will help employees in the job acquire higher-level knowledge and skills.

This position is not eligible for employer-sponsored employment authorization.

Responsibilities

  • Coordinates entry and maintenance of organization prospect and contact data and organization records in Phoenix. Reviews and requests updates and corrections to organization giving data in Phoenix. Works closely with multiple teams in Advancement towards these ongoing efforts.

Leverages Phoenix Salesforce reporting, WebI Enterprise Data Hub (EDH) reporting, and additional reporting tools.

title: Associate Advanced, Securities Operations(Dealer Services / Main Office Services (MOS))
description:
Job Posting Description

Are you curious, motivated, and forward-thinking? At FIS, you’ll have the opportunity to work on some of the most challenging and relevant issues in financial services and technology. Our talented people empower us, and we believe in being part of a team that is open, collaborative, entrepreneurial, passionate and above all fun.

About the team

The Transfer Agency (TA) function is a core operational division responsible for end‑to‑end transaction processing, record keeping, and shareholder servicing for mutual fund and investment management clients. The team supports the full lifecycle of investor and distributor activity, ensuring accuracy, timeliness, and regulatory compliance across all transaction and servicing functions.

Within TA, the Dealer Services / Main Office Services (MOS) team acts as a critical interface between fund managers, intermediaries, distributors, platforms, and internal operations teams. The group enables seamless transaction flow, data integrity, and issue resolution across multiple servicing channels.

At FIS, we deliver client and intermediary support through multiple channels including transaction processing, workflow tools, chat, email, and telephonic interactions. Services include but are not limited to - account setup, shareholder and dealer data maintenance, transaction management, reconciliations, reporting, and overall record keeping, while maintaining high service levels and client satisfaction.

What you will be doing:

The Specialist role requires strong business and operational knowledge, with the ability to function as a subject matter expert while independently resolving moderate to complex operational issues. This individual acts as a key support resource to the direct leader in managing day‑to‑day operational functions and is expected to exercise sound judgment, apply acquired knowledge, and take ownership of outcomes. The role demands a high level of accountability, independence, and proactive engagement to ensure service level commitments and business objectives are consistently met.

  • Act as a subject matter expert for the team by independently researching and resolving complex, non‑routine, and escalated operational issues.

  • Serve as a resource to the direct leader by supporting day‑to‑day operational oversight and contributing to the effective execution of operational priorities.

  • Perform work independently with minimal guidance, following defined procedures to complete moderate to complex assignments that may vary in nature.

  • Exercise judgment using acquired skills and business knowledge to assess situations, identify issues, and recommend or execute corrective actions, particularly in unique or non‑standard scenarios.

  • Support daily operational deliverables by allocating work across resources, monitoring shared and individual work baskets, and ensuring all tasks are completed within defined SLAs.

  • Proactively monitor workflows to identify process gaps, issues, processing errors, or potential SLA and data privacy incidents, and escalate concerns to management in a timely manner to enable prompt resolution.

  • Deliver a high standard of service to clients and their clients (back‑office firms / broker‑dealers) through various channels of communication, including email and phone.

  • Address client and internal inquiries and perform account maintenance to ensure accuracy of records related to account owners, back‑office firms, and associated entities.

  • Assist customers by initiating and managing payment investigations, maintenance requests, fulfillment requests, and fee reversals.

  • Collaborate effectively with internal teams and external clients to resolve outstanding issues, comply with customer requests, and respond to inquiries in a timely and professional manner.

  • Follow up as required to ensure prompt resolution of client inquiries and escalated situations.

  • Interface with clients to understand current and future servicing needs, provide status updates, and discuss progress toward resolution.

  • Ensure service expectations are consistently met by establishing rapport with requestors and back‑office firms and setting clear expectations for account‑related and servicing requests.

  • Complete all assigned tasks and transactions accurately and within established timelines, demonstrating strong ownership, attention to detail, and accountability for individual work.

  • Maintain comprehensive knowledge of MOS division services, products, policies, and procedures, and remain current on changes to existing processes.

  • Participate, as required, in business reviews to gain insight into clients’ strategic direction and better understand product and service offerings.

  • Identify opportunities for process improvement by evaluating existing workflows, highlighting gaps or inefficiencies, and recommending practical solutions that enhance operational efficiency, accuracy, and service quality.

  • Perform other related duties as assigned to support operational and business objectives.

What you bring:

  • 5 to 6 years of experience from Mutual Fund / Financial Services background

  • Strong knowledge of Transfer Agency operations is mandatory, with hands-on experience across transaction processing, record keeping and shareholder servicing.

  • Working knowledge of Dealer Services / MOS is an added advantage.

  • Excellent knowledge of Customer Services; Global mindset (Desirable)

  • Ready to work in night shifts (5 days in a week)

  • Ready for rotational shifts

What we offer you:

A career at FIS is more than just a job. It’s the change to shape the future of fintech. At FIS, we offer you:

  • A voice in the future of fintech

  • Always-on learning and development

  • Collaborative work environment

  • Opportunities to give back

  • Competitive salary and benefits

FIS is committed to protecting the privacy and security of all personal information that we process in order to provide services to our clients. For specific information on how FIS protects personal information online, please see the Online Privacy Notice.

Sourcing Model

Recruitment at FIS works primarily on a direct sourcing model; a relatively small portion of our hiring is through recruitment agencies. FIS does not accept resumes from recruitment agencies which are not on the preferred supplier list and is not responsible for any related fees for resumes submitted to job postings, our employees, or any other part of our company.

title: Lead Technical Product Manager
description:
Job Description: The Lead Technical Product Manager at Northwestern Mutual Life Insurance Company in Milwaukee, WI will define project scope, objectives, deliverables, success criteria, schedule, budget, resource needs, and risk mitigation plans. Coordinate and lead cross functional teams (engineering, data, QA, design, finance, operations) through project initiation, development, testing, deployment, and closure. Facilitate risk identification, assessment, mitigation planning, and issue resolution throughout the project lifecycle. Translate business needs into formal artifacts. Author, prioritize, and maintain product and feature backlogs. Collaborate with engineering and QA to decompose large features into sprint sized stories and ensure readiness for development. Lead data discovery and profiling activities to source, validate, and reconcile data from systems. Define data requirements, mapping rules, transformation logic, and validation checks. Coordinate with engineers to implement transformations and QA tests. Create and deliver dashboards, visualizations, and analytic reports to present findings, drive decisions, and measure data quality. Oversee data migration planning and coordination including sample sets, cutover criteria, reconciliation processes and monitor reconciliation and remediation of exceptions. Define, document, and monitor data quality KPIs and SLA adherence; drive corrective action for data anomalies affecting downstream consumers. Define product vision and multi-year roadmap for multiple related products. Facilitate agile ceremonies including daily standups, sprint planning, sprint reviews, retrospectives and coach teams on agile best practices to ensure predictable delivery. Author and validate user stories, acceptance criteria, and test cases. Mentor and guide cross functional team members, provide technical/product guidance, and act as escalation point for complex functional and technical issues. Define and enforce data governance standards including data lineage, ownership, metadata, retention. Coordinate with legal, compliance, and security teams to ensure data handling meets regulatory and internal policy requirements. Telecommuting permitted 2 days per week. Salary $130,800- $196,200 per year.

Minimum Requirements: Bachelor’s degree in Computer Engineering, Electronic Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Industrial Engineering or a related field and 6 years of experience as a product engineer (or related occupation) in the institutional investment or financial services industry. Experience must include 6 years of experience with each of the following: (1) working within agile teams and applying agile delivery methodologies including Scrum and Kanban; (2) data analysis, validation, reconciliation, and reporting with hands-on use of BI tools including Power BI, Tableau, Looker and data management platforms; and (3) translating product requirements into technical requirements.

title: UX Design Associate
description:
Who We Are

At Kyndryl, we run and reimagine the mission-critical technology systems that drive advantage for the world’s leading businesses. We are at the heart of progress; with proven expertise and a continuous flow of AI-powered insight, enabling smarter decisions, faster innovation, and a lasting competitive edge. For our people—Kyndryls—that means doing purposeful work that powers human progress. Join us and experience a flexible, supportive environment where your well-being is prioritized and your potential can thrive.

The Role

Your role
As an AI UX Designer at Kyndryl, you will lead the design activities that connect insight, imagination, and execution for the next era of computing. You aren’t just building interfaces; you are defining the mental models and interaction patterns that allow humans to collaborate seamlessly with autonomous agents.

Join Kyndryl and gain the trust, autonomy and teamwork to help define what comes next for us, our customers and global industries as a whole.

What you will do
Humanize Complex Intelligence
•Architect intentional journeys: You’ll lead user research to uncover pain points in the human-AI relationship, creating journey maps that turn the complexity of multi-step agentic reasoning into clarity for the end user.
•Design for non-deterministic UI: You will move beyond static wireframes to create dynamic interaction patterns that handle AI latency, ambiguity, and error states gracefully, ensuring users always feel in control of the autonomous process.

Choreograph the Collaborative Loop
•Facilitate co-creation: Lead workshops and usability tests to balance desirability with feasibility, working closely with creative technologists and AI engineers to ensure the intelligence of the system matches the intuition of the user.
•Master Human-in-the-Loop (HITL): Design the critical hand-off moments where an agent needs human validation, ensuring that transparency and trust are built into every automated workflow.

Advocate for Inclusive Evolution
•Champion ethical design: Advocate for accessibility and inclusive intelligence, ensuring that our AI experiences are equitable and work for all users across diverse backgrounds.
•Shape the interface era: Maintain a strong perspective on how agentic AI drives human-centered design, using clear storytelling to inspire alignment across the full design lifecycle—from discovery to delivery.

Who You Are

Required skills and experience

•UX / experience design or a related field, with a strong portfolio of enterprise or innovation-studio projects
•Deep understanding of user-centered design, interaction design, and usability testing methods
•Comfortable facilitating co-creation sessions and presenting to clients
•Direct experience with AI, agentic AI/UX and data-driven design is preferred
•A POV on how AI can drive human-centered design and co-creation
•Experience with emerging AI assistants (Figma Make, MiroAI, Adobe Firefly, Lovable, etc)
•Fluent in Figma or Sketch, or similar prototyping tools
•Experience working with developers / product managers to translate research into delivery
•Excellent communication skills in English

title: Principal, Running Footwear Product Developer
description:
WHO YOU’LL WORK WITH

We are looking for a Principal Footwear Developer who will work collaboratively with key functional partners throughout the Product Development process. This includes Footwear Innovation, Footwear Engineering, Footwear Product Testing, Footwear Material Design and Material Development, Product Design, Product Management, Product Merchandising, Sourcing and Operations, Manufacturing and our overseas partners – both within Nike and external to Nike.

You will need to navigate the Nike matrix to ensure that our processes model and match Nike’s Footwear Development standard methodologies for product excellence. You are the key point of contact for our overseas partners and ensure that communication during the product development process is clear and accurate.

WHO WE ARE LOOKING FOR

The Product Brief is the first spark of a product idea sets the Footwear Product Creation team into motion. The team of Footwear Developers, Testers, Engineers and Designers collectively strive for product excellence in every way. They obsess over smallest of details, while collaborating, ideating and refining product construction, performance, fit and style. They use groundbreaking advancements in technology, sustainable design and materials to accelerate innovation. And they work lockstep with Marketing, Design, Materials, Testing, and Manufacturing to produce products that reflect the soul of Nike Footwear, that inspire and ultimately enable our athletes to reach all new levels of performance.

As a member of the Nike Footwear Development team, you will inform, drive and facilitate decisions throughout the product creation process to meet or exceed the design vision, athlete performance and product excellence. You will be an active thought partner with Design, Product Management, Engineering, Materials, and Factory Product Creation Teams to develop processes and tools that push boundaries and create solutions that support the creation of Nike’s game changing footwear products.

  • Bachelor’s Degree in Product Development or Product Engineering, Manufacturing, Marketing, Industrial Design or related field. Will accept any suitable combination of education, experience, and training.

  • Minimum of 8+ years directly applicable work experience

  • High profile communication and influencing skills, including the ability to interact and update leaders on status to ensure alignment.

  • Consistent track record of pulling together diverse individuals with conflicting priorities, while identifying a path forward, and championing alignment.

  • Prior experience in delivering footwear innovation projects through transition, commercialization and to retail

  • Expert knowledge of footwear manufacturing technologies and equipment, tooling, and materials is highly preferred. Including Nike product creation software and tools.

  • The ability to anticipate and solve complex footwear manufacturing issues with Asia teammates to ensure mass production can achieve quality and craftsmanship standards.

  • Proficient understanding of product planning, forecasting, logistics, process planning, and expertise in project management with strong communication skills

  • Instills confidence and empowers a project team in delivering product excellence through collaboration

  • Entrepreneurial mindset and spirit to proactive address critical deliverables while identify novel solutions that address technical and business challenges.

  • Bias towards action and comfortable working in ambiguous environments

  • Adjust to changing circumstances and adapt to ensure product excellence

  • In-depth understanding of Nike date and gates, with the ability to adjust project plans based on compressed timelines

  • An understanding of consumer electronics product development, preferred

  • The ability to travel 20% of the time domestic and international

WHAT YOU’LL WORK ON

We are seeking a Principal Footwear Developer who will work in Product Creation to transition Footwear innovation projects from Nike’s innovation team through development to retail. You drive the development through commercialization and ensure successful launch to market. As a problem solver, your ability to identify novel solutions while creating innovative product and bringing it to market will be fuel by your love of product. You will have the opportunity to deliver transformative product that will excite and delight Nike athletes* and consumer. You will be passionate about achieving the ultimate goal of timely manufacturability of quality and crafted, tested and validated, sustainable and efficient products, that meet or exceed our performance criteria and design intent.

We offer a number of accommodations to complete our interview process including screen readers, sign language interpreters, accessible and single location for in-person interviews, closed captioning, and other reasonable modifications as needed. If you discover, as you navigate our application process, that you need assistance or an accommodation due to a disability, please complete the Candidate Accommodation Request Form.

title: Commercial Director
description:
ACCIONA is a global company, leading in the development of regenerative infrastructure that creates a positive impact on society. Our workforce consists of more than 65,000 professionals, present in more than 40 countries across the five continents, all contributing in our mission to design a better planet. Are you a passionate individual who wants to make a difference, promote sustainable development, and find solutions to the biggest global challenges including climate change, overpopulation, and water scarcity? Come and join us in building the infrastructure our planet needs to achieve a sustainable future.

Job Description

  • Lead commercial strategy on nationally significant projects

  • Rewarding salary with annual bonuses and reviews

  • Recognised Top Employer, 2022 to 2026

Project Info

ACCIONA Infrastructure is growing its Origination team, driving the pursuit of major road, rail, water and energy projects across Australia. Our current pipeline spans some of the country's most complex and high-value infrastructure programs, from motorway and rail upgrades to water treatment and renewable energy assets. This role sits at the centre of that growth, shaping how ACCIONA prices, structures and wins new work. You will help build the commercial foundations for projects that will serve Australian communities for decades.

About Opportunity

As Commercial Director or Senior Commercial Manager, you will lead commercial strategy and structuring across ACCIONA's Origination pipeline. You will guide bid teams through pricing, risk allocation and contract structuring from early opportunity assessment through to submission and award. Working closely with estimating, engineering, legal and bid leadership, you will shape the commercial position on major pursuits and represent ACCIONA in client and partner negotiations. This role carries real influence over which projects we pursue and how we win them.

Key Accountabilities

  • Lead commercial strategy across allocated bids and pursuits

  • Structure pricing, risk allocation and contract terms

  • Negotiate commercial terms with clients, partners and subcontractors

  • Assess and mitigate commercial and contractual risk on tenders

  • Partner with estimating and engineering to build competitive bids

  • Manage joint venture, alliance and consortium commercial arrangements

  • Mentor and develop commercial team members across Origination

Required Skills and Competencies

  • Degree in quantity surveying, law, commerce or engineering

  • Extensive experience in commercial leadership on major infrastructure bids

  • Strong track record negotiating complex contracts and JV structures

  • Deep understanding of risk allocation and tender pricing strategy

  • Proven ability to lead and develop commercial teams

At ACCIONA, we offer a dynamic and challenging work environment where our employees can grow and develop their careers. We provide opportunities for professional development, and our team members are encouraged to bring new ideas and approaches to their work. Our company is dedicated to fostering a culture of inclusiveness and respect where every employee feels valued and supported.

ACCIONA has been given the Top Employer 2022, 2023, 2024 & 2025 certification in Australia, which certifies the company's commitment to excellence in human resources management and those who focus on putting their people first through their exceptional HR policies. Since establishing a presence in Australia in 2002, ACCIONA has made significant investments in local opportunities and project development. ACCIONA employs more than 3,000 people in its renewable energy, infrastructure and water projects across Australia & New Zealand.

We are an Equal Opportunity Employer and promote equality and diversity. Indigenous Australians and candidates from minority groups are encouraged to apply.

Job Description

*** If you have any questions or to connect with a recruiter while your application is being reviewed, please Text DFS3 to 317-597-8130 ***

Days: Monday through Friday

Hours: 7 am to 4 pm

Cox Fleet keeps your fleet moving!

Headquartered in Indianapolis, Cox Fleet has grown to become one of the largest fleet maintenance companies in the country.

Cox Fleet is the leading provider of on-site mobile maintenance and repair services nationwide, offering mobile on-site fleet service for light medium, and heavy-duty trucks and trailers. Cox Fleet also services customers utilizing its 50+ nationwide service centers; each offering accident repair, painting, refurbishment, and heavy mechanical repair. We are supported by a 24/7 in-house call-center and provide scheduled maintenance services and unscheduled services to fleets anywhere, anytime.

Cox Fleet is currently hiring a Mobile Diesel Technician Level II.

The Mobile Diesel Technician Level II will be responsible for performing licensed DOT inspections, Preventative Maintenance inspections, light and follow-up repairs, light mechanical/hydraulic/electrical and electronic diagnostics, and other duties as assigned. The Mobile Diesel Technician II can perform more advanced diagnostics and repairs under the supervision of a Sr Mobile Diesel Technician or higher. The Diesel Technician II continues to learn additional advanced mechanical skills and diagnostic techniques. A successful Diesel Technician II complies with all company policies and achieves high level performance metrics.

DUTIES:

  • Perform scheduled preventative maintenance (“PM”), DOT Inspections and follow up repairs on light, medium and heavy-duty vehicles in a mobile/field environment.

  • Perform minor adjustment and repairs on various types of truck equipment including, but not limited to the following: Electrical/Brake/Cooling Systems, Starters/Alternators, Fan clutches, Engine electronics, Diesel steering systems, Engines (gas and diesel), Transmissions (manual and automatic), Clutches, Differentials, etc.

  • Diagnose, adjust, and repair various types of truck equipment including, but not limited to the following: Electrical/Brake/Cooling Systems, Starters/Alternators, Air conditioning systems, Fan clutches, Engine electronics, Diesel steering systems, Engines (gas and diesel), Transmissions (manual and automatic), Clutches, Differentials, etc.

  • Inspect, test, and listen to defective equipment to diagnose malfunctions, using test instruments such as handheld computers and pressure gauges.

  • Road test vehicles to diagnose malfunctions and to ensure that they are working properly.

  • Identify problems, determine accuracy and relevance of information, using sound judgment to generate and evaluate alternatives.

  • Independently manage parts inventory and equipment provided on company-issued service truck and perform periodic reconciliation.

  • Maintain and operate company-issued service vehicle, conduct safety checks, and pre-/post-trip inspections of vehicle.

  • Work with and listen effectively to clients and customers to assess their needs, providing information or assistance, resolving their problems, or satisfying their expectations.

  • Manage concurrent assigned tasks, making effective judgments as to prioritizing work related activities and time allocations.

  • Use hand tools, precision instruments, as well as Diesel tools, welding equipment, lift and jacks.

  • Document according to company standards and upload pictures of work performed, parts used, and all findings observed on Repair Orders (“RO”) using company-issued iOS device and our proprietary TRAIT application.

  • Accurately complete DOT forms and all other forms of documentation in a timely fashion.

  • Work with a high degree of independence and manage own daily schedule.

  • Maintain a high level of productivity and be able to work within or close to most Standard Repair Times.

  • Obtain parts from approved local and national vendors as necessary for the repairs to be performed.

  • Communicate with management and support team via email or phone to obtain approvals on repair estimates, retrieve purchase order numbers and/or discuss RO findings notes.

  • Perform all work in compliance with organizational safety, health and environmental policies, and federal regulations, to include OSHA, EPA, and DOT.

  • Maintain company issued service truck, conduct safety checks and daily pre/post trip inspections.

title: Sr. Scientist, Analytic Science
description:
FICO (NYSE: FICO) is a leading global analytics software company, helping businesses in 100+ countries make better decisions. Join our world-class team today and fulfill your career potential!

The Opportunity

The need for analytics is everywhere! Want to build something meaningful and have fun while doing it? We do too and have been using cutting edge technology to help build industry leading solutions for businesses and consumers in the credit risk space. If you are a problem solver and like the idea of solving tough problems with data and analytics in real world situations, you will thrive here at FICO! You will have the opportunity to work side by side with some of the brightest analytical and engineering minds in the industry who share a passion for innovation.

What You’ll Contribute

  • Oversee project teams building high-end analytic models and tools for relevant problems using statistical modeling techniques.

  • Ensure the development of regulatory compliant FICO Scores to the US market.

  • Work with large amounts of real-world data and ensure data quality throughout all stages of acquisition and processing, including data collection, normalization and transformation.

  • Research and select appropriate statistical methods and computational algorithms.

  • Lead and manage critical projects across FICO Scores, working under time constraints and partnering with cross-functional teams to translate complex models and analytics into clear insights.

  • Serve as a trusted analytic partner, assisting with client meetings to provide support, investigate issues, and resolve problems.

  • Leverage and apply advanced data mining methodology to drive in-depth model behavior analysis, guidance on model construction, and deliver key insights and direction for internal/external stakeholders.

What We’re Seeking

  • Bachelor's Degree in Computer Science, Cognitive Science, Engineering, Physics, Statistics, Mathematics, Operations Research, or other Natural Science fields (Highly Preferred).

  • Advanced proficiency using analytic techniques such as neural networks, logistic regression, non-linear regression, random forests, decision trees, support vector machines, linear/non-linear optimization (Highly Preferred).

  • Deep level of expertise in predictive modeling and data mining, with demonstrated hands-on related experience in a relevant industry.

  • Experience working with U.S. Credit Bureau data (Highly Preferred).

  • Extensive experience analyzing large data sets and applying data-cleaning techniques along with performing statistical analyses leading to the understanding of the structure of data sets.

  • Proven experience working with at least two of the following: Python, Java, R, SQL, MATLAB, SAS, C++ or C.

  • Proven ability to collaborate cross functionally with various stakeholders and senior leadership, including experience presenting and articulating technical topics and analytics.

Our Offer to You

  • An inclusive culture strongly reflecting our core values: Act Like an Owner, Delight Our Customers, and Earn the Respect of Others.

  • The opportunity to make an impact and develop professionally by leveraging your unique strengths and participating in valuable learning experiences.

  • Highly competitive compensation, benefits and rewards programs that encourage you to bring your best every day and be recognized for doing so.

  • ​An engaging, people-first work environment offering work/life balance, employee resource groups, and social events to promote interaction and camaraderie.

  • The targeted base pay range for this role is: $140,000 to $220,000 with this range reflecting differences in candidate knowledge, skills and experience.

Why Make a Move to FICO?

At FICO, you can develop your career with a leading organization in one of the fastest-growing fields in technology today – Big Data analytics. You’ll play a part in our commitment to help businesses use data to improve every choice they make, using advances in artificial intelligence, machine learning, optimization, and much more.


FICO makes a real difference in the way businesses operate worldwide:

• Credit Scoring — FICO® Scores are used by 90 of the top 100 US lenders.

• Fraud Detection and Security — 4 billion payment cards globally are protected by FICO fraud systems.

• Lending — 3/4 of US mortgages are approved using the FICO Score.

Global trends toward digital transformation have created tremendous demand for FICO’s solutions, placing us among the world’s top 100 software companies by revenue. We help many of the world’s largest banks, insurers, retailers, telecommunications providers and other firms reach a new level of success. Our success is dependent on really talented people – just like you – who thrive on the collaboration and innovation that’s nurtured by a diverse and inclusive environment. We’ll provide the support you need, while ensuring you have the freedom to develop your skills and grow your career. Join FICO and help change the way business thinks!

description:

We’re seeking versatile experts who share our passion for innovation and excellence. This is your chance to learn, grow, and thrive in a dynamic and inclusive organization.

Castrol is a global leader in lubricants and part of the bp Group, one of the world’s largest energy companies. In India, Castrol is a publicly listed company, leading in the Automotive, Industrial, and Marine lubricant sectors. With iconic brands, steadfast innovation, strong customer relationships, and a team of highly motivated employees, we have maintained our market leadership in India for over a century. Our robust manufacturing and distribution network in India helps us reach consumers through more than 135,000 outlets.

At Castrol, success knows no bounds. We offer a fast-paced learning environment where you can develop your career, whether in specialized functions or on a general management track. Castrol India has a proud legacy of championing top talent for leadership roles, both locally and globally. ​

Role title - Lead - Shipping Operations (Chartering, Vetting & Port Clearance)

Location - Pune

  • This role is critical to building Castrol’s independent marine capability, ensuring safe, compliant, and cost-efficient global supply.

  • You will lead the establishment and ongoing operation of Castrol’s independent global Shipping Operations function, transitioning from bp TSA to a fully owned, future-ready operating model.

  • This is an enterprise-critical role with end-to-end accountability for safety, compliance, cost, and continuity across global marine movements. You will establish the Shipping Operations Centre of Excellence, define governance and decision rights, and ensure effective execution across chartering, vetting, and port clearance.

  • You will also ensure Shipping Operations is fully integrated into Castrol’s Logistics Control Tower, enabling end-to-end visibility, performance management, and data-driven decision-making across global marine flows.

  • This role sits at the intersection of operations, risk management, and strategy, requiring strong leadership across internal teams, TSA providers, third parties, and senior partners.

Key Responsibilities -

1. Shipping Operations CoE & Operating Model:

  • Establish and lead the global Shipping Operations Centre of Excellence

  • Define the target operating model, roles, governance, and decision rights across chartering, vetting, and port clearance.

  • Build scalable operating rhythms, standards, and blocking issue pathways across regions.

  • Develop organisational capability to support Castrol’s long-term independent marine operating model

2. TSA Ownership & Transition:

  • Act as Castrol owner for Shipping Operations under the TSA environment

  • Lead transition planning, cutover readiness, and TSA exit execution

  • Ensure operational continuity, knowledge transfer, and effective mobilisation of internal and third-party capabilities

  • Support the development of regional procedures, controls, and service expectations for post-TSA execution

3. Global Performance, Cost & Optimisation:

  • Drive freight cost optimisation, service reliability, and operational efficiency across marine operations

  • Define and govern indicators covering cost, service, safety, compliance, utilisation, and demurrage

  • Oversee shipping capacity, utilisation, and operational trade-offs across regions

  • Ensure marine operations support supply-demand plans, inventory positioning, and customer delivery commitments

  • Identify and prioritise continuous improvement opportunities to improve value delivery and resilience

4. Safety, Compliance & Marine Risk:

  • Set and govern standards for HSSE, sanctions compliance, and marine risk management

  • Ensure robust control frameworks are in place for vessel, terminal, and cargo movement decisions

  • Oversee governance for incidents, exceptions, and critical issues impacting safety, compliance, or continuity

  • Ensure marine operations are driven in accordance with regulatory, internal policy, and assurance requirements

5. Digitalisation & Logistics Control Tower Integration:

  • Define requirements and lead selection of digital tools for Shipping Operations post-TSA

  • Embed digital ways of working across chartering, vetting, clearance, and performance reporting

  • Integrate Shipping Operations into the Logistics Control Tower to improve visibility, exception management, and decision support

  • Enable data clarity and analytics to support performance management and operational governance

6. Collaborator & Partner Management:

  • Build strong alignment with Procurement, Finance, HSSE, Legal, Digital, and regional Supply Chain teams

  • Lead engagement with TSA providers, ship owners, brokers, terminals, and marine service providers

  • Define clear interfaces between global CoE, regional execution teams, and assurance roles

  • Influence senior partners on risk, cost, continuity, and operating model decisions.

Required Skill

  • 12–18 years of experience in marine or shipping operations, including chartering, vetting, clearance, and/or port operations

  • Strong experience in global tanker, lubricants, chemicals, or liquid bulk shipping environments

  • Proven experience leading complex operating model transitions, TSA exits, outsourcing transitions, or major shipping transformations

  • Deep understanding of marine risk, vessel vetting standards, sanctions controls, and maritime compliance requirements

  • Demonstrated ability to lead global teams and influence across regions, functions, and third parties

  • Strong commercial and operational judgement, with the ability to balance cost, service, risk, and continuity

  • Bachelor’s degree or equivalent experience in Maritime Studies, Supply Chain, Engineering, or a related field.

Preferred Skill

  • Experience in oil & gas, lubricants, or chemical shipping environments

  • Familiarity with chartering, vetting, voyage management, or Control Tower systems

  • Experience working with brokers, marine service providers, or 3PL/4PL operating models

  • Strong understanding of trade compliance, geopolitical risk, and marine assurance governance

You will work with -

  • Regional Chartering & Voyage Operations Leads

  • Marine Vetting & Clearance Specialist

  • Global Supply Chain and Logistics leadership

  • Procurement, Finance, HSSE, Legal, and Digital teams

  • TSA providers, ship owners, charterers, brokers, terminals, and marine service partners

  • Procurement (marine sourcing & contracts)

  • Finance (freight cost, budgeting, performance tracking)

  • Digital & IT teams (system selection and integration)

  • External partners: ship owners, charterers, brokers, vetting agencies, port authorities

  • Regional Supply Chain, Procurement, and Commercial teams

title: Consumer & Market Insights Director
description:
Position Summary

This role is not eligible for immigration sponsorship.

Samsung Electronics America (SEA) is a leader in mobile technologies, consumer electronics, home appliances, enterprise solutions and networks systems. Across each of these areas, our work drives innovation, economic growth and workforce opportunity in the United States.

For nearly five decades, Samsung has been at the forefront of technological advancements, investing over $100 billion and creating more than 20,000 jobs nationwide. Our mission? To integrate cutting-edge products, services, and AI technology to deliver smarter, sustainable, and more connected experiences that empower people to live better.

As a wholly owned subsidiary of Samsung Electronics Co., Ltd., SEA offers opportunities to work alongside global visionary thinkers and innovators who are passionate about making a difference. Explore the exciting opportunities at Samsung Electronics America and discover how you can make an impact.

To learn more, visit Samsung.com. For the latest news, visit news.samsung.com/us.

Role and Responsibilities

Role & Responsibilities

The Consumer & Market Insights Director is the Corporate Marketing team's expert voice on the consumer: who they are, how they use Samsung products, and how they perceive the Samsung brand relative to competitors. This person owns the end-to-end insights agenda: designing and fielding primary research, synthesizing secondary and syndicated research, and translating findings into clear, decision-ready recommendations. The role sits at the intersection of research rigor and business impact, partnering closely with brand, media, and creative teams to ensure every major marketing decision is grounded in a deep, current understanding of the consumer.

Primary Research

  • Design, scope, and manage primary quantitative and qualitative research studies (e.g., surveys, focus groups, in-depth interviews, ethnographies, usability studies) to answer specific business questions.
  • Select and manage external research vendors and panels; negotiate scopes of work, timelines, and budgets.
  • Develop research objectives, hypotheses, discussion guides, and questionnaires in partnership with marketing stakeholders.
  • Analyze primary research data (using statistical and qualitative analysis methods) to surface clear, actionable findings.

Secondary Research & Market Intelligence

  • Monitor and synthesize syndicated and secondary research (e.g., category reports, analyst research, industry studies, social listening, competitive intelligence) relevant to consumer electronics and Samsung's core categories.
  • Maintain a current, organized point of view on consumer trends, category dynamics, and competitive brand positioning.
  • Curate and evaluate third-party research vendors, panels, and data sources to ensure the team has access to best-in-class tools and data.

Brand & Consumer Understanding

  • Serve as the organization's subject-matter expert on consumer attitudes, behaviors, needs, and perceptions related to Samsung products and the Samsung brand.
  • Build and maintain core measurement frameworks (e.g., brand health tracking, usage & attitude studies, customer satisfaction/NPS, purchase journey mapping) to monitor shifts over time.
  • Develop consumer segmentation and personas that inform targeting, messaging, and product strategy.
  • Translate complex research and data into clear, compelling narratives and recommendations tailored to marketing, brand, and executive audiences.
  • Present findings and recommendations to senior stakeholders, including corporate marketing leadership.

Business Partnership

  • Act as a trusted advisor to Corporate Marketing functional leadership, proactively identifying research needs that will help the team achieve its business objectives.
  • Prioritize and manage a portfolio of research initiatives against budget, timeline, and organizational priorities.

Skills and Qualifications

Skills & Qualifications

  • Minimum Bachelor’s degree with 12+ years of experience analyzing consumer data and providing insights that drive business, including research methods and statistics.
  • Mix of Client and/or agency side experience a plus.
  • Experience designing and executing both qualitative and quantitative primary research studies, from scoping through fielding to analysis.
  • Strong experience synthesizing secondary/syndicated research and competitive intelligence into usable business input.
  • Demonstrated ability to translate data into clear narratives and recommendations for non-technical, senior audiences.
  • Working knowledge of research methodologies, sampling, survey design, and statistical analysis.
  • Experience managing external research vendors, panels, and agency partners. Ability to adapt and move between platforms and partners to evolve with changing business needs.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication and presentation skills.
  • Experience with brand tracking, segmentation, and customer journey research.
  • Familiarity with tools such as Zappi, Sprinklr and Infotools. Experience with syndicated resources such as Kantar MONITOR, eMarketer and Statista.
  • Experience within a large matrixed organization or global brand marketing function.
  • Knowledge of the consumer electronics, mobile, home appliance, or CE/tech retail landscape.

title: Commercial Coordinator
description:
ACCIONA is a global company, leading in the development of regenerative infrastructure that creates a positive impact on society. Our workforce consists of more than 65,000 professionals, present in more than 40 countries across the five continents, all contributing in our mission to design a better planet. Are you a passionate individual who wants to make a difference, promote sustainable development, and find solutions to the biggest global challenges including climate change, overpopulation, and water scarcity? Come and join us in building the infrastructure our planet needs to achieve a sustainable future.


We have successfully delivered large infrastructure projects across Canada since 2001. Our leadership and expertise span the entire value chain from research and development through construction, operation and maintenance of projects. Currently involved in some of Canada’s largest infrastructure projects, ACCIONA delivers solutions that contribute to the economic and social progress of the communities in which it operates.

Job Description

Commercial Coordinator plays a pivotal role in managing contractual agreements, overseeing contract administration processes, facilitating communication and collaboration among project stakeholders, and ensuring compliance with legal and regulatory requirements. By effectively managing contracts and related activities, Commercial Coordinator contributes to the successful execution and delivery of the project within established parameters and objectives.

  • Oversee and manage all contractual agreements between the project owner, stakeholders, and various contractors involved in the project.
  • Identify, assess, and mitigate contractual risks, including potential liabilities, obligations, and exposures that may impact project outcomes.
  • Supervise and carry out the administration of contracts throughout the project lifecycle, including monitoring contract performance, tracking milestones, and managing deliverables.
  • Coordinate with project teams to ensure timely execution of contractual obligations and adherence to project schedules.
  • Ensure that contracts are accurately drafted, reviewed, and executed in accordance with project requirements and legal standards.
  • Ensure compliance with contractual terms, legal requirements, and regulatory standards applicable to the construction industry. Maintain a comprehensive database of contracts including key terms, expiration dates and renewal options.
  • Prepare, review, and issue formal correspondence, including notices, requests, and responses, to stakeholders, contractors, and clients in compliance with contract requirements, ensuring clarity, accuracy, and alignment with project objectives and timelines.
  • Process and manage change orders, variations, and amendments to existing contracts as necessary.
  • Review proposed changes, assess their impact on project scope, schedule, and budget, and negotiate terms and conditions with relevant parties.
  • Handle contract-related claims, disputes, and conflicts that may arise during the project lifecycle.
  • Work closely with legal counsel, project managers, and stakeholders to resolve disputes in a timely and amicable manner, minimizing disruption to project progress.
  • Maintain accurate and comprehensive records of all contractual documents, correspondence, and communications related to the project.
  • Organize contract files, amendments, and other documentation in a structured manner for easy retrieval and reference.
  • Serve as the primary point of contact for contractual matters, liaising between project stakeholders, contractors, and legal advisors as needed.
  • Facilitate effective communication and collaboration among internal and external stakeholders to ensure alignment on contract terms and project objectives.
  • Implement best practices, standard operating procedures, and tools to enhance efficiency, transparency, and accountability in contract administration.
  • Support the Contracts Manager with any other daily commercial/contractual activities as needed.

Required Skills and Competencies

  • This role requires a strong sense of accountability, exceptional attention to detail, and a demonstrated commitment to advancing in commercial/contract departments within the construction industry.
  • Bachelor’s degree in engineering, law, or a related field.
  • 3 to 7 years of experience in a commercial or administrative role within the construction industry, with demonstrated progression in responsibilities.
  • Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Office Suite (Word, Excel, PowerPoint, Visio) and familiarity with project management or contract management software is an asset.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to draft, review, and oversee formal project correspondence effectively.
  • Proven ability to lead and collaborate in diverse, cross-functional teams within a fast-paced and deadline-driven environment.
  • Skilled in prioritizing tasks, managing multiple assignments, and maintaining attention to detail under pressure.
  • Demonstrated ability to identify complex issues, perform detailed analysis, and recommend and implement effective solutions.
  • Proactive, self-managing, solution-oriented, highly organized, and adaptable to evolving project needs.
  • Strong knowledge of contract management principles, financial considerations, and risk assessment methodologies.

This role offers an annual base salary in the anticipated range of $90,000–$120,000 CAD, with compensation determined based on experience, qualifications, and internal equity.

In addition to base salary, this role includes a total rewards package that supports employee well-being, development, and long-term growth, subject to company policies and applicable provincial employment standards, including:

  • Group benefits and EFAP from your start date, with premiums paid by ACCIONA

  • RRSP matching

  • Share purchase program

title: Quality Assurance Engineer
description:
With a career at The Home Depot, you can be yourself and also be part of something bigger.

**This position is for engineering disciplines that focus on mechanical, electrical, or manufacturing engineering profiles. This position DOES NOT focus on IT, System Engineering, or Software related projects.

Position Purpose:

Develop and validate factory and product assessments, tests, and inspections in coordination with suppliers, foreign sourcing offices, and service providers. Ensure optimal execution of process controls for The Home Depot and related companies so that factories used and products manufactured meet or exceed product specifications and relevant national, state, and local laws. Ensure compliance to all relevant requirements from Standard Operating Procedures, contracts, supplier buying agreements, and purchase orders. Monitor the implementation of continuous improvement / corrective / preventive action plans throughout each process. Integrate all available supplier / factory / product data and analyze metrics and reporting to effectively monitor quality, service, cost, and risk components of each process. Focused on less complex manufacturing processes and product with lower product liability risks and related legislation / standards.


Key Responsibilities:

  • Assign assessment, test, and inspection work to service providers, based on predetermined selection criteria, a review of all technical requirements, and service provider capabilities.
  • Develop / validate test and inspection plans designed to assure quality of factories and products based on a review of all applicable safety standards (such as American National Standards Institute or Underwriters Laboratories), industry trends, and historical performance data.
  • Monitor and evaluate Private Brand product returns, damages, and voice of customer data in order to implement continuous improvement / CAPA (corrective action preventive action) plans throughout the product life cycle. Integrate supplier factory and product data, and analyze metrics to effectively monitor product quality
  • Evaluate and document cost / benefit trade-offs between prevention, detection, and failure response activities.
  • Support management in the review and resolution of issues with suppliers, factories, service providers, merchandising, store operations, distribution, safety, customers, and other related supply chain components as required.
  • Analyze and interpret assessment, test, and inspection results, determine root cause of failures and non-conformities, and drive continuous improvement and best practices.


Direct Manager/Direct Reports:

  • Position Reports to Director Quality Assurance


Travel Requirements:

title: VIDEO PRODUCTION SERVICE
description:
1. Background

BIGGER Écoles: Changing Attitudes and Norms to Prevent Underage Marriage in Marrakech-Safi is an initiative implemented by Project Soar and funded by the European Commission. The project aims to strengthen civil society organizations in Morocco to promote and protect human rights, address gender-based violence, champion girls’ rights, and prevent underage marriage through stronger engagement in public schools.

As part of the BIGGER Écoles Toolkit, Project Soar has developed learning content for school administrators and FNAPEM parents’ associations. This content covers the project cycle, safeguarding, referral and reporting procedures, School Dialogues, Family Advocacy Events, and other audience-specific responsibilities. The materials will be made available through short video-based eLearning capsules hosted online alongside the project guides and annexes. Project Soar therefore invites qualified videographers or audiovisual production providers to record the approved BIGGER Écoles video content over three filming days in Marrakech.


2. Objective

Project Soar seeks to contract a qualified videographer or audiovisual production company to plan and execute the technical recording of presenter-led BIGGER Écoles eLearning videos for school administrators and parents’ associations. The successful bidder will ensure consistent image, sound, lighting, framing, and visual quality across all sessions. The footage must be suitable for professional post-production and publication on web- and mobile-based learning platforms.


3. Responsibilities

The videographer will be responsible for the following:

• Participate in a pre-production briefing with the Project Coordinator and relevant team members to review the scripts, visual approach, filming schedule, branding requirements, and technical needs.

• Prepare a detailed filming plan and call sheet covering the three filming days, including set-up, recording sequence, breaks, retakes, and equipment requirements.

• Provide, install, operate, and safely remove all professional filming equipment required for the assignment, including camera(s), lenses, tripods or stabilization equipment, lighting, microphones, audio recording equipment, monitors, media storage, cables, and back-up equipment.

• Record presenter-led BIGGER Écoles content in Arabic in accordance with the approved scripts

• Ensure professional and consistent technical quality, including camera settings, composition, focus, exposure, white balance, lighting, clean audio, room tone, and continuity between takes and filming days.

• Support the presenters during filming by allowing adequate time for rehearsal, identifying technical issues, and recording retakes where needed.

• Monitor sound and image throughout each recording session and immediately flag any issue that may affect the usability of the footage.

• Maintain clear production logs identifying file names, scenes, takes, preferred takes, language versions, and any technical or continuity notes.

• Back up all footage and audio files at the end of each filming day to at least two separate storage locations.

• Organize and hand over all recorded footage, synchronized audio, production logs, and related files using an agreed folder and file-naming structure.

• Comply with Project Soar’s safeguarding, confidentiality, consent, and branding requirements throughout the assignment.

4. Expected Deliverables

Deliverable

Description

Pre-production package

Filming plan, technical set-up, equipment list, call sheets, and proposed file-management structure, approved before filming.

Three filming days

Complete professional recording of the approved BIGGER Écoles video capsules and related learning content during three full production days in Marrakech.

Daily footage back-up

Secure duplicate back-ups of all camera and audio files after each filming day.

Footage handover

All original high-resolution footage, separate audio files, proxy files if requested, production logs, and a clearly organized folder structure.

Technical quality check

Confirmation that files open correctly, are complete, and meet the agreed technical specifications before final acceptance.


5. Duration and Work Schedule

The assignment includes three full filming days in Marrakech on dates agreed with Project Soar. The selected provider must also allocate sufficient time before filming for technical preparation and after filming for file organization, quality control, and handover. Any change to the approved schedule must be communicated promptly and agreed in writing.


6. Reporting

The videographer will report directly to the Project Coordinator and coordinate closely with the eLearning Specialist, presenters, and other designated Project Soar team members. Project Soar will provide the approved scripts, relevant European Commission and Project Soar visibility guidance, the presenter schedule, and access to the agreed filming location.


7. Evaluation Criteria

Criterion

Weight

Relevant experience and portfolio quality

35%

Suitability of technical approach, equipment, and crew

30%

Financial proposal and value for money

25%

Availability, references, and understanding of the assignment

10%


8. Payment Terms

Payment will be made upon satisfactory completion and approval of the agreed deliverables:

1. 30% upon approval of the filming plan, technical set-up, equipment list, and call sheets.

2. 40% upon satisfactory completion of the three filming days.

3. 30% upon complete handover and acceptance of all organized footage, audio files, production logs, and back-ups.

Payments are subject to submission of a valid invoice and any applicable contractual and tax requirements.


9. Ownership, Confidentiality, and Safeguarding

• All footage, audio, project files, production records, and materials produced under this assignment will be the exclusive property of Project Soar upon payment.

Required Qualifications and Experience

• At least three years of demonstrated professional experience in videography or audiovisual production.

• A strong portfolio or showreel demonstrating presenter-led, educational, institutional, documentary, or non-profit video work.

• Proven ability to manage camera, lighting, and sound for indoor or studio-based productions.

• Strong attention to detail, reliability, time management, and ability to work collaboratively with presenters and a production team.

• Availability in Marrakech for all three scheduled filming days and for the agreed preparation and handover period.


Submission Requirements

Interested applicants should submit:

• An updated CV or company profile highlighting relevant experience.

• A portfolio or showreel with links to comparable work.

• A detailed financial proposal in Moroccan dirhams (MAD), clearly indicating professional fees, equipment rental, crew, transport, taxes, and any other costs. The proposed price should cover the complete assignment.

• Confirmation of availability for the proposed filming period.


If you are interested in this role, please submit your application as a single PDF file (titled: LastName-FirstName-) no later than Sept 15th, 2026.

title: Distribution Supervisor
description:
Alumicor Limited

The Supervisor, Distribution is a customer-focused leader responsible for ensuring products are received, managed, and delivered safely, accurately, and on time to meet customer expectations. This role oversees Distribution, Receiving, and Logistics operations while fostering a culture of service excellence, accountability, and teamwork. The Supervisor partners closely with internal stakeholders and external customers to proactively resolve issues, improve service levels, and drive continuous improvement initiatives that enhance the overall customer experience.

Key Responsibilities:

Customer Service & Delivery Excellence

  • Championing a customer-first culture by ensuring operational decisions support customer commitments and business objectives.
  • Ensure customer orders are fulfilled accurately, completely, and on time while maintaining quality standards.
  • Monitor service performance and proactively address issues that may impact on customer satisfaction.
  • Collaborate with Sales, Customer Service, Production, and Logistics teams to provide seamless support to customers.
  • Investigate customer service concerns and implement corrective actions to prevent recurrence.
  • Identify opportunities to improve service levels, responsiveness, and overall customer experience.

Distribution Warehouse Management

  • Lead warehouse operations to ensure efficient and accurate processing of customer orders.
  • Maintain inventory accuracy to support product availability and reliable customer deliveries.
  • Implement best practices that improve order fulfillment speed, accuracy, and consistency.
  • Utilize operational metrics to enhance customer service performance and operational effectiveness.

Receiving & Inventory Management

  • Work closely with Procurement and Quality teams to resolve receiving discrepancies and minimize supply disruptions.

  • Strong analytical skills with experience using KPI metrics to drive results.
  • Effective organizational and time-management skills with the ability to manage competing priorities.

  • Occasional travel for supplier visits, training, or business-related meetings.

This position is critical to delivering positive customer experience and strengthening customer trust. The successful candidate will build an engaged and accountable team that consistently provides safe, reliable, and efficient service while driving continuous improvements that support customer satisfaction, operational excellence, and business growth.
